cells.S: El Responsable de P&O Iberia - People Adm.&Industrial Relations - People Operations ejecuta en SAP HR Global (HGP) la transaccion ZRR_ITA2 para hacer un control de coherencia entre los datos de los trabajadores reflejados en los informes I.T.A obtenido en formato "txt" de Seguridad Social (a traves de SILTRA) y previamente cargados en el sistema, respecto a los datos de trabajadores que hay registrados en SAP HR Global (HGP). A traves de esta transaccion, SAP HR Global (HGP) automaticamente realiza un control de coherencia sobre la siguiente informacion:• Nº de trabajadores.• Codigo de cuenta del trabajador.• Contrato del trabajador.• DNI del trabajador.• Nº de afiliacion a la Seguridad Social.• Otros. En caso de resultado negativo, el sistema SAP HR Global (HGP) automáticamente genera un informe con las incoherencias que se hayan encontrado, que almacena en una unidad de red de P&O Iberia - People Adm.&Industrial Relations - People Operations con acceso reservado, . Después, el Responsable de P&O Iberia - People Adm.&Industrial Relations - People Operations investiga las causas de errores con los Responsables de HR BP según negocio/territorio correspondientes hasta su solución, dejando constancia las medidas correctoras y la explicación correspondiente en el informe utilizado para la verificación.
cells.T: The Head of P&O Iberia - People Adm.&Industrial Relations - People Operations performs in SAP HR Global (HGP) the transaction ZRR_ITA2 to check for coherence between the workers’ data in the I.T.A reports obtained in "txt" format from the Social Security (through SILTRA) and previously uploaded into the system, and the workers’ data recorded in SAP HR Global (HGP). Through this transaction, SAP HR Global (HGP) automatically checks for coherence about the following information: • Number of workers.• Worker’s account code.• Worker’s contract.• Worker’s DNI (National Identification document)• Social Security registration number.• Other.In case of negative result, the system SAP HR Global (HGP) automatically generates a report containing the incoherences found, which is stored in a network belonging to P&O Iberia - People Adm.&Industrial Relations - People Operations and with limited access. After this, the Head of P&O Iberia - People Adm.&Industrial Relations - People Operations investigates the error causes along with the Heads of HR BP until they are solved, recording the corrective measures and the related explanation within the report used for the verification.

cells.S: Los cambios en los datos familiares son solicitados por el empleado a través de la herramienta HR OIP EnLinea Admin Spain anexando en dicha herramineta la documentación soporte para cada cambio. _x000D_El operador de P&O Iberia - People Oper.&Industrial Relations - People Operations - Payroll verifica que la solicitud realizada en la herramienta HR OIP EnLinea Admin Spain y la documentación aportada por el empleado es correcta. _x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, (hay no correspondencia), el operador de P&O Iberia - People Oper.&Industrial Relations - People Operations - Payroll rechaza la solicitud de modificacion en el sistema. _x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, (todo es correcto), el operador de P&O Iberia - People Oper.&Industrial Relations - People Operations - Payroll registra la modifiación solicitada en el sistema SAP HR.
cells.T: Changes in family data are requested by the employee through the tool HR OIP EnLinea Admin Spain attaching the supporting documentation for each change in said tool. _x000D_The operator of P&O Iberia - People Oper.&Industrial Relations - People Operations - Payroll verifies that the request made in the HR OIP EnLinea Admin Spain tool and the documentation provided by the employee is correct. _x000D_In case of negative result, (there is no correspondence), the operator of P&O Iberia - People Oper.&Industrial Relations - People Operations - Payroll rejects the modification request in the system. _x000D_In case of positive result, (everything is correct), the operator of P&O Iberia - People Oper.&Industrial Relations - People Operations - Payroll records the requested modification in the SAP HR system.

cells.S: Anualmente y según el calendario de informes establecido por ADM Iberia - Cons.&Fin.Stat. Ibe (para Iberia) y Innovation&Sustainability Holding (para el Grupo Enel), el operador de P&O Iberia - People Operat Comp Ctr Ibe (Planning&Reporting) extrae de HR Analytics el fichero "Dashboard Diciembre AAAA.xlxs" que contiene los siguientes indicadores de plantilla:• Total número de empleados• Distribución de la plantilla por edad• Distribución de la plantilla por categoría profesional• Distribución de la plantilla por mujeres/hombres y categoria profesional• Distribución de la contratación• Nuevas contrataciones (para el Grupo Enel)y lo salva con el nombre "Dashboard December YYYY.xlsx" y extrae del front-end BO Global (People Global Reporting) de BW HR Global (BHP)) el informe "Closing" con los datos y movimientos de personal (altas, bajas y modificaciones de empleados del mes correspondiente) detallados por la empresa. A partir de esta información, el operador de P&O Iberia - People Operat Comp Ctr Ibe (Planning&Reporting) verifica que la información está completa y es correcta según los datos registrados en BW HR Global (BHP).• El dato del indicador “Total número de empleados” del fichero “Dashboard Diciembre AAAA.xlsx” coincide con la plantilla final recogida en el fichero “Closing”• Los indicadores “Nuevas contrataciones” y “Distribución de la plantlla por categoria profesional” del fichero “Dashboard Diciembre AAAA.xlsx” coincide con los datos recogidos en el fichero “Closing”• Los totales de los indicadores “Distribución del personal por edad”, “Distribución de la plantillal por mujeres/hombres y categoria profesional” y “Distribución de la contratación” del fichero “Dashboard Diciembre AAAA.xlxs” coincide con la plantilla final recogida en el fichero “Closing”.En caso resultado negativo, (se identifican inconsistencias o falta de información), el operador de P&O Iberia - People Operat Comp Ctr Ibe (Planning&Reporting) envía un correo a P&O - Planning&Organization notificando las discrepancias para que las subsanen.En caso de resultado positivo, (todo está correcto), el operador de P&O Iberia - People Operat Comp Ctr Ibe (Planning&Reporting) vuelca la información en el soporte establecido por ADM Iberia - Cons.&Fin.Stat. Ibe para el proceso de reporting de información de Sostenibilidad en Iberia o envía correo electrónico a P&O - Planning&Organization notificando que los indicadores son correctos para poder gestionar la carga de los indicadores en Digital S si el requirmiento ha sido realizado por Innovation&Sustainability Holding para el proceso de reporting de información de Sostenibilidad del Grupo Enel.
cells.T: Annually and according to the reporting calendar established by ADM Iberia - Cons.&Fin.Stat. Ibe (for Iberia) and Innovation&Sustainability Holding (for Enel Group), the operator of P&O Iberia - People Operat Comp Ctr Ibe (Planning&Reporting) extracts from the HR Analytics system the "Sustainability" report with the following indicators: - Distribution of the workforce by women/men- Distribution of the workforce by age- Distribution of the workforce by professional category- Distribution of the workforce by women/men and professional category- Distribution of the workforce by type of contract- New hires (for Enel Group)and saves it under the name "Dashboard December YYYY.xlsx" and extracts from BO Global (People Global Reporting) front-end of BW HR Global (BHP)) the "Closing" report with the data and personnel movements (employees' registrations, cancellations and modifications of the corresponding month) detailed by the company. Based on this information, the P&O Iberia - People Operat Comp Ctr Ibe (Planning&Reporting) operator verifies that the information is complete and correct according to the data recorded in BW HR Global (BHP). •The "Total number of employees" data in the "Dashboard December YYYY.xlsx" file matches the data collected in the "Closing" file.•The indicators "New hires" and "Distribution of the workforce by professional category" of the file "Dashboard December YYYY.xlsx" match the data collected in the file "Closing".•The results of the indicators "Distribution of the workforce by age",  "Distribution of the workforce by women/men", "Distribution of the workforce by women/men and professional category" and "Distribution of the workforce by type of contract" of the file "Dashboard December YYYY.xlsx" match the data collected in the file "Closing".In case of negative result, (any inconsistencies or missing information are identified), the operator of P&O Iberia - People Operat Comp Ctr Ibe (Planning&Reporting) sends an email to Holding P&O - Planning&Organization notifying the discrepancies so that they can be corrected.In case of positive result, (everything is correct), the operator of P&O Iberia - People Operat Comp Ctr Ibe (Planning&Reporting) sends an email to the operator of Holding P&O - Planning&Organization notifying that the indicators are correct so that can manage the uploading of the indicators in Digital S.

cells.S: Anualmente, o responsável da área gerenciamento de performance de pessoal (Operation Competence Center Unit) ou seu subordinado realiza uma verificação de exatidão, verificando se os dados relativos ao número de gerentes/gestores mulheres o número de funcionários transmitidos no Digital S são realmente os dados presentes no SAP BW do Brasil.Em caso de discrepância, o Responsável pela área ou seu subordinado solicita esclarecimentos ao Responsável de HR Support, que providenciará um novo upload se necessário.Na ausência de discrepância, o Responsável da área ou seu subordinado envia os dados para o próximo nível de validação no sistema Digital S.
cells.T: The Responsible of the People Operation Competence Center Unit Brazil or his/her delegate performs a correctness check, verifying that the data related to the number of women managers/middle managers and the number of employees transmitted in Digital S is actually the data present in SAP BW Brazil.In case of a negative result of the check, the Responsible of People Operation Competence Center or his/her delegate asks for clarifications to the Responsible of HR Support who will provide to make a new upload if needed.In case of positive result of the check, the Responsible of the People Operation Competence Center or his/her delegate sends the data to the next level validation into Digital S system.

cells.S: Mensalmente, o Responsável da área de gerenciamento de performance de pessoal (HR support), ou seu subordinado, compara os campos do cargo do colaborador com da categoria de funcionário (e.g. blue collar, white collar, manager, etc.), presentes no masterfile HR payroll, armazenado dentro do SAP BW, e verifica se as informações correspondem com o que está presente nos parâmetros definidos pela área de People Operation Competence Center. Usa de dashboard Data Quality para vizualizar a quantidade de discrepâncias presentes entre as categorias._x000D__x000D_Em caso de discrepâncias, o Responsável do da área, ou o seu subordinado, comunica as alterações solicita ajuste à base de dados, para que a categoria do profissional condiza com o cargo._x000D__x000D_Na ausência de discrepâncias, o Responsável da área, ou seu subordinado, conclui o procedimento dentro do Dashboard.
cells.T: Monthly, the person responsible for the area of ​​personnel performance management (HR support), or his/her subordinate, compares the data of employee categories (e.g. blue collar, white collar, manager, etc.) with the current positions of the employees, both within the HR payroll masterfile, storaged at the SAP BW, assessing if the position matches the category recorded into the system, according to the parameters set by the area of People Operations Competence Centre. The discrepancies are presented by the Data Quality assessment Dashboard._x000D__x000D_In case of discrepancies, the person in charge of the area, or his/her subordinate, request the necessary changes to the database management for SAP BW, so that the category be updated to match the position._x000D__x000D_In the absence of discrepancies, the person in charge of the area, or his/her subordinate, conclude the procedure performed into the Dashboard.

cells.M: Errata/mancata approvazione e trasmissione dei dati utilizzati nella predisposizione dell'informativa quantitativa di Sostenibilità
cells.N: Incorrect/missing approval and transmission of data used in the elaboration of sustainability quantitative information
cells.S: El Responsable de I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) o su delegado, tras los cálculos automáticos en el sistema AQoS del KPI SAIDI, realiza una comprobación de la gestión de los datos, comparando el KPI calculado por el sistema con el Budget forecast y analizando toda desviación que prevea un desvío respecto al presupuesto.En caso de un resultado negativo de la comprobación [KPI>Budget forecast], el Responsable de I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) o su delegado solicita explicaciones dentro de su propia unidad para tratar de entender la tendencia anómala, o bien intenta solicitar el apoyo de las unidades territoriales (Áreas/Zonas).En este caso, el Responsable de I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) o su delegado, identifica los fallos anormales con impacto relevante en el rendimiento de la red para realizar un análisis específico sobre el mismo.En caso de que el resultado de la comprobación sea positivo [KPI<=Budget forecast], el Responsable de I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) o su delegado introduce los datos en el formato requerido y los sube a un sharepoint compartido con la unidad de O&M Performance Management Control (Global). Una vez cargados los datos,  envía un correo electrónico para confirmar la cumplimentación de los mismos.
cells.T: The I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) Responsible, or delegate, following the automatic calculations into AQoS system of the KPI SAIDI, performs a management check on the data, comparing the KPI calculated by the system with the budget forecast and analysing all variance that provides for a deterioration compared to the budget.In case of a negative result (KPI>Budget forecast), the I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) Responsible, or delegate, requests explanations within its own unit to try to understand the abnormal trend, or trying to request the support of territorial units (Areas/Zones).In that case, the I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) Responsible, or delegate, identify abnormal failures with relevant impact on the network performance in order to perform specific analysis on it.In case of a positive result (KPI<=Budget forcast), the I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) Responsible, or delegate, inserts the data within the required format and upload them into a sharepoint shared with the O&M Performance Management Control (Global) unit. Once data are upload, he/she sends an email to confirm its completion.
cells.AB: FERNANDO DIZ-LOIS RUIZ;Antonio Manuel Vargas Castejon;
cells.AF: 1. En caso de resultado negativo del control realizado, aclaraciones de toda desviación que suponga un deterioro entre los datos calculados en AQoS y el presupuesto por parte del Responsable de&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) o su delegado a las Áreas/Zonas afectadas, relacionadas con fallos relevantes en la red._x000D_Estas aclaraciones serán enviadas por correo electrónico a la unidad de O&M Performance Management Control (Global), que contienen la evidencia del archivo cargado, que incluye el KPI, en el sharepoint_x000D__x000D_2. En caso de que el resultado de la comprobación sea positivo, se enviará un correo electrónico a la unidad de O&M Performance Management Control (Global), que contiene las pruebas del archivo cargado, que incluyen el KPI, en el sharepoint.
cells.AG: 1. In case of a negative outcome of the control performed, clarifications of all variance that provides an deterioration between the data calculated in AQoS and the budget by the I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) Responsible or his delegate to the Areas/Zones concerned, related to relevant failures on the network._x000D_These clarifications will be sent by email  to the O&M Performance Management Control (Global) unit, which contain the evidence of the uploaded file, that include the KPI, in the sharepoint_x000D__x000D_2. In case of a positive result of the check, email sended to the O&M Performance Management Control (Global) unit, which contain the evidence of the uploaded file, that include the KPI, in the sharepoint.

cells.S: El responsable de la Unidad Regional de Network Operation and Maintenance revisa entre todas las interrupciones del suministro eléctrico ocurridas en la red de BT-MT con estado "VALIDADO" en GEMAS (lo que significa que la Operación de la Red de I&N (España) ha comprobado para cada interrupción todos los documentos relacionados, y las normas locales que son obligatorias, incluyendo todo tipo de responsabilidades: Planificada con preaviso, Terceros, etc... y ha cambiado el estado de la interrupción de "CUMPLIMENTADO" a "VALIDADO") aquellas para las que se ha cambiado la "Responsabilidad" por falta de información o por información errónea.- Si se detectan incoherencias, el operador de la Unidad de Unidad Regional de Network Operation and Maintenance inicia las acciones de corrección oportunas para que se cargue la información faltante en el sistema GEMAS o se la corrija, a fin de que se resuelva la irregularidad.- En caso de que el resultado de la comprobación sea positivo (evento correctamente revisado), la Unidad Regional de Network Operation and Maintenance mantiene en GEMAS la información original. I&N O&M Network Operation (España) revisa en GEMAS toda la documentación de todas las interrupciones modificadas y realiza de nuevo la validación para cada una de ellas.  I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) genera un informe en PowerBI relacionado con todas las interrupciones validadas.
cells.T: The person in charge of the Regional Area Network Operation and Maintenance Unit reviews among all interruptions of the electricity supply occurred in the LV-MV network with “VALIDADO” status (validated) in GEMAS (which means that I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) has checked for each interruption all the related documents, and local rules that are mandatory, including all types of responsibilities: Planned with notice, Third Parties, etc... and changed the interruption status from “Completed” to “Validated”) those for which the “Responsibility” has been changed due to a missing or wrong information.•	If incoherence’s are detected, the operator of the Regional Area Network Operation and Maintenance Unit initiates appropriate corrective actions to upload the missing information in GEMAS system or to correct it, so that the irregularity can be resolved.•	In case of a positive result of the check (event correctly reviewed), the Regional Area Network Operation and Maintenance Unit maintains in GEMAS the original information. I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) reviews in GEMAS all the documentation for all modified interruptions and performs again the validation for each one of them.  I&N O&M Network Operation (Spain) generates a report in PowerBI related to all the validated interruptions.

cells.S: Diariamente, el proceso de transmisión de datos entre la base de datos de AGUI (GEMAS) y AQOS realiza unas validaciones y comprueba que no hay errores de traspaso de datos, carga de información y cálculo de indicadores. AQOS guarda el resultado de dicho proceso en una tabla de log en la base de datos AQOS y envía lo por correo electrónico automáticamente al Gestor de Grid Remote Control Domain._x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, (si detecta algún error (p.e. traspaso de datos, carga de información o cálculo)), el Gestor de Grid Remote Control Domain abre una incidencia en One Click para resolverlos errores._x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, (todo es correcto), el Gestor de Grid Remote Control Domain guarda el correo electrónico recibido por el sistema AQOS con el resultado del proceso de transmisión de datos en la unidad red compartida.
cells.T: Daily, the data transmission process between the AGUI (GEMAS) database and AQOS performs validations and checks that there are no errors in data transfer, information loading and indicator calculation. AQOS saves the result of this process in a log table in the AQOS database and automatically sends by e-mail to the Manager of Grid Remote Control Domain ._x000D_In case of negative result, (any errors are detected (i.e. data transfer, data loading or calculation)), the Manager of Grid Remote Control Domain creates an incident in One Click to resolve the errors ._x000D_In case of positive result, (everything is correct), the Manager of Grid Remote Control Domain saves the received email by the AQOS system with the result of the process of data transmission in the shared network drive.

cells.S: Mensualmente, habiendo recibido todos los datos relativos a los eventos de HS a través de la herramienta HSEQ 4ALL del Responsable de la planta, el HSEQ Enel Green Power and Thermal Generation - Iberia o su delegado lleva a cabo:_x000D__x000D_i) una comprobación de integridad, verificando que todos los eventos de HS y los datos relacionados para el período han sido comunicados de acuerdo con la Policy n.106._x000D__x000D_ii) una comprobación puntual de todos los eventos de HS para verificar la coherencia entre los datos y la documentación soporte, verificando la información relativa a los eventos de HS registrados según la gravedad (por ejemplo, nombre y apellidos de la persona lesionada, número de serie del empleado, días de enfermedad, descripción / detalles de los eventos de HS) se corresponde con la documentación soporte de los mismos (por ejemplo, certificado médico, etc.)._x000D__x000D_En caso de que el resultado de las comprobaciones sea negativo, el Responsable de HSEQ de Enel Green Power y Generación Térmica - Iberia o su delegado solicita al Responsable de la planta los datos que faltan y/o las aclaraciones pertinentes y, si procede corrige los datos recibidos previamente._x000D__x000D_En caso de que el resultado de las comprobaciones sea positivo, los datos de los eventos de HS están disponibles en la herramienta HSEQ 4ALL para la unidad de HSEQ Health and Safety (HSEQ EGP y Generación Térmica).

cells.S: Una vez recibidos los datos relativos a un evento de HS comunicado por correo electrónico por parte de la unidad organizativa responsable de la actividad en la que ha ocurrido el evento o incidente, a través del archivo de comunicación inmediata establecido en cada momento en las Políticas, Instrucciones Operativas o Documentos internos vigentes (Anexo 1 Policy n.106), el Responsable o persona delegada de Health&Safety Enel Commercial Iberia realiza:i) una comprobación de integridad, verificando que el documento de comunicación inmediata contiene la información mínima exigible para la evaluación y clasificación del evento conforme a la Policy n.106.ii) una comprobación de la coherencia de datos de los eventos de HS del archivo de comunicación inmediata,  verificando la coherencia de la información relativa a los eventos de HS registrados según la gravedad (por ejemplo, nombre y apellidos de la persona lesionada, número de empleado, días de enfermedad, descripción/detalles de los eventos de HS) con la documentación soporte de los mismos (por ejemplo, certificado médico; etc.).En caso de que el resultado de las comprobaciones sea negativo, el Responsable o persona delegada Health&Safety Enel Commercial Iberia  solicita al trabajador afectado o su Responsable los datos o aclaraciones necesarias y, si procede, solicita nuevo reenvío actualizado o procede a corregir directamente los datos previamente recibidos de forma consensuada.En caso de que el resultado de las comprobaciones sea positivo o una vez subsanadas las incidencias,  el Responsable o persona delegada de Health&Safety Enel Commercial Iberia actualiza mensualmente el archivo excel establecido en cada momento por la normativa interna (ref. Anexo 3 Policy n.106) en el repositorio sharepoint que tenga establecido el área Global de HSEQ.
cells.T: Having receipt of the data relating to a HS event communicated by e-mail from the organisational unit responsible for the activity in which the event or incident has occurred, through the immediate communication file established at all times in the Policies, Operating Instructions or internal Documents in force (Annex 1 Policy n.106), the Head or delegated of Health&Safety Enel Commercial Iberia carries out:(i) a completeness check, verifying that the immediate communication document contains the minimum information required for the assessment and classification of the event in accordance with Policy n.106.ii) a data consistency check of the HS events in the immediate reporting file, verifying the consistency of the information related to the recorded HS events according to severity (e.g. name and surname of the injured person, employee number, sick days, description/details of the HS events) with the supporting documentation of the HS events (e.g. medical certificate; etc.).In case that the result of the checks is negative, the Head or delegated of Health&Safety Enel Commercial Iberia requests the necessary data or clarifications from the affected worker or the Head and, if appropriate, requests a new updated resubmission or proceeds to directly correct the data previously received by consensus.In case that the result of the checks is positive or once the incidents have been rectified, the Head or delegated of Health&Safety Enel Commercial Iberia updates the excel file established at all times by the internal regulations (ref. Annex 3 Policy n.106) monthly in the sharepoint repository established by the Global HSEQ area.

cells.S: HSE – Enel Grids IberiaSobre los eventos de HS compartidos a través del sistema H&S Global (Delfos), el Responsable de HSE – Enel Grids Iberia o su delegado realiza:i) una comprobación de integridad, verificando que todos los eventos de HS han sido cargados en el sistema por el técnico de SPM y que los datos relacionados para el periodo han sido comunicados y compartidos de acuerdo con la Policy n.106.ii) una comprobación de coherencia de todos los eventos de HS,  verificando la coherencia de la información relativa a los eventos de HS registrados según la gravedad (por ejemplo, nombre y apellidos de la persona lesionada, número de empleado, días de enfermedad de acuerdo con el RGPD (Reglamento General de Protección de Datos) y el primer pronóstico, descripción/detalles de los eventos de HS) con la documentación soporte de los mismos. En caso de que el resultado de las comprobaciones sea negativo, el Responsable de HSE – Enel Grids Iberia o su delegado solicita por correo electrónico o llamada telefónica al técnico de SPM los datos que faltan y/o la información/aclaraciones y corrige los datos en H&S Global (Delfos). En caso de que el resultado de las comprobaciones sea positivo, el Responsable de HSE – Enel Grids Iberia o su delegado procede a cargar los datos recibidos del técnico SPM en un archivo xls (ref. Anexo 2 Policy n.106) y los comparte con la unidad HSE - Cross Activities and Training - Enel Grids a través del sharepoint "Enel Grids HSEQ".
cells.T: HSE – Enel Grids IberiaOn the HS events shared through H&S Global (Delfos) system, the Head of HSE – Enel Grids Iberia, or delegate, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that all HS events have been uploaded into the system by the SPM technician and the related data for the period have been communicated and shared in accordance with Policy n.106.ii) a timely check on all HS events of consistency between data and supporting documentation, verifying the consistency of the information relating to the HS events recorded according to severity (e.g. name and surname of the injured person, employee number, days of illness in accordance with the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and the first prognosis, HS events description/details) with the documentation submitted in support of the HS events. In case of negative result of the checks, the Head of HSE – Enel Grids Iberia, or delegate, requests by email or phone call to the SPM technician the missing data and/or the information / clarifications and corrects the data into H&S Global (Delfos). In case of positive result of the checks, the Head of HSE – Enel Grids Iberia, or delegate, proceeds to uploads the data received by the SPM technician into an xls file (rif. Annex 2 Policy n.106) and shares them to  HSE - Cross Activities and Training - Enel Grids unit throught the dedicated sharepoint "Enel Grids HSEQ".

cells.S: Mensualmente, una vez recibidos por correo electrónico todos los datos relativos a las horas trabajadas por los contratistas por parte del delegado de la Línea de Servicio Responsable de Producto, el Responsable o persona delegada de HSEQ (Enel Commercial Iberia) carga los datos en el Cuadro de Mando "Informe WH Endesa Energía 20AA.MM.xlsx", y realiza: i) una comprobación de integridad, verificando que todos los datos han sido comunicados por el delegado de la Línea de Servicio Responsable de Producto;ii) un control de razonabilidad, comparando los datos con los mismos datos registrados en el mismo mes del año anterior, y los datos agregados del trimestre de cierre con los mismos datos registrados en el mismo trimestre del año anterior, analizando todas las desviaciones superiores al 15% en valor absoluto entre trimestres.En caso de resultado negativo (desviación superior al 15%), el Responsable o persona delegada de HSEQ (Enel Commercial Iberia) solicita a cada Responsable de Producto de la Línea de Negocio o su delegado, en los casos que corresponda, aclaraciones sobre la causa de dicho desvío.En caso de que el resultado positivo (desviación inferior o igual al 15%), el Responsable o persona delegada de HSEQ (Enel Commercial Iberia) procede a cargar la información pertinente (que contiene los datos de las horas trabajadas por los contratistas) en el repositorio pertinente de HSEQ Global Enel Commercial.
cells.T: Monthly, once all the data related to the contractors' worked hours have been received by e-mail from the delegate of the Service Line Product Responsible, the HSEQ (Enel Commercial Iberia) Responsible, or delegate, uploads the data in the Scorecard "Informe WH Endesa Energía 20AA.MM.xlsx" file, and carries out:i)  a completenesscheck, verifying that all the the delegate of Service Line Product Responsible communicated the data;ii) a reasonableness check ,comparing the data with the same data recorded in the same month of the previous year, and the aggregate data of the closing quarter with the same data recorded in the same quarter of the previous year, analysing all deviations greater than 15% in absolute value between quarters.In case of negative result (deviation greater than 15%), the HSEQ (Enel Commercial Iberia) Responsible, or delegate, requests clarification from each Service Line Product Responsible or delegated, where applicable.In case of positive result (deviation less than or equal to 15%), the HSEQ (Enel Commercial Iberia) Responsible, or delegate, proceeds to upload the relevant information (containing the data of the hours worked by contractors) into the relevant HSEQ Global Enel Commercial repository.

cells.S: HSE – Enel Grids IberiaEl responsable de la unidad HSE – Enel Grids Iberia, o su delegado, recibe del gestor de P&O Iberia - Health & Safety (Sistemas de Gestión y SS. Transversales) la extracción de H&S Global Reporting con los datos relativos a las horas trabajadas por los contratistas y realiza:i) una comprobación de integridad, verificando que los datos de todas las unidades organizativas afectadas están presentes;ii) un control de razonabilidad con respecto al valor correspondiente a la media de los cinco meses anteriores, investigando cualquier desviación significativa e inesperada superior a un 15% o inferior a un 15%ii) un control de razonabilidad con respecto al mismo valor registrado YTD (year-to-date) en el mismo mes del año anterior, investigando cualquier desviación significativa e inesperada superior a un 10% o inferior a un 10%iv) comprueba si las 'horas trabajadas de contratistas' informadas en los meses anteriores del año en curso han sido correctasEn caso de resultado negativo de las comprobaciones, el responsable de la unidad HSE – Enel Grids Iberia o su delegado solicita solicita al gestor de P&O Iberia - Health & Safety (Sistemas de Gestión y SS. Transversales) o a la persona designada como responsable de reportar las horas totales de contratistas desde el Área/Proceso correspondiente aclaraciones sobre los datos extraídos de H&S Global Reporting.En caso de que el resultado de las comprobaciones sea positivo y/o tras solicitar las oportunas aclaraciones, el responsable de la unidad HSE – Enel Grids Iberia o su delegado envía un correo con el archivo de las horas trabajadas de los contratistas a HSEQ GI&N (Unidad HSEQ Enel Grids), incluyendo a las personas de referencia de Enel Grids HSE, y siguiendo el formato comunicado por HSE - Cross Activities and Training – Enel Grids Global.
cells.T: HSE – Enel Grids IberiaThe head of HSE – Enel Grids Iberia unit, or his delegate, receives from the operator of P&O Iberia - Health & Safety (Sistemas de Gestión y SS. Transversales) the extraction from H&S Global Reporting the data related to the contractors' worked hours and carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that the data of all organisational units concerned are present;ii) a reasonableness check with respect to the value corresponding to the average of the previous five months, investigating any significant and unexpected deviation of more than 15% or less than 15%.iii) a reasonableness check with respect to the same value recorded YTD (year-to-date) in the same month of the previous year, investigating any significant and unexpected deviation of more than 10% or less than 10%.iv) checks whether the 'contractor hours worked' reported in the previous months of the current year have been correct.In case of negative result, the head of HSE – Enel Grids Iberia unit or his delegate requests clarification of the data extracted from H&S Global Reporting from the operator of P&O Iberia - Health & Safety (Sistemas de Gestión y SS. Transversales) or from the person designated as responsible for reporting the contractors' total worked hours from the corresponding Area/Process.In case of positive result, and/or after requesting the appropriate clarifications, the head of HSE – Enel Grids Iberia unit or his delegate sends an e-mail with the file of the contractors' worked hours to HSEQ GI&N (Unit HSEQ Enel Grids), including Enel Grids HSE reference people and following the format communicated by HSE - Cross Activities and Training - Enel Grids Global.

cells.S: Mensilmente il Data Owner del sistema EGC Elettrico, o un suo delegato, estrae da EGC i Report contenenti tutti gli stralci crediti e tutti i passaggi a perdita predisposti e validati in EGC Elettrico da uno stesso utente per richiedere la validazione agli User Manager delle attività eseguite dai propri collaboratori in possesso dell'incompatibilità SOD. Dopo aver ricevuto i riscontri dagli User Manager degli utenti, in caso di esito negativo del controllo, il Data Owner del sistema EGC Elettrico, o il suo delegato, invia una mail con l’esito dell’analisi agli User Manager segnalando le eventuali squadrature, e se necessario provvede a richiedere di effettuare le relative sistemazioni a sistema e di riceverne evidenza. In caso di esito positivo del controllo, il Data Owner del sistema EGC Elettrico, o il suo delegato, archivia i report di controllo con le validazioni ricevute dagli User Manager.
cells.T: On a monthly basis, the Data Owner of the EGC Electrico system, or his delegate, extracts the Reports from EGC  containing all the credit write-offs and all the loss-making passages prepared and validated in EGC Electric by the same user to request the User Managers to validate the activities performed by their collaborators in possession of the SOD incompatibility. After receiving the feedbacks from the User Managers of the users, in the event of a negative outcome of the check, the Data Owner of the EGC Elettrico system, or his delegate, sends an email with the result of the analysis to the User Managers reporting any squaring, and if necessary, requests to carry out the related system adjustments and to receive evidence of it. In the event of a positive outcome of the control, the Data Owner of the EGC Elettrico system, or your delegate, archives the control reports with the validations received from the User Managers.
cells.AB: Alessandro Rossi;

cells.AG: 1) Credit write-offs report _x000D_2) Loss-making passages report _x000D_3) Validation of the User Managers (in case of positive outcome of the control) _x000D_4) Evidence adjustments executed on system (in case of negative outcome of the control)

cells.S: Il Responsabile dell’Unità Planning and Reporting (Industrial Control EGP and TGX), o suo delegato, a valle del caricamento manuale in NEW PRIMO dei dati relativi al KPI GN02 "Additional Capacity MW" da parte delle Country, effettua le seguenti verifiche mediante il supporto degli industrial controller delle Unità Operation & Maintenance ed Engineering & Construction:i) sulla completezza del dato risalito in NEW PRIMO;ii) sulla consistenza complessiva del dato, comparando il dato actual presente in NEW PRIMO con i dati "expected" (budget).In caso di esito negativo del controllo, il Responsabile di Planning and Reporting (Industrial Control EGP and TGX), o suo delegato, contatta via mail i controller di riferimento al fine di richiedere spiegazioni e le dovute correzioni in NEW PRIMO. Solo nel caso in cui l’anomalia non venga sanata prima della chiusura contabile, il Responsabile di Planning and Reporting (Industrial Control EGP and TGX), o suo delegato, provvede a comunicarla via mail all’Unità Group Planning, Reporting and Performance Control.A valle delle suddette verifiche, il dato è disponibile in NEW P.R.I.MO.
cells.T: The Planning and Reporting (Industrial Control EGP and TGX) Responsible, or delegate, after the manual data uploading related to the KPI GN02 "Additional Capacity MW", verifies with support of Industrial Controller of Operation & Maintenance and Engineering & Construction Units: i) the completeness of the data uploaded in NEW PRIMO;ii) the complessive consistency of the data, comparing the actual data in NEW PRIMO with the expected data (budget).In case of misalignments, the Planning and Reporting (Industrial Control EGP and TGX) Responsible, or delegate, requests via email the related clarifications to the relative P&C Responsible and requests the appropriate corrections in NEW PRIMO. Only in the event that the anomaly is not fixed before the closing date, the Planning and Reporting (Industrial Control EGP and TGX), or delegate, communicates the anomaly via email to the Group Planning, Reporting and Performance Control Unit.Following the aforementioned checks, the data is available in NEW P.R.I.MO.
cells.AB: Biagio Faina;BIANCAROSA NASO;

cells.S: El Responsable de P&C Energy & Commodity Management Chile (o  delegado), luego de recibir vía correo electrónico que se encuentra disponible la información del analista de Margin Contribution Management  relacionadas con todas las empresas EM19 "Net Electricity Production fed into the grid GWh" realiza un chequeo de integridad, verificando que todas las empresas hayan enviado la información requerida para el KPI.			En caso de resultado negativo,  falta información, el Responsable de P&C Energy & Commodity Management Chile (o  delegado), solicita vía correo electrónico al analista de Margin Contribution Management que brinde la información faltante / incompleta.			 En caso de resultado positivo,  no existan discrepancias, el Responsable de P&C Energy & Commodity Management Chile (o  delegado), envía un correo electrónico al responsable de P&C EGPTGX Chile o delegado para cargar el respectivo KPI en NEW PRIMO.

In case of negative results, missing information, the Responsible of P&C Energy & Commodity Management Chile, or delegate, requests via email to the Margin Contribution Management Chile to provide the missing / incomplete information.			 In case of positive results,  there are no discrepancies, the Responsible of P&C Energy & Commodity Management Chile, or delegate, sends an email to the Responsible of  P&C EGPTGX Chile or delegate to load the respective KPI in NEW PRIMO

cells.S: Após a inclusão automática no sistema New Primo referentes aos dados relativos ao KPI GN15 "Capacidade de Geração Líquida MW", e após a inclusão manual dos dados relativos ao GN02 "Capacidade Adicional MW" e do EM19 "Produção Líquida de Eletricidade Alimentada na rede GWh" no sistema, o Responsável de P&C Brasil (ou seu delegado) verifica a integridade e exatidão dos dados incluídos através de uma consulta no sistema por meio do arquivo de uma query em excel. Em caso de resultado negativo (havendo divergência), a carga deverá ser refeita no sistema New Primo, e posteriormente conferida novamente pelo Responsável P&C Brasil (ou seu delegado) até a correta representação dos dados no sistema.Em casos de resultado positivo (Não havendo mais discrepâncias),  com base na documentação comprobatória recebida pela Área de Negócios, o Responsável P&C Brasil (ou seu delegado) comunica a equipe interna de P&C EC&M Brazil por e-mail que a carga está finalizada corretamente no sistema.
cells.T: After the automatic inclusion in New Primo system related to the data related to the KPI GN15 "Net generation capacity MW" and after the manual inclusion of the data related to the KPI GN02 "Additional Capacity MW" and the EM19 "Net Electricity Production fed into the grid GWh" in the system, the P&C Brazil Responsible (or the delegated person) verifies the completeness and correctness of the data included by consulting the system using an Excel query file.In case of negative result (if there is a discrepancy), the upload must be redone in the New Primo system and then checked again by the P&C Brazil Responsible (or the delegated person) until the data is correctly represented in the system.In case of positive result (if there are no more discrepancies), based on the supporting documentation received by the Business Unit, the P&C Brazil Responsible (or the delegated person) notifies the internal P&C EC&M Brazil team by email that the upload has been correctly completed in the system.

cells.AF: 1) Em caso de resultado negativo, evidência do arquivo de query com a diferença detectada;2) Em caso de resultado positivo, e-mail enviado pelo Responsável de P&C Brasil (ou seu delegado) à equipe interna de P&C EC&M Brazil para comunicar o upload correto e completo, através de um print da query com a carga efetuada.
cells.AG: 1) In case of a negative result, evidence of the query file with the difference detected;2) In case of a positive result, email sent by the P&C Brazil Manager (or his/her delegate) to the internal P&C EC&M Brazil team to communicate the correct and complete upload, through a print of the query with the load made.

cells.S: O Responsável de P&C Planning & Reporting Grids Brazil (ou seu delegado), após a inclusão automática no NEW PRIMO dos dados relativos ao KPI:- KPI_DI08 - Eletricidade Distribuída GWh;- KPI_DI31 - Km de alta tensão de distribuição de rede;- KPI_DI32 - Km de Média Tensão de Distribuição de Rede;- KPI_DI33 - Km de baixa tensão de distribuição de rede;- KPI_DI40 - Clientes ativos com medidores inteligentes;- KPI_DI24 - Final Number of Electricity Distribution Customers.- KPI_DI54 - Electricity Distribution Losses (%) YTD.verifica a integridade e exatidão dos dados incluídos.Em caso de resultado negativo (em caso de desalinhamento), o Responsável de P&C Planning & Reporting Grids Brazil (ou seu delegado) solicita os respectivos esclarecimentos e a realização das devidas correções à Área de Negócios responsável pelos dados incorretos / incompletos que realiza as correções adequadas no Sistema C3, automaticamente conectado ao New PRIMO.Em caso de resultado positivo (não há discrepâncias, ou após ter corrigido as eventuais inconsistências no NEW PRIMO, com base na documentação comprobatória recebida pela área de negócios), o Responsável de P&C Planning & Reporting Grids Brazil (ou seu delegado) comunica o resultado da verificação via e-mail para o Responsável P&C Global Grids.
cells.T: The P&C Planning & Reporting Grids Brazil Responsible, or delegate, after the automatic inclusion in New P.R.I.MO. of the data related to the KPIs: - KPI_DI08 - Electricity Distribution GWh;- KPI_DI31 - Network Distribution High Voltage Km; - KPI_DI32 - Network Distribution Medium Voltage Km;- KPI_DI33 - Network Distribution Low Voltage Km;- KPI_DI40 - Active Customers with Smart Meters;- KPI_DI24 - Final Number of Electricity Distribution Customers.- KPI_DI54 - Electricity Distribution Losses (%) YTD.verifies the completeness and correctness of the data included.In case of negative result (in case of misalignment), the P&C Planning & Reporting Grids Brazil Responsible, or delegate, requests the respective clarifications and the implementation of the necessary corrections to the Business Area responsible for the incorrect/incomplete data, which makes the appropriate corrections in the C3 System, automatically connected to New PRIMO.In case of positive result (there are no discrepancies, or after having corrected any inconsistencies in NEW PRIMO, based on the supporting documentation received by the business area), the P&C Planning & Reporting Grids Brazil Responsible, or delegate, communicates the result of the verification via email to the P&C Global Grids Responsible.
cells.AB: Claudia Salerno;BERNARDO BAERE LOMBA DE ARAUJO SANTOS;
cells.AF: 1) Na negativa, e-mail enviado pelo Responsável de P&C Planning & Reporting Grids Brazil (ou seu delegado) à área de negócios, solicitando esclarecimentos e feedback.2) Em caso positivo, e-mail enviado pelo Responsável de P&C Planning & Reporting Grids Brazil (ou seu delegado) ao Responsável P&C Global Grids, para comunicar o upload correto e completo.
cells.AG: 1) In case of negative result, e-mail sent by P&C Planning & Reporting Grids Brazil Responsible, or delegate, to the business area, requesting clarifications and feedback.2) In case of positive result, e-mail sent by the P&C Planning & Reporting Grids Brazil Responsible, or delegate, to P&C Global Grids Responsible, to communicate the correct and complete upload.

cells.S: Se muestra en EDEN la hoja llenada por el Responsable del Sitio de Chile respecto a datos relacionados con:- Pérdidas de SF6 por actividades de generación- consumo de combustibles fósiles relacionado con la producción de energía termoeléctricautilizado dentro del cálculo de las siguientes métricas:  i) Emisiones directas totales (SCOPE 1), ii) Otras emisiones de CO2eq debido a la producción de electricidad y otras actividades iii) Emisiones específicas de CO₂eq de SCOPE 1;y consumo de electricidad adquirida de la red para la producción en centrales termoeléctricas utilizada en el cálculo de las siguientes métricas:i) SCOPE 2, basado en el mercado - Emisiones indirectas totales ii) SCOPE 2, basado en la ubicación - Emisiones indirectas totales,El Responsable de Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile), o su delegado, realiza:i) una verificación de integridad, verificando que todos los responsables del sitio del país Chile hayan cargado los datos en el sistema EDEN.ii) una verificación de razonabilidad en comparación con el valor  del trimestre anterior, investigando cualquier desviación en el valor absoluto superior al umbral del 20%.En caso de resultado negativo de la verificación, el Responsable de Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile), o delegado, procede a devolver la hoja al nivel anterior notificando, mediante un comentario en el sistema y/o enviando un correo electrónico, al Responsable del ingreso de datos una solicitud de aclaración/integración de los datos registrados, modificando los valores anómalos encontrados. En caso de resultado positivo de la verificación, el Responsable de Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile), o delegado, valida la hoja a través del estado de aprobación "validado a nivel País": EDEN devuelve un mensaje al aprobador respecto a la responsabilidad relacionada con el proceso de validación y a partir de este momento la hoja ya no podrá ser modificada, quedando visible para el Responsable de Global Business Line Environment Unit (HSEQ EGP and Thermal Generation) o delegado
cells.T: Displayed on EDEN the sheet filled in by the Site Responsible of Chile regarding data related to:- SF6 losses due to generation activities- fossil fuel consumption related to thermoelectric energy productionused within the calculation of the following metrics:  i) Total direct emissions (SCOPE 1), ii) Other CO2eq emissions due to electricity production and other activities iii) Specific CO₂eq emissions from SCOPE 1;and Purchased electricity consumption from the grid for production into thermoelectric plants used within the calculation of the following metrics:i) SCOPE 2, market based - Total indirect emissions ii) SCOPE 2, location based - Total indirect emissions, The Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) Responsible, or  delegate, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that all Country Chile Site Responsible have uploaded the data into the EDEN system.ii) a reasonableness check compared to the previous quarter value, investigating any deviations in absolute value higher than the 20% threshold.In case of negative result, the Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile), or delegate, proceeds to send back the sheet to the previous level notifying, through a comment in the system and/or sending an e-mail, to the data entry Responsible a request for clarification / integration of the recorded data, modifying any anomalous values found. cells.S: Annualmente, il Responsabile dell' Unità Fabbisogno Risorse dell'Area Operativa Sicilia (SIC-PGE-FRI - FABBISOGNO RISORSE) o un suo Delegato senza conflitti SOD estrae da sistema i documenti di rettifica inventariale registrati dalla propria unità e verifica la coerenza delle differenze (positive/negative) generate dall’inserimento dei conteggi di ogni materiale, rilevato presso il magazzino di II° livello oggetto di inventario.Qualora dal controllo emergano incongruenze, il Responsabile dell' Unità Fabbisogno Risorse dell'Area Operativa Sicilia (SIC-PGE-FRI - FABBISOGNO RISORSE)) o un suo Delegato senza conflitti SOD richiede la correzione direttamente nel sistema “SAP DIP 010” oppure l’esecuzione di un nuovo inventario “ad evento” per riallineare le differenze contabili, oggetto dell’errore. Diversamente, in assenza di incongruenze, produrrà un verbale/documento in formato elettronico (riportante i riferimenti dei movimenti di rettifica inventariale analizzati con esito positivo) che verrà firmato tramite ME-SIGN e successivamente archiviato.
cells.T: Annually, the Manager of the "Unità Fabbisogno Risorse dell'Area Operativa Sicilia (SIC-PGE-FRI - FABBISOGNO RISORSE) " or his/her Delegate without SOD conflicts extracts from the system the inventory adjustment documents registered by his unit and verifies the consistency of the differences (positive/negative) generated by the insertion of the counts of each material, detected at the second warehouse level under inventory.If there is any inconsistency, the Manager of the "Unità Fabbisogno Risorse dell'Area Operativa Sicilia (SIC-PGE-FRI - FABBISOGNO RISORSE)" or his/her Delegate without SOD conflicts requests the correction directly in the "SAP DIP 010" system or execution of a new "event" inventory to realign the accounting differences, the subject of the error.Otherwise, in the absence of inconsistencies, he/she will produce a report/document in electronic format (containing the references of the successfully analysed inventory adjustment movements) which will be signed via ME-SIGN and subsequently archived.

cells.S: El Responsable de la unidad de Network Maintenance, Studies & Analysis, o su delegado, obtiene los datos recopilados sobre la adquisición de combustibles relacionados con combustión de combustibles fósiles en motores auxiliares (equipos electrógenos propios) para actividades de distribución de energía utilizados dentro del cálculo de las siguientes métricas: i) Emisiones directas totales (SCOPE 1), ii) Otras emisiones de CO2eq debidas a la producción de electricidad y otras actividades iii) Emisiones específicas de CO₂eq de SCOPE 1, y realiza:1)  Una verificación de razonabilidad contra la cantidad de combustible consumido por equipo y las horas de utilización del mismo, evaluando cualquier desviación.2)  Una verificación de congruencia, comparando los datos estimados de los pedidos con los datos de la compra de combustible fósil para los motores auxiliares.En caso de resultado negativo de la verificación, el Responsable de Network Maintenance, Studies & Analysis, o delegado, procede a contactar a la empresa contratista que realiza el mantenimiento de los equipos electrógenos para obtener aclaraciones sobre los datos obtenidos. En caso de resultado positivo de la verificación, el Responsable de Network Maintenance, Studies & Analysis, o delegado, procede a extraer un archivo Excel que contiene el total de los pedidos realizados y lo envía a la unidad de Medio Ambiente (Enel Grids Argentina - HSE Argentina).
cells.T: Collected data about  the acquisition of fuels regarding data related to combustion of fossil fuels in auxiliary engines (own generator equipment) for energy distribution activities used within the calculation of the following metrics: i) Total direct emissions (SCOPE 1), ii) Other CO2eq emissions due to electricity production and other activities,iii) Specific CO₂eq emissions from SCOPE 1,the Responsible of Network Maintenance, Studies & Analysis, or delegate, carries out:1) a reasonableness check against the amount of fuel consumed by equipment and the hours of use of the same, evaluating any deviations. 2) a congruence check, comparing the data of the order estimates with the data of the purchase of fossil fuel for the auxiliary engines.In case of negative result, the Responsible of Network Maintenance, Studies & Analysis, or delegate, proceed to contact the contractor company that performs the maintenance of the generator equipment to get clarifications on the data obtained. cells.S: Após o encerramento da competência de faturamento, o Assistente de Energy Contracts Management Brazil verifica o recebimento, via e-mail, das notas fiscais (DANFE - Documento Fiscal, ou uma fatura ou uma nota de débito), encaminhadas pelo Gerador de Energia e compara com as informações da planilha Sistema de Gestão de Faturas e com as informações contratuais no WBC, a fim de garantir o correto pagamento e registro contábil da compra de energia.Em caso de resultado negativo (com erros), o Assistente de Energy Contracts Management Brazil (Regulated Customer Operations - Energy Balance and Supply) procede conforme segue:(i) Caso o Gerador de Energia não tenha encaminhado a fatura de compra de energia, solicita o envio ao Gerador de Energia, via e-mail, a fatura de compra de energia. (ii) Caso o Gerador de Energia tenha encaminhado a fatura de compra de energia com erro nas informações, solicita ao Gerador de Energia, via e-mail, os devidos ajustes.Em caso de resultado positivo (sem erros), o Assistente de Energy Contracts Management Brazil efetua o lançamento da fatura no WBC através do carregamento do arquivo e/ou por lançamento via FCP no SAP RP1.
cells.T: After the billing period closes, the Energy Contracts Management Brazil Assistant verifies the receipt, via email, of the invoices (DANFE - Fiscal Document, or an invoice or a debit note) forwarded by the Energy Generator and compares them with the information in the "Invoice Management System" spreadsheet and with the contractual information in WBC, in order to ensure the correct payment and accounting record of the energy purchase.If the result is negative (with errors), the Energy Contracts Management Brazil Assistant proceeds as follows: (i) If the Energy Generator has not forwarded the energy purchase invoice, requests the Energy Generator, via email, to send the energy purchase invoice. (ii) If the Energy Generator has forwarded the energy purchase invoice with incorrect information, requests the Energy Generator, via email, to make the necessary adjustments.If the result is positive (without errors), the Energy Contracts Management Brazil Assistant posts the invoice in WBC through file upload and/or by posting via FCP in SAP RP1.

cells.S: Após o encerramento da competência do faturamento, antes de fazer o lançamento no sistema SAP RP1 - FI o Assistente de Energy Contracts Management  compara as informações que compõem a fatura de compra de energia versus as informações contidas na planilha Sistema de Gestão de Faturas e no relatório "mapa financeiro" do sistema WBC a fim de garantir o correto pagamento e registro contábil de compra de energia. As principais informações analisadas são: montante, tarifa, valor a pagar, parcelas, datas de vencimento e CNPJ do vendedor. Em caso de resultado negativo (alguma informação inconsistente), o Assistente Energy Contracts Management  solicita, via e-mail, a correção ou refaturamento para o gerador. Em caso de resultado positivo (informações de acordo), o Assistente de Energy Contracts Management  gera o ABAP arquivo de carga massiva na planilha Sistema de Gestão de Faturas, para upload no SAP RP1 - FI e gera os lançamentos no mapa financeiro no sistema WBC.
cells.T: After the billing period ends, before posting in SAP RP1 - FI system, the Energy Contracts Management Assistant compares the information on the energy purchase invoice with the information in the Invoice Management System spreadsheet and the "financial map" report in the WBC system to ensure correct payment and accounting registration of the energy purchase. If the result is negative (any inconsistent information), the Energy Contracts Management Assistant requests, via email, correction or re-invoice from the generator. If the result is positive (information matches), the Energy Contracts Management Assistant generates the ABAP mass load file in the Invoice Management System spreadsheet to upload it in SAP RP1 - FI and generates the entries in the financial map in the WBC system.

cells.S: Após o encerramento da competência do faturamento, o Assistente de Energy Contracts Management  verifica, por meio do relatório de ressarcimento/ajuste (Receita de Venda XXX_RV00x _ENEL SP_MêsAA) extraído do site da CCEE, se existe algum valor a ser creditado do gerador resultante do montante de energia elétrica não gerado conforme regra de despacho do O.N.S (Operador Nacional do Sistema) em referência ao valor da Nota fiscal recebida pelo gerador a fim de garantir a correta contabilização dos valores a serem pagos pela compra de energia. Em caso de resultado negativo (sem ressarcimento/ajuste), o Assistente de Energy Contracts Management  encaminha a relação das FCPs devidamente aprovadas para pagamento via abertura de OIP. Em caso de resultado positivo (ocorrência de ressarcimento/ajuste), o Assistente de Energy Contracts Management efetua lançamento complementar de ressarcimento/ajuste no SAP RP1 - FI e solicita para o Analista de Impostos Indiretos, via e-mail, a emissão de uma Nota de Ressarcimento com a principais informações i) nome do gerador, ii) número do FCP e iii) fatura de compra de energia.
cells.T: After the billing period ends, the Energy Contracts Management Assistant verifies, using the reimbursement/adjustment report (Sales Revenue XXX_RV00x _ENEL SP_MonthYY) extracted from the CCEE website, whether there is any amount to be credited to the generator resulting from the amount of electricity not generated according to the dispatch rule of the ONS (National System Operator) in reference to the value of the invoice received by the generator, in order to ensure the correct accounting of the amounts to be paid for the purchase of energy. In case of a negative result (no reimbursement/adjustment), the Energy Contracts Management Assistant forwards the list of duly approved FCPs for payment via the opening of an OIP. In case of a positive result (reimbursement/adjustment occurrence), the Energy Contracts Management Assistant makes a supplementary reimbursement/adjustment entry in SAP RP1 - FI and requests the Indirect Tax Analyst, via email, to issue a Reimbursement Note with the main information i) generator name, ii) FCP number and iii) energy purchase invoice.

cells.S: Mensalmente, o Especialista de P&C Energy&Commodity Management Brazil, após receber o e-mail da área de Commercialization and Trading Brazil com a planilha "INPUT CDSA M_MÊS.xls" que contém as provisões já contabilizadas de venda e compra de energia, preenche as informações na planilha “MC_CDSA_MMAAAA.xls” para calcular o valor da margem de energia.Em seguida, o Especialista de P&C Energy&Commodity Management Brazil compara o valor da margem de energia com a margem mensal determinada no Budget do ano e verifica quais foram as variações de premissas do Budget versus o Realizado.Em caso de resultado negativo (com divergências), o Especialista de P&C Energy&Commodity Management Brazil envia um e-mail ao Analista de Commercialization and Trading Brazil e ao Analista de Business accounting para solicitar explicações, e em seguida refaz a apuração da contabilização da margem até que o resultado esteja de acordo.Em caso de resultado positivo (sem divergências), o Especialista de P&C Energy&Commodity Management Brazil envia um e-mail ao Responsável de Business accounting informando que a margem está validada, bem como preenche o relatório "E-Report Comments" com os comentários explicativos dos desvios entre o Realizado e o Budget acumulado até o mês corrente e efetua o upload no site "https://e-report.enel.com".
cells.T: Monthly, the P&C Energy&Commodity Management Brazil Specialist, after receiving an email from the Commercialization and Trading Brazil unit with the spreadsheet "INPUT CDSA M_MONTH.xls" containing the provisions already accounted for energy sales and purchases, fills in the information in the spreadsheet “MC_CDSA_MMYYYY.xls” to calculate the value of the energy margin.Then, the P&C Energy&Commodity Management Brazil Specialist compares the value of the energy margin with the monthly margin determined in the Budget for the year and checks what the variations in the Budget assumptions were versus the Actual one.In case of a negative result (with discrepancies), the P&C Energy&Commodity Management Brazil Specialist sends an email to the Commercialization and Trading Brazil Analyst and the Business Accounting Analyst to request explanations, and then redoes the calculation of the margin accounting until the result is consistent.In case of a positive result (no discrepancies), the P&C Energy&Commodity Management Brazil Specialist sends an email to the Business Accounting Manager informing that the margin has been validated, as well as filling out the "E-Report Comments" report with explanatory comments on the deviations between the Actual and the Budget accumulated up to the current month and uploading it to the website "https://e-report.enel.com".

cells.S: Mensalmente, o Analista de Indirect Tax Regional RJ/CE extrai do Sistema COMPLY a planilha “Livro de entrada mês aaaa.xls”, com as informações das notas fiscais registradas pela compra de Energia (Nome do fornecedor, Número de nota fiscal, Código fiscal da operação, Data de emissão, Valor nota fiscal) e verifica se as informações cadastradas no sistema COMPLY estão de acordo com as regras fiscais.Caso não identifique erros, o Analista de Indirect Tax Regional RJ/CE envia por e-mail, ao final da apuração, o arquivo “Livro de entrada mês aaaa.xls” para o Responsável Indirect Tax Regional RJ/CE solicitando aprovação.Caso identifique erros, o Analista de Indirect Tax Regional RJ/CE indica na planilha “Livro de entrada mês aaaa.xls” as notas fiscais a serem corrigidas, realiza as mudanças diretamente no Sistema COMPLY em seguida envia por e-mail ao Responsável de Indirect Tax Regional RJ/CE a planilha “Livro de entrada mês aaaa.xls” corrigida.
cells.T: Monthly, the RJ/CE Regional Indirect Tax Analyst extracts from the COMPLY System the spreadsheet "Entry book month yyyy.xls", with the information of the invoices registered by the purchase of Energy (Supplier's name, Invoice number, Operation tax code, Issue date, Invoice amount) and verifies if the information registered in the COMPLY system is in accordance with the tax rules.In case of positive result (If no errors are found), the RJ/CE Regional Indirect Tax Analyst sends by e-mail, at the end of the verification, the file "Entry book month yyyy.xls" to the RJ/CE Regional Indirect Tax Responsible, requesting approval.In case of negative result (If errors are identified), the RJ/CE Regional Indirect Tax Analyst indicates on the spreadsheet "Entry book month yyyy.xls" the invoices to be corrected, makes the updates directly in the COMPLY system and then sends the corrected "Entry book month yyyy.xls" spreadsheet by e-mail to the RJ/CE Regional Indirect Tax Manager.

cells.S: Após a criação do contrato no sistema WBC, o Analista de Energy Contracts Management valida os dados contratuais registrados no sistema WBC comparando com as informações contidas no contrato de CCEAR, disponível no sharepoint da equipe.Em caso de resultado negativo (Caso identifique alguma inconsistência), o Analista de Energy Contracts Management não valida o registro do contrato no sistema WBC e envia um e-mail para o Assistente de  Energy Contracts Management solicitando a correção no sistema WBC. Em caso de resultado positivo (Caso não identifique erro), o Analista de Energy Contracts Management valida o registro e publica o contrato no sistema WBC.
cells.T: After creating the contract in the WBC system, the Energy Contracts Management Analyst validates the contractual data registered in the WBC system by comparing it with the information contained in the CCEAR contract, digitally available. In case of negative result (if any inconsistency is identified), the Energy Contracts Management Analyst does not validate the contract registration in the WBC system and sends an email to the Energy Contracts Management Assistant requesting correction in the WBC system. In case of postive result (if no error is identified), the Energy Contracts Management Analyst validates the registration and publishes the contract in the WBC system.

cells.S: A cada nova competência de faturamento, o especialista de de Energy Contracts Management de valida as informações faturadas referentes ao contrato de compra de energia por quantidade (CCEAR-Q) comparando o preço, o valor e o montante que constam na fatura com o contrato registrado no sistema WBC. Em caso de resultado positivo (as informações faturadas conforme contrato registrado no WBC), o especialista de Energy Contracts Management aprova o registro da fatura no sistema WBC, (através do botão "Enviar ERP") e os dados da fatura são automaticamente transferidos para o SAP E4E D4P - MM. Em caso de resultado negativo (as informações faturadas divergentes do contrato registrado no WBC), o especialista de Energy Contracts Management envia um e-mail para o Assistente de Energy Contracts Management corrigir as informações no sistema WBC ou contatar o fornecedor por e-mail solicitando as devidas correções no  faturamento.
cells.T: At each new billing period, the specialist of Energy Contracts Management validates the invoiced information related to the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) for quantity comparing the price, value, and amount shown on the invoice with the contract registered in the WBC system. If the result is positive (the invoiced information matches the contract registered in the WBC), the Energy Contracts Management specialist approves the invoice registration in the WBC system (via the "Send ERP" button), and the invoice data is automatically transferred to SAP E4E D4P - MM. In case of a negative result (invoiced information differing from the contract registered in the WBC), the Specialist of Energy Contracts Management sends an e-mail to the Energy Contracts Management Assistant to correct the information in the WBC system or to contact the supplier by e-mail requesting the necessary corrections in the invoice.

Em caso de resultado positivo, o especialista de Energy Contracts Management de aprova o registro da fatura no sistema WBC (através do botão "Enviar ERP") e os dados da fatura são automaticamente transferidos para SAP E4E D4P - MM. cells.T: For each new billing period for power purchase agreements (PPAs) based on availability, the Energy Contracts Management specialist validates the invoiced information against the "Preliminary Availability PPA Sales Revenue Report" and the "Final Availability PPA Sales Revenue Report" published by CCEE. If the result is positive, the specialist of Energy Contracts Management approves the invoice registration in the WBC system (via the "Send ERP" button) and the invoice data is automatically transferred to SAP E4E D4P - MM. If the result is negative, the Energy Contracts Management specialist sends an email to the Energy Contracts Management Assistant requesting the correction of the information in the WBC system or contacts the supplier by email requesting the correction of the billing.

cells.S: Mensalmente, após o registro do documento de pagamento no sistema WBC pelo Assistente de Energy Contracts Management, o Head de Energy Contracts Management revisa se as mesmas informações constam no documento de pagamento de encargo setorial (no SAP E4E D4P - FI) com base na Resolução da ANEEL ou relatório emitido pela CCEE (Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica). cells.T: Monthly, after the payment document is registered in the WBC system by the Energy Contracts Management Assistant, the Head of Energy Contracts Management reviews whether the same information is present in the sector charge payment document (in SAP E4E D4P - FI) based on the ANEEL Resolution or a report issued by CCEE (Chamber of Electric Energy Commercialization). In case of negative result (any errors are identified), the Head of Energy Contracts Management requests, via email, the necessary correction in the SAP E4E D4P - FI and WBC systems.

cells.S: Mensalmente, o Head de RTR MEC realiza a verificação de que os custos de energia estão devidamente registrados nas contas contábeis correspondentes. Para isso, compara-se os valores da aba “Conciliação Patrimonial e Resultado”, obtidos por meio da extração do SAP Analysis – Operational Reporting (OR) e pela geração do balancete via transação ZFI4D_BR_ZC29 do SAP E4E D4P – GL, com os valores da aba “CVA Resumo”, que consolida os saldos de energia elétrica. Ambas as abas fazem parte da planilha “Enel DX_EMPRESA - Fechamento de Compra de Energia e CVA mm.aa.xls”.Em caso de resultado negativo (caso a análise identifique divergências), o Head de RTR MEC envia um e-mail ao Especialista de RTR MEC solicitando os ajustes necessários.Em caso de resultado positivo (Se não houver divergências), o Head de RTR MEC encaminha ao Especialista de RTR MEC um e-mail contendo o arquivo “Enel DX_EMPRESA - Fechamento de Compra de Energia e CVA mm.aa.xls”, comunicando o resultado e confirmando as variações do saldo do mês.
cells.T: Monthly, the Head of RTR MEC verifies that energy costs are properly recorded in the corresponding accounting accounts. To do this, the values ​​in the "Equity and Results Reconciliation" tab, obtained through extraction from SAP Analysis – Operational Reporting (OR) and generating the trial balance via transaction ZFI4D_BR_ZC29 of SAP E4E D4P – GL, are compared with the values ​​in the "CVA Summary " tab, which consolidates the electricity balances. Both tabs are part of the spreadsheet "Enel DX_COMPANY - Energy Purchase Closing and CVA mm.aa.xls".In case of a negative result (if the analysis identifies discrepancies), the Head of RTR MEC sends an email to the Specialist of RTR MEC  requesting the necessary adjustments.In case of a positive result (if there are no discrepancies), the Head of RTR MEC forwards an email to the Specialist of RTR MEC containing the file “Enel DX_COMPANY - Energy Purchase Closing and CVA mm.aa.xls”, communicating the result and confirming the variations in the month's balance.

cells.S: Mensalmente, o Chefe de Industrial P&C Enel Grids Brazil - Regulation and Margin Control recebe por e-mail do Analista o documento "MM_Company_Explicações Margem_AAAA", que é um resumo executivo, contendo explicações das variações das receitas e custos da margem de energia em relação ao orçamento e ano anterior e verifica se as explicações das variações de receitas e custos são consistentes.Em caso de resultado negativo, o Chefe de Industrial P&C Enel Grids Brazil - Regulation and Margin Control envia um e-mail ao responsável da unidade competente solicitando informações adicionais.Em caso de resultado positivo, o Chefe de Industrial P&C Enel Grids Brazil - Regulation and Margin Control solicita ao Analista que insira o arquivo “MM_Company_Explicações Margem_AAAA” na pasta compartilhada global de P&C e carrega as explicações no sistema Collaboration Tool. cells.T: Monthly, the Head of Industrial P&C Enel Grids Brazil - Regulation and Margin Control receives by e-mail from the Analyst the document "MM_Company_Margin Explanations_YYYY", which is an executive summary, containing explanations of the variations in the revenue and costs of the energy margin in relation to the budget and previous year and verifies if the explanations for variations in revenues and costs are consistent. In case of negative result, the Head of Industrial P&C Enel Grids Brazil - Regulation and Margin Control sends an email to the responsible of competent unit requesting additional information. In case of positive result, the Head of Industrial P&C Enel Grids Brazil - Regulation and Margin Control requests to the Analyst to insert the file “MM_Company_Margin Explanations_YYYY” in the global P&C shared folder and loads the explanations into the Collaboration Tool system. Once loaded, the Analyst send an email to the Head of Industrial P&C Enel Grids Brazil - Regulation and Margin Control of confirming the upload of the file.

cells.S: Mensalmente, o Especialista de RTR MEC Brazil extrai do SAP E4E D4P - GL, por meio da transação FBL3N, a relação de todas as MIGO’s registradas no mês e verifica se todas estão refletidas na planilha de fechamento mensal “Check Custo Empresa_mmmaa_envio.xls”, utilizada para validar o cálculo da despesa mensal com base no suporte “Enel DX_EMPRESA - Fechamento de Compra de Energia e CVA mm.aa.xls”, enviado por e-mail pelo Analista de Regulação Econômica Brazil.Em caso de resultado positivo (ausência de inconsistências), o Especialista de RTR MEC Brazil armazena digitalmente a planilha de fechamento mensal “Check Custo Empresa_mmmaa_envio.xls” e envia o resultado da validação ao Head de RTR MEC Brazil para aprovação.Em caso de resultado negativo (identificação de inconsistências):Caso sejam identificadas divergências superiores a R$ 4,5MM, o Especialista de RTR MEC Brazil solicita ao Analista de Regulação Econômica Brazil, por e-mail, o reenvio do controle de fechamento mensal “Enel DX_EMPRESA - Fechamento de Compra de Energia e CVA mm.aa.xls”, atualizado considerando as faturas ingressadas após a data de corte. Após o recebimento do arquivo atualizado, o Especialista de RTR MEC Brazil envia e-mail ao Head de RTR MEC Brazil informando a divergência identificada e o reprocessamento realizado.Caso sejam identificadas divergências inferiores a R$ 4,5MM, o Especialista de RTR MEC Brazil registra a diferença como item não coberto na sheet de check de cobertura do suporte “Enel DX_EMPRESA - Fechamento de Compra de Energia e CVA mm.aa.xls”, armazena digitalmente a planilha de fechamento mensal “Check Custo Empresa_mmmaa_envio.xls” e envia e-mail ao Head de RTR MEC Brazil para aprovação da exceção.
cells.T: Monthly, the Specialist of RTR MEC Brazil extracts from SAP E4E D4P - GL, through transaction FBL3N, the list of all MIGO entries recorded during the month and verifies whether all of them are reflected in the monthly closing spreadsheet “Check Custo Empresa_mmmaa_envio.xls”, which is used to validate the calculation of the monthly expense based on the supporting file “Enel DX_EMPRESA - Fechamento de Compra de Energia e CVA mm.aa.xls”, sent by email by the Analyst of Economic Regulation Brazil.In case of a positive result (absence of inconsistencies), the Specialist of RTR MEC Brazil digitally stores the monthly closing spreadsheet “Check Custo Empresa_mmmaa_envio.xls” and sends the validation result to the Head of RTR MEC Brazil for approval.In case of a negative result (identification of inconsistencies):- if discrepancies greater than BRL 4.5 million are identified, the Specialist of RTR MEC Brazil requests, by email, to the Analyst of Economic Regulation Brazil to resubmit the monthly closing control “Enel DX_EMPRESA - Fechamento de Compra de Energia e CVA mm.aa.xls” updated, considering invoices recorded after the cut-off date. After receiving the updated file, the Specialist of RTR MEC Brazil sends an email to the Head of RTR MEC Brazil informing about the identified discrepancy and the reprocessing performed.- if discrepancies lower than BRL 4.5 million are identified, the Specialist of RTR MEC Brazil records the difference as an uncovered item in the coverage check sheet of the supporting file “Enel DX_EMPRESA - Fechamento de Compra de Energia e CVA mm.aa.xls”, digitally stores the monthly closing spreadsheet “Check Custo Empresa_mmmaa_envio.xls”, and sends an email to the Head of RTR MEC Brazil requesting approval of the exception.
