cells.S: Sob demanda, o RTR - Especialista de Ativo Fixo Brasil recebe e-mail do RTR - Analista de Ativo Fixo Brasil os documentos pré-editados, realiza as verificações através dos relatórios "Constituição de PPA_Intangible.xls" e extrai os relatórios através das transações: "ZILA", contendo relatório do Ativo Imobilizado / "CJI3" - contendo itens de linha do projeto / FAGLB03 - contendo saldo do G/L, extraído do SAP E4E (R4 P) - AA/GL, com o objetivo de conciliar contas: PPA zerado / Ativo no atual zerado / SPE zerado / tudo o que estava na Holding foi corretamente transferido para a SPE e se os saldos estão presentes na SPE de acordo com os parâmetros definidos (valor do PPA, rateio de valores e elementos contábeis, centros de custo utilizados, contas etc.). Em caso de resultados negativos, (Caso sejam encontradas  divergências), o RTR - Especialista de Ativo Fixo Brasil envia e-mail para o RTR - Analista de Ativo Fixo Brasil para realizar as correções. Em caso de resultados positivos, (Caso não sejam encontradas  divergências), os documentos comprobatórios são arquivados digitalmente.
cells.T: On demand, the RTR - Fixed Asset Specialist Brazil receives e-mail from the RTR - Fixed Asset Analyst Brazil the pre-edited documents, performs the checks through the reports "Constitution of PPA_Intangible.xls" and extracts the reports through the transactions: "ZILA", containing report of the Fixed Asset / "CJI3" - containing project line items / FAGLB03 - containing balance of the G/L, extracted from SAP E4E (R4P) - AA/GL, in order to reconcile accounts: PPA zeroed / Active in current zeroed / SPE zeroed / everything that was in the Holding was correctly transferred to The SPE and if the balances are present in the SPE according to the defined parameters (PPA value, apportionment of values and accounting elements, used cost centers, accounts etc.). In case of negative results, (If differences are found), the RTR - Fixed Asset Specialist Brazil sends e-mail to the RTR - Fixed Asset Analyst Brazil to perform the corrections.In case of positive results, (if no divergence is identified), the supporting documents are digitally archived.

cells.S: Com base no e-mail enviado pelo Analista de BPO, contendo as telas do SAP e o "relatório FAGLB03", o RTR - Head de Ativo Fixo Brasil valida a contabilidade PPA com base na "Planilha de Amortização" elaborada pelo RTR - Analista de Ativo Fixo Brasil - com base em sua análise sobre o valor bruto e o valor de resgate dos ativos e realiza as análises sobre os seguintes tópicos:- Definição correta do valor bruto de PPA extraído do SAP, com base no relatório "Razão", extraído do sistema SAP E4E (R4P) - BR/FI, através da transação FB01L;- A taxa de depreciação é correta calculada com base no valor bruto do PPA e período de concessão.Em caso de resultados negativos, (Caso sejam encontradas  diferenças), o RTR - Head de Ativo Fixo Brasil envia e-mail para o Analista de BPO para realizar os ajustes apropriados. Em caso de resultados positivos, (Caso não sejam encontradas  diferenças), o RTR - Head de Ativo Fixo Brasil envia um e-mail para o RTR - Analista de Ativo Fixo Brasil com a validação, com cópia para o Analista BPO, que finaliza a solicitação no Portal OIP.
cells.T: Based on the e-mail sent by the BPO Analyst, containing the SAP printscreens and the “report FAGLB03”, the RTR - Head of Fixed Asset validates the PPA accounting based in the “Amortization worksheet” elaborated by the RTR - Analyst of Fixed Asset based on theirs analysis on the gross value and the redemption value of the assets, and performs the analyses over the following topics:- Correct definition of the gross amount of PPA extracted from SAP, based on the “Razao” report, extracted from the system SAP E4E (R4P) BR - FI, through transaction FB01L;- Depreciation rate is correct calculated based on the gross amount of PPA and period of concessionIn case of negative results (if the Head of RTR - Fixed Asset identifies divergences), sends and email to BPO Analyst to perform appropriate adjustments.In case of positive results (if the Head of RTR - Fixed Asset does not identify divergences), sends an e-mail to the Analyst of RTR - Fixed Asset, with copy to BPO Analyst, who finalizes the request in the Portal OIP.

cells.S: Uma vez assinado o Memorando de Entendimento, mediante solicitação por e-mail do Analista de BD Control & Portfolio Management Brazil, o Especialista em Legal Affairs O&M PG & Energy & Com Man BR realiza a Due Diligence de questões fundiárias, com base na documentação disponível por agentes externos (cartório, órgãos públicos e fórum de justiça, contendo registros imobiliários dos imóveis) para saber se há algum problema que possa impactar o imóvel (como uma hipoteca, por exemplo), ou se houver ações judiciais envolvendo o imóvel e o proprietário do imóvel. Além disso, são avaliados os seguintes itens:_x000D_- a situação dos imóveis envolvidos no projeto,_x000D_- consistência no registro do imóvel,_x000D_- situação jurídica dos proprietários do imóvel,_x000D_- existência de dívidas, _x000D__x000D_a fim de verificar se o projeto é viável em termos econômicos e de reputação. _x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultados negativos, (Caso seja identificado um risco ou inconsistência no Due-Diligence), o Especialista em Legal Affairs O&M PG & Energy & Com Man BR comunica o Analista de BD Control & Portfolio Management Brazil por e-mail, para realizar as negociações necessárias e avaliar se o projeto deve prosseguir. _x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultados positivos, (Caso não haja inconsistência no Due-Diligence), o Especialista em Legal Affairs O&M PG & Energy & Com Man BR comunica o Analista de BD Control & Portfolio Management Brazil por e-mail para elaborar o modelo do projeto.
cells.T: Once signed the MoU, upon request by e-mail from the BD Control & Portfolio Management Brazil Analyst, the Specialist of Legal Affairs O&M PG & Energy & Com Man BR performs the Due Diligence of land issues, based on the documentation available by external agents (notary office, public agencies and justice forum, containing real estate registrations of the properties) to find out if there is any issue that could impact the property (such as a mortgage for example), or if there are lawsuits involving the property and the property owner._x000D__x000D_In addition, the following items are evaluated:_x000D_- the situation of the properties involved in the project, _x000D_- consistency in the property registration, _x000D_- legal situation of the property owners, _x000D_- existence of debts, _x000D__x000D_In order to verify if the project is feasible in economic and reputational terms._x000D__x000D_In case of negative results, (If a risk or inconsistency are identified in the Due-Diligence), the Specialist of Legal Affairs O&M PG & Energy & Com Man BR communicates the BD Control & Portfolio Management Brazil Analyst by email, to carry out the necessary negotiations and assess whether the project should proceed._x000D__x000D_In case of positive results, (If there is no inconsistency in the Due-Diligence), the Specialist of Legal Affairs O&M PG & Energy & Com Man BR communicates the BD Control & Portfolio Management Brazil Analyst by e-mail to prepare the project model.

cells.S: Após receber a confirmação do Especialista de O&M Technical Services Solar Brazil que houve nova aquisição de empresa, o Analista de RTR MEC inicia o controle da atualização monetária. O Head de RTR MEC revisa os lançamentos de atualização do passivo.Em caso de resultados negativos (o Head de RTR MEC identifique inconsistências), o Head de RTR MEC envia um e-mail para o Analista de RTR MEC para fazer os ajustes adequados aos lançamentos passivos de atualização.  Em caso de resultados positivos (o Head de RTR MEC não identifique inconsistências), o Head de RTR MEC envia um e-mail para a Analista de RTR MEC, aprovando os lançamentos no SAP E4E (R4P) - FI.
cells.T: After receiving confirmation from the Specialist of O&M Technical Services Solar Brazil that a new company has been acquired, the RTR MEC Analyst starts controlling the monetary adjustment. The control is carried out according to the acquisition. The RTR MEC Analyst updates the spreadsheet "Passive Update Acquisition_mmyyyy.xls" and sends it by email to the Head of RTR MEC, including the SAP E4E (R4P) - FI screen (extracted through transaction FB03), with the amounts recorded related to the monetary adjustment of liabilities. The Head of RTR MEC reviews the liabilities update postings. In case of negative results (the Head of RTR MEC identifies inconsistency), the Head of RTR MEC sends an e-mail to the RTR MEC Analyst to make the appropriate adjustments to the passive update postings. In case of positive results (the Head of RTR MEC does not identify inconsistency), the Head of RTR MEC sends an e-mail to the RTR MEC Analyst, approving the postings in the SAP E4E (R4P) - FI.

cells.S: Tramite un'integrazione automatica, il sistema SAP HR Italia (HRP) invia giornalmente i dati relativi alla retribuzione del personale al sistema SAP HR Global. Giornalmente, l'unità ERP Finance & Safety (Global ICT) controlla l'esito della trasmissione automatica.In caso di esito negativo, il sistema SAP HR Global tramite uno schedulatore Control M invia in automatico una mail all'unità ERP Finance & Safety (Global ICT) per informarlo del blocco, il quale provvede ad analizzarlo e a risolverlo laddove accertato.In caso di esito positivo, il sistema SAP HR Global tramite uno schedulatore Control M invia in automatico una mail all'unità ERP Finance & Safety (Global ICT) per informarlo dell'avvenuto caricamento dei dati.
cells.T: Through an automatic integration between the systems, the SAP HR Italia (HRP) system sends employees' remuneration data to the SAP HR Global once a day. Daily, once the data are freezed, the ERP Finance & Safety (Global ICT) unit checks the result of the automatic transmission.In case of negative result, the SAP HR Global system, through a Control M scheduler, automatically sends an email to the ERP Finance & Safety (Global ICT) unit to inform it of the block, which then analyses it and solves it where established.In case of positive result, the SAP HR Global system through a Control M scheduler automatically sends an email to the ERP Finance & Safety (Global ICT) unit to inform it that the data has been uploaded.

cells.S: Mensilmente, l’addetto dell’unità People Analytics accede a QlickSense (front end per l’utilizzatore finale di  Cloudera), in particolare nella Dashboard Compensation, e visualizza i dati anagrafici e retributivi che contribuiscono alla formazione dell'indicatore “Ratio of remuneration Women/Men” (che comprende l'indicatore “Ratio of basic salary Women/Men”), risaliti dai sistemi payroll locali, al fine di monitorare l’andamento dell'indicatore globale rispetto ai dati registrati nel mese precedente e analizzare tutti gli eventuali scostamenti. In caso di presenza di scostamenti, l’addetto dell'unità People Analytics provvede a contattare via mail l’unità Compensation della Country coinvolta al fine di analizzarne le cause e giustificare la variazione.Al termine del controllo e in caso di assenza di variazioni, l’addetto dell'unità People Analytics provvede ad archiviare digitalmente in apposita cartella di rete il printscreen/estrazione dalla Salary Dashboard analizzata.
cells.T: On a monthly basis, the People Analytics employee logs into QlickSense (front end for the Cloudera People Analytics end user), specifically in the Compensation Dashboard, and views the personal and remuneration data contributing to the "Ratio of remuneration Women/Men" indicator (which includes the "Ratio of basic salary Women/Men" indicator), traced back from local payroll systems, in order to monitor the trend of the overall indicator against the data recorded in the previous month and analyze all deviations, if any. In the event of variances, the People Analytics employee contacts the Compensation unit of the country involved by email in order to analyze the causes and justify the variances. In case of positive result, the People Analytics employee digitally archives in the appropriate network folder the printscreen/extraction from the analyzed Salary Dashboard.
cells.AB: Milena Colombo;Serena Bonaccorsi;Rossella Bilotta;
cells.AF: 1) Printscreen/estrazione dalla Compensation Dashboard con evidenza del KPI “Ratio of remuneration Women/Men” (che comprende il KPI “Ratio of basic salary Women/Men”) calcolato per il mese in corso e nel mese precedente;2) In caso di variazioni, e-mail scambiate tra l'addetto dell'unità People Analytics e i referenti delle Unit Compensation delle Country coinvolte al fine di indagare le cause e ottenere le giustificazioni di tutti gli scostamenti rilevati.
cells.AG: 1) Printscreen/extract from the Compensation Dashboard with evidence of the "Ratio of remuneration Women/Men" KPI (which includes the "Ratio of basic salary Women/Men" KPI) calculated for the current month and in the previous month;2) In case of variances, emails exchanged between People Analytics and the Compensation Unit contacts of the countries involved in order to investigate the causes and obtain justifications of all deviations detected.

cells.S: A valle della ricezione dei file Excel estratti dai software di monitoraggio di ciascun sito con i dati inerenti alle emissioni di NOx, SO2 e polveri dagli addetti HSEQ di sito, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) o suo delegato consolida i dati in un database Excel e provvede ad effettuare:_x000D__x000D_i) un controllo di completezza, verificando che tutti i siti di competenza della Country abbiano inviato le estrazioni Excel con i dati inerenti alle emissioni di NOx, SO2 e polveri;_x000D_ii) un controllo di coerenza, verificando che il dato mensile come estratto dal sistema di monitoraggio delle emissioni corrisponda alla sommatoria dei consumi giornalieri come estratti dal sistema di monitoraggio per ogni sito._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) richiede il dato mancante agli addetti HSEQ dei siti che non hanno fornito l'informazione e/o rettifica eventuali errori di inserimento nel database Excel e/o richiede chiarimenti agli addetti HSEQ di sito sui dati che presentano discrepanze._x000D_In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) o suo delegato aggiorna il suddetto database Excel caricato nella cartella Sharepoint di Enel Spa “Archivio dati emissivi/Documenti condivisi/General” accessibile anche all'unità Environmental Policies and Procedures (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation).
cells.T: After receiving the Excel files extracted from the monitoring software of each site with the data concerning NOx, SO2 and dust emissions from the site HSEQ operators, the Environmental Model Development Unit (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) responsible or delegate consolidates them into an Excel database and carries out:_x000D__x000D_i) a completeness check, verifying that all the sites under Country competence have sent the Excel extracts with the data concerning NOx, SO2 and dust emissions;_x000D_ii) a consistency check, verifying that the monthly data as extracted from the monitoring system is equal to the sum of the daily data value as extracted from the monitoring system for each site._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the Environmental Model Development Unit (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) responsible or delegate asks for the missing site HSEQ operators to send their data and/or amends possible inserting errors in the Excel databse and/or asks for clarifications to the site HSEQ operators on the misaligned data._x000D_In case of positive result, the Environmental Model Development Unit (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) responsible or delegate updates the aforementioned Excel database into the Enel Spa “Archivio dati emissivi/Documenti condivisi/General” Sharepoint folder, whose access is shared also with the Environmental Policies and Procedures Unit (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) responsible or delegate.

cells.S: A valle della ricezione dei dati sulla produzione totale da parte dell'Unità Monitoring & Maintenance Scheduling Italy (O&M Improvement Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), il responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) o suo delegato provvede a calcolare le emissioni specifiche di NOx, SO2 e polveri e ad effettuare un controllo di ragionevolezza sul dato riguardante le emissioni specifiche di NOx, SO2 e polveri di Country, rispetto al valore del periodo corrispondente dell'anno precedente, indagando su eventuali scostamenti degli indici superiori alla soglia del 20%.In caso di esito negativo, il responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) o suo delegato richiede via e-mail chiarimenti all'operatore dell'impianto sui dati che ritiene anomali. In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) o suo delegato considera il dato consolidato come definitivo.

In case of positive result, the Environmental Model Development Unit (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) responsible or delegate considers consolidated data as final.

cells.S: A valle della validazione su EDEN dei dati inerenti le emissioni di NOx, SO2, polveri, Hg ed H2S da parte del responsabile di sito nel sistema EDEN   e utilizzati nel calcolo delle seguenti metriche:a) Specific NOx emissionsb) Specific SO2 emissionsc) Dust specific emissionsd) Hg emissionse) H2S emissionsil responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) o suo delegato verifica che: i) tutti i siti di competenza della Country abbiano correttamente caricato il dato in EDEN;ii) soltanto per gli inquinanti NOx, SO2 e polveri, il dato caricato in EDEN sia coerente con i valori riportati nel file Excel di monitoraggio trimestrale, indagando su eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 10% dovuti a eventuali rettifiche inserite su EDEN successivamente al consolidamento dei dati nel file Excel di monitoraggio trimestrale;iii) soltanto per gli inquinanti Hg e H2S, un controllo di ragionevolezza, comparando il dato del periodo in corso con il valore del periodo corrispondente dell'anno precedente e indagando eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%.In caso di esito negativo, il responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) o suo delegato provvede a rimandare la scheda al livello precedente indicando, tramite commento a sistema e/o invio e-mail, all'addetto dell'inserimento dati una richiesta di chiarimento/integrazione sui dati registrati, rettificando eventuali valori anomali riscontrati, o richiede via e-mail il dato mancante agli addetti HSEQ dei siti che non hanno fornito l'informazione.In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) o suo delegato procede a validare la scheda tramite l’approvazione in stato "convalidato a livello di Paese": EDEN restituisce un avviso che avverte sulla responsabilità intrapresa e da questo momento in poi la scheda non è più modificabile, diventando visibile al responsabile dell'Unità Environment (HSEQ EGP and Thermal Generation).
cells.T: After the validation on EDEN of data concerning the NOx, SO2, dust, Hg and H2S emissions by the site responsible and contributing to the following metrics:a) Specific NOx emissionsb) Specific SO2 emissionsc) Dust specific emissionsd) Hg emissionse) H2S emissionsthe Environmental Model Development Unit (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) responsible or delegate verifies that:i) all the sites under Country competence have correctly uploaded the data into EDEN;ii) for the NOx, SO2 and dust emissions only, the data uploaded into EDEN are consistent with the values reported in the quarterly monitoring Excel file, investigating any deviations in absolute value higher than the 10% threshold;iii) for the Hg and H2S emissions only, a reasonableness check, comparing the current period's data with the value of the previous year's corresponding period and investigating any deviations in absolute value higher than the 20% threshold.In case of negative result, the Environmental Model Development Unit (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) responsible or delegate sends the sheet back to the previous level notifying, through a comment in the system and/or sending an e-mail, to the data entry operator a request for clarification/integration on the data recorded, modifying any anomalous values found, or requesting by e-mail to upload the data to the missing site HSEQ operators.In case of positive result, the Environmental Model Development Unit (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) responsible or delegate validates the sheet through the approval status "validated at Country level": EDEN returns a message to the approver regarding the responsibility connected to the validation process and from this moment onwards the sheet can no longer be modified, becoming visible to the Environment Unit (HSEQ EGP and Thermal Generation) responsible.

cells.S: Mensualmente, el profesional de HSEQ (Enel Commercial Colombia) descarga el seguimiento de la herramienta ME - HSEQ Processes, realiza un análisis de cumplimiento de las EcoS planificadas contra las ejecutadas, obteniendo el número total de Ecos realizadas de seguridad y medio ambiente. cells.S: Semestralmente, una vez registrados y validados en EDEN - Sustainability los datos de emisiones contaminantes de partículas, NOx y SO2 por parte del Operador de EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Ibe - Environment, el Jefe de EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Ibe - Environment (o delegado) verifica que los datos de emisión de cada instalación, extraídos de SIGMA, están cargados y son consistentes con los datos del año anterior tenendo en cuenta la operación de las centrales durante el año y las medidas de reducción de emisiones que se podrían instalar. En caso de resultado negativo, (se identifican inconsistencias o falta de información), el Jefe de EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Ibe - Environment (o delegado) procede a devolver la ficha al nivel anterior notificando, mediante un comentario en el sistema y/o enviando un correo electrónico, al responsable de la entrada de datos una solicitud de aclaración/integración de los datos registrados, modificando los valores anómalos encontrados. En caso de resultado positivo, (todo es correcto o una vez corregidos los errores), el Jefe de EGP&TGX Iberia – HSEQ Ibe – Environment (o delegado) valida los datos en EDEN - Sustainability.
cells.T: Semiannually, once the data on particle, NOx and SO2 pollutant emissions have been registered and validated in EDEN - Sustainability by the operator of EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Ibe - Environment of each power plant, the Head of EGP&TGX Iberia – HSEQ Ibe - Environment (or delegate) verifies that the emission data for each installation, extracted from SIGMA, are loaded and are consistent with the data of the previous year taking into account the operation of the power plants during the year and the emission reduction measures that could be installed. In case of negative result, (any inconsistencies are identified or lack of information), the Head of EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Ibe - Environment (or delegate) proceed to send back the sheet to the previous level notifying, through a comment in the system and/or sending an e-mail, to the data entry responsible a request for clarification/integration of the recorded data, modifying any anomalous values found. In case of positive result, (everything is correct or once the errors have been corrected), the Head of EGP&TGX Iberia – HSEQ Ibe – Environment (or its delegate) validates the data in EDEN - Sustainability.

cells.S: El operador de IA&R & Sustainability Iberia - Sustainability (Environment) extrae del sistema EDEN - Sustainability, a través de la funcionalidad “Report BDS” un informe en fichero Excel “EDEN_iberia_all_DDMMAA.xlsx” con el detalle de la información, relativa a emisiones de partículas, SO2 y NOx, recogida para todas las instalaciones, así como reportes individuales para cada indicador y línea de negocio, de manera que se facilite la revisión del total de los valores reportados por las instalaciones, con respecto al histórico de datos recogido en el semestre anterior, haciendo un juicio crítico en función de la actividad del período.En caso de resultado negativo, (se detectan discrepancias, y/o es necesario alguna aclaración o un mayor aporte de información), el operador de IA&R & Sustainability Iberia - Sustainability (Environment) envía un correo electrónico a la persona de la unidad de HSEQ de las instalaciones responsable de la carga de los datos en el sistema EDEN - Sustainability, para el seguimiento y resolución.En caso de resultado positivo, (todo es correcto o una vez resueltas las discrepancias), el operador de IA&R & Sustainability Iberia - Sustainability (Environment) Iberia procede a calcular los indicadores relacionados con las emisiones de partículas, SO2 y NOx, en el fichero Excel “EDEN_iberia_all_DDMMAA.xlsx”.
cells.T: The operator of IA&R & Sustainability Iberia - Sustainability (Environment) extracts from EDEN - Sustainability, through the functionality “Report BDS”, an Excel report "EDEN_Iberia_all_DDMMYY" with the detail of the information, related to particle, NOx and SO2 emissions, collected for all the installations, as well as individual reports for each indicator and business unit, in order to ease the review of the total values reported by the facilities, and their comparison and/or contrast with the historical data collected in the previous semester, making a critical judgment based on the period activity.In case of negative result, (any discrepancies are detected, and/or some clarification or further provision of information is needed), the operator of IA&R & Sustainability Iberia - Sustainability (Environment) sends an email to the person of the HSEQ Unit of the corresponding installation responsible for the data loading in the EDEN - Sustainability system, for the follow-up and resolution.In case of positive result, (everything is correct or once discrepancies have been resolved), the operator of IA&R & Sustainability Iberia - Sustainability (Environment) proceeds to calculate the indicators related to particle, NOx and SO2 emissions in the excel file "EDEN_Iberia_all_DDMMYY”.

cells.S: Después de recibir los datos sobre la producción total por parte de Industrial Control P&C (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile), el Especialista Ambiental del sitio (HSEQ Chile EGP and Thermal Generation) revisa y reporta la producción de la planta. El Responsable de Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) o delegado, realiza una verificación de razonabilidad de los datos, investigando cualquier desviación superior al umbral del 20%.En caso de resultado negativo, el Responsable de Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) o delegado,  solicita aclaraciones al Especialista Ambiental del sitio (HSEQ EGP and Thermal Generation).En caso de resultado positivo, el Responsable de Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) o delegado, considera definitivos los datos consolidados y valida la hoja en EDEN quedando en estado "validado a nivel País".
cells.T: After receiving the data about total production by Industrial Control P&C (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile), the site environmental specialist  (HSEQ Chile EGP and Thermal Generation) analyzes and reports the production of the site.   The Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) responsible or delegate carries out a reasonableness check about the data, investigating any deviations higher than the 20% threshold. In case of negative result, the Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) responsible or delegate asks the site environmental specialist (HSEQ Chile EGP and Thermal Generation) for clarification. In case of positive result, the Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) responsible or delegate considers consolidated data as final.

cells.S: Después de la validación en EDEN de los datos relativos a las emisiones de NOx y polvo, por parte del Especialista Ambiental del sitio y que contribuye a las siguientes métricas:a) Emisiones específicas de NOxb) Emisiones específicas de polvoEl Responsable de Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) o delegado, verifica que:i)  Todos los sitios bajo la competencia del País han cargado correctamente los datos en EDEN;ii) Para las emisiones de NOx y polvo, los datos cargados en EDEN son consistentes con los valores informados en el archivo Excel de monitoreo trimestral, investigando cualquier desviación en el valor absoluto superior al umbral del 10%;En caso de resultado negativo, el Responsable de Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) o delegado, remite la hoja al nivel anterior notificando, mediante comentario en el sistema o envío de correo electrónico, al Especialista Ambiental del sitio una solicitud de aclaración/integración de los datos registrados, modificación de cualquier valor anómalo encontrado, o solicitando cargar los datos faltantes.En caso de resultado positivo, el Responsable de Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) o delegado, valida la hoja a través del estado de aprobación "validado a nivel de País". EDEN envía un aviso al responsable de aprobar el proceso de validación, y a partir de este momento la ficha ya no podrá ser modificada, quedando visible para  el responsable de Global Business Line Environment Unit (HSEQ EGP and Thermal Generation) o delegado.
cells.T: After the validation on EDEN of data concerning the NOx and dust emissions by the environmental specialist on site and contributing to the following metrics:a) Specific NOx emissionsb) Dust specific emissionsThe Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) responsible or delegate verifies that:i) all the sites under Country competence have correctly uploaded the data into EDEN;ii) for the NOx and dust emissions, the data uploaded into EDEN are consistent with the values reported in the quarterly monitoring Excel file, investigating any deviations in absolute value higher than the 10% threshold;In case of negative result, the Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile) responsible or delegate sends the sheet back to the previous level notifying, through a comment in the system or sending an e-mail, to the environmental specialist on site a request for clarification/integration on the data recorded, modifying any anomalous values found, or requesting to upload the missing data.In case of positive result, the Environment Chile (EGP and Thermal Generation Chile)  responsible or delegate validates the sheet through the approval status ""validated at Country level"": EDEN returns a message to the approver regarding the responsibility connected to the validation process and from this moment onwards the sheet can no longer be modified, becoming visible to the Global Business Line Environment Unit (HSEQ EGP and Thermal Generation) responsible, or delegate

cells.S: Mensalmente, após o envio por P&C Regulation and Margin Control Brasil e por Billing Brasil dos dados de mercado regulado relativos à, respectivamente, eletricidade distribuida na planilha “Balanço Elétrico” e consumo faturado pela planilha “Informe de Gestão”, todos esses dados referentes aos KPIs "Energy Sold Domestic Market - End Customers GWh” e “Energy Sold Domestic Market - End Customers Gross of Losses GWh", o Head de P&C Grids (Regulated Customers Operations) Brazil ou seu delegado carrega os dados no NEW P.R.I.MO. e realiza uma verificação de consistência, comparando os valores no arquivo Excel recebidos das unidades com o que foi carregado no NEW P.R.I.MO._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado negativo da verificação, o Head de P&C Grids (Regulated Customers Operations) Brazil ou seu delegado retifica as inconsistências encontradas no NEW P.R.I.MO._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado positivo da verificação, o Head de P&C Grids (Regulated Customers Operations) Brazil ou seu delegado confirma internamente os dados carregados no NEW P.R.I.MO.
cells.T: Monthly, after P&C Regulation and Margin Control Brazil and Billing Brazil send the regulated market data related to, respectively, electricity distributed in the “Electric Balance” spreadsheet and consumption billed in the “Management Report” spreadsheet, all of this data related to the KPIs “Energy Sold Domestic Market - End Customers GWh” and “Energy Sold Domestic Market - End Customers Gross of Losses GWh”, the Head of P&C Grids (Regulated Customers Operations) Brazil or his delegate uploads the data to NEW P.R.I.MO. and perform a consistency check, comparing the values ​​in the Excel file received from the units with what was uploaded to NEW P.R.I.MO._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result of the verification, the Head of P&C Grids (Regulated Customers Operations) Brazil or his delegate rectifies the inconsistencies found in NEW P.R.I.MO._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result of verification, the Head of P&C Grids (Regulated Customers Operations) Brazil or his delegate internally confirms the data loaded into NEW P.R.I.MO.

cells.S: Il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center (HSEQ EGP & TGX), o suo delegato, a seguito della stima delle emissioni CO2 effettuata su base mensile moltiplicando il dato della produzione effettiva netta degli impianti del mese di riferimento per il coefficiente emissivo dell'anno precedente, verifica la correttezza della stessa, con riferimento ai parametri utilizzati nel calcolo (produzione effettiva netta e set di coefficienti emissivi per il periodo considerato, calcolati sulla base dello storico di esercizio e delle eventuali variazioni attese a seguito di modifiche impiantistiche).In caso di esito negativo del controllo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center (HSEQ EGP & TGX), o suo delegato, rivede i parametri del calcolo e corregge la stima.In caso di esito positivo del controllo o a valle delle eventuali correzioni, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center (HSEQ EGP & TGX), o suo delegato, archivia digitalmente il calcolo elaborato su file xls e lo invia il dato a Planning and Reporting (P&C – EGP&TGX) e ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition.
cells.T: The Head of the Environmental Competence Center Unit (HSEQ EGP & TGX), or delegate, following the estimation of CO2 emissions carried out on a monthly basis by multiplying the actual net production data of the plants for the reference month by the emission coefficient of the previous year, verifies the accuracy of the same, with reference to the parameters used in the calculation (actual net production and set of emission coefficients for the period considered, calculated on the basis of historical operating data and any expected changes following plant modifications).In case of negative result, the Head of Environmental Competence Center Unit (HSEQ EGP & TGX), or delegate, reviews the calculation parameters and corrects the estimate.In case of positive result, or following any corrections, the Head of Environmental Competence Center (HSEQ EGP & TGX), or delegate, digitally archives the calculation in an xls file and sends the data to Planning and Reporting (P&C – EGP&TGX) and ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition.
cells.AB: Leonetto Ferrari;Claudio Mosti;

cells.S: Mensalmente, após o recebimento pela Unidade de P&C Grids (Regulted Customer Operations) Brasil dos arquivos em Excel “Balanço Elétrico” e “Informe de Gestão”, o Head da unidade, ou seu delegado, passa a realizar uma verificação da quantidade de eletricidade distribuida e consumo faturado ocorridas no período em comparativo com o mês anterior._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado negativo, o Head de P&C Grids (Regulated Customer Operations) Brasil, ou seu delegado, entra em contato com as unidades de negócio que fornecem as planilhas, solicitando explicações sobre a verificação realizada e validação dos dados._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado positivo, o Head de P&C Grids (Regulated Customer Operations) Brasil, ou seu delegado, valida internamente as bases que são utilizadas na carga dos dados no NEW P.R.I.M.O.

In case of positive result, the Audit Holding responsible, or delegate, modifies the status of the paragraphs of competence on Sturnis in "Submitted".

cells.S: Mensualmente, el Responsable o persona delegada de HSEQ (Enel Commercial Iberia) supervisa la realización de las ECoS (Seguridad y Medio Ambiente) en Iberia conforme al calendario previsto a principios de año, convocando a los diferentes roles que correspondan (Team Leader, Partners, SPM, Gestor de Proyecto, ...) para la revisión y planificación de las ECoS realizadas y pendientes, y así completar el documento de seguimiento de los briefing de HSEQ Global.En caso de resultado negativo (retraso o cancelación de la planificación de las ECoS), el Responsable o persona delegada de HSEQ (Enel Commercial Iberia) solicita justificación del mismo vía correo electrónico e insta en las reuniones con las líneas de negocio a la finalización de las ECoS.En caso de resultado positivo, los datos relativos a los ECoS completados están disponibles en ME - HSEQ Processes.
cells.T: Monthly, the Head or delegate of HSEQ (Enel Commercial Iberia) supervises the implementation of the ECoS (Safety and Environment) in Iberia in accordance with the schedule set at the beginning of the year, convening the different roles involved (Team Leader, Partners, SPM, Project Manager, ...) to review and plan the ECoS carried out and pending, and thus complete the monitoring document of the Global HSEQ briefing.In case of negative result (delay or cancellation of the planning of the ECoS), the Head or delegate of HSEQ (Enel Commercial Iberia) requests justification via email and urges the completion of the ECoS in the meetings with the business lines.In case of positive result, data related to completed ECoS are available on ME - HSEQ Processes.

cells.S: Cada vez que se crea un WBS en el módulo SAP R4P - CO y ingresa sus atributos, el sistema realiza controles en los campos y controles requeridos en el formato de los datos ingresados (por ejemplo, texto, numérico / alfanumérico). En particular, los campos obligatorios son:_x000D_ - Compañía financiera;_x000D_ - Centro de costos;_x000D_ - Ejercicio;_x000D_ - Tipo WBS;_x000D_ - Proyecto asociado;_x000D_ - Tipo de instalación;_x000D_ - Fecha de inicio y fecha de finalización._x000D_ - responsable_x000D_ Si no hay conformidades, el módulo SAP R4P - CO no permite la finalización del proceso y notifica al usuario con un mensaje en la pantalla.
cells.T: Each time a WBS is created in the module SAP R4P - CO and enters its attributes, the system performs controls on the required fields and controls on the format of the data entered (eg text, numeric / alphanumeric). In particular the mandatory fields are:_x000D_- Financial Company;_x000D_- Cost center;_x000D_- Exercise;_x000D_- WBS type;_x000D_- Associated project;_x000D_- type of installation;_x000D_- Start date and end date._x000D_- Responsable_x000D_If there are no conformities, the module SAP R4P - CO does not allow the completion of the process and notifies the user with a message on the screen.

cells.M: WH5-Attività di inventario fisico e rilevazione (inserimento) giacenze vs WH3-Movimentazioni / Riclassifiche stock di magazzino
cells.N: WH5-Inventory vs WH3-Movements / Reclassifications for stock value
cells.S: Annualmente, il Responsabile dell’Unità Open Meter e Fibra Dell'Area Regionale Lombardia o un suo delegato (senza conflitti SOD) estrae da sistema i documenti inventariali registrati dall'unità OMF-OMD e verifica che gli  stessi siano coerenti con i verbali della conta inventariale di fine contratto, ricevuti dall’addetto al Piano Inventariale. Nel caso in cui ci siano delle incongruenze, il  Responsabile dell’Unità Open Meter e Fibra o un suo Delegato, se l’errore risiede in SAP MM, richiede la correzione all'addetto, diversamente richiede un’ulteriore attività di conta fisica all’addetto del Piano Inventariale. Nel caso in cui non ci siano incongruenze tra le scritture ausiliari di magazzino e i verbali della conta inventariale, comunica l’esito positivo della verifica al Responsabile PGL dell'Arera Regionale e all’addetto al Piano Inventariale.
cells.T: Annually, the Open Meter and Fibra Unit Manager of the "Lombardia" Regional Area or his delegate without SOD conflicts, extracts from the system the inventory documents recorded by the OMF-OMD unit and verifies that they are consistent with the end-of-contract inventory count reports received from the Inventory Plan Officer. If there are any inconsistencies, the Open Meter and Fibre Unit Manager or his Delegate, if the error lies in SAP MM, requests the correction from the employee, otherwise he requests a further physical count from the Inventory Plan Officer. If there are no inconsistencies between the auxiliary warehouse entries and the minutes of the inventory count, he communicates the positive outcome of the verification to the Regional Arera PGL Manager and the Inventory Plan Officer.
cells.AB: RAFFAELLA VIVANI;
cells.AF: 1) Documenti inventariali registrati da OMF-OMD (Open Meter di Open Meter e Fibra) ed estratti da SAP DIP010 (modulo MM)._x000D_2) Verbale della Conta Inventariale redatto al termine del contratto. _x000D_3) In caso di esito negativo, email per richiesta di chiarimenti inviata dal Responsabile dell’Unità Open Meter e Fibra o da un suo delegato senza conflitti SOD all’addetto al Piano Inventariale ed evidenza delle rettifiche apportate a sistema._x000D_4) In caso di esito positivo, email inviata dal Responsabile dell’Unità Open Meter e Fibra o da un suo delegato senza conflitti SOD al Responsabile della PGL di Area Regionale e all’addetto al Piano Inventariale con la comunicazione dell’esito della verifica.
cells.AG: 1) Inventory documents recorded by OMF-OMD (Open Meter and Fibra) and extracted from SAP DIP010 (MM module)._x000D_2) Minutes of the Inventory Count drawn up at the end of the contract. _x000D_3) In the event of a negative outcome, email for request for clarification sent by the Open Meter e Fibra Unit Manager or his delegate without SOD conflicts to the Inventory Plan Officer and evidence of the corrections made in the system._x000D_4) In the event of a positive outcome, email sent by the Head of the Open Meter and Fibra Unit or his delegate without SOD conflicts to the Regional Area PGL Manager and to the Inventory Plan Officer with notification of the outcome of the verification.

cells.M: CA5-Cost capitalization operations vs CA3-Opening/managing technical object of investment / Control (includes rules for amortizing costs)
cells.N: CA5-Cost capitalization operations vs CA3-Opening/managing technical object of investment / Control (includes rules for amortizing costs)
cells.S: Trimestralmente, o Responável BPO DAP Externo Local  ou o Delegado, sem conflitos SOD relacionados, extrai dos sistemas SAP E4E R4P, SAP E4E S4P and SAP E4E D4P os relatórios de todos os documentos SAP relacionados à gestão de ativos em que ambas abertura/gerenciamento de objetos técnicos de investimento/controle (incluindo regras para custos de amortização) e operações de custo de capitalização e/ou contabilidade dos custos associados aos ativos, foram executados pelo mesmo usuario pertencente a unidade "BPO" com conflitos SOD relacionados.No caso de resultado positivo, o Responsável BPO DAP Externo Local  ou Delegado aprova diretamente no SAP as atividades executadas no SAP pelos usuários, salvando os relatorios analisados em um arquivo Excel e o log de aprovação lançado no SAP, confirmando que todas as atividades do trimestre são revisadas e aprovadas.No caso de resultado negativo, o Responsável BPO DAP Externo Local  ou Delegado, requisita ao usuario da unidade que execute as modificações e receba as evidencias dos ajustes feitos no sistema, salvando todas as evidencias dos ajustes realizados referentes aos documentos não aprovados em SAP (se houver algum).Ao final do controle, O Responsável BPO DAP Externo Local ou o delegado envia um email ao Head de DAP-RTR Ativo Fixo ou Delegado com os resultados verificados.O controle é aplicado para os seguintes processos. 5542 - Elaboração do balancete5511 - Capitalização de recursos internos e externos - Gestão de Ativos Fixos5512 - Capitalização de recursos externos - Gestão de Ativos Fixos
cells.T: Quarterly, the External Local BPO DAP Responsible  or the Delegate, without the SoD conflicts in object, extracts from SAP E4E R4P, SAP E4E S4P and SAP E4E D4P systems the reports of all SAP documents related to assets management on which both opening/managing technical object of investment/control (included rules for amortizing costs) and cost capitalization operations and/or accounting of costs associated to assets were executed by the same user of "BPO" unit with the related SoD conflicts.In case of positive result, the External Local BPO DAP Responsible  or the Delegate approves directly in SAP the activities executed in SAP by the users, saving the analyzed reports in an Excel file and the approval log released in SAP, verifying that all the quarter activities are reviewed and validated.In case of negative result, the External Local BPO DAP Responsible  or the Delegate, requires to the user of the unit to execute the modifications and to receive the evidences of the adjustments made on system, saving all the evidences of the performed adjustments related to the documents not approved in SAP (if any).At the end of the control, the External Local BPO DAP Responsible or the Delegate sends an email to the DAP-RTR Fixed Assets Head (or the Delegate) with the check's outcomes.The control is applied to  to the following processes: 5542 - Elaboration of Trial Balance5511 - Capitalization of Internal and External Resources - Fixed Asset Management5512 - Capitalization of External Resources - Fixed Asset Management.
cells.X: ENEL GREEN POWER CACHOEIRA DOURADA;ENEL BRASIL;ENEL DISTRIBUIÇÃO CEARÀ – BRASIL;ENEL DISTRIBUIÇÃO RIO – BRASIL;ENEL TRADING BRASIL
cells.AF: 1) Relatório trimestral em Excel e respectivo lançamento do log de aprovação nos sistemas SAP E4E R4P, S4P e D4P, do qual se destaca que o Responsável Local Externo do BPO DAP ou seu Delegado, aprovou todas as operações executadas durante o trimestre para os usuários pertencentes à sua unidade com o conflito de SoD em objeto (caso as atividades tenham sido executadas pelo mesmo usuário e em caso de resultado positivo).2) Eventuais insights executados e os ajustes realizados no sistema pelos usuários pertencentes à unidade BPO DAP, considerando as solicitações vindas do Responsável Local Externo do BPO DAP ou de seu Delegado (caso as atividades tenham sido realizadas pelo mesmo usuário e em caso de resultado negativo).3) E-mail enviado pelo Responsável pelo DAP Local do BPO Externo ou seu Delegado ao Responsável pela Administração Local do País ou seu Delegado, detalhando os resultados do controle.
cells.AG: 1) Quarter report in Excel and related approval log release in SAP E4E R4P, S4P and D4P systems, from which is pointed out that the External Local BPO DAP Responsible or his/her Delegate approved all the operations executed during the quarter by the users belonging to "BPO" unit with the SoD conflict in object (in case the opening/managing of the technical object of investment/control and the capitalization or accounting of costs associated to assets were performed by the same user and in case of positive outcome).2)Any adjustments performed in the system by the users belonging to "BPO" unit, considering the requests coming from the External Local BPO DAP Responsible or his/her Delegate (in case the opening/managing of the technical object of investment/control and the capitalization or accounting of costs associated to assets were performed by the same user and in case of negative outcome).3) Email coming from the External Local BPO DAP Responsible or his/her Delegate to the DAP-RTR Fixed Assets Heads or his/her Delegate detailing the control outcomes.

cells.S: Trimestralmente, O Head RTR Ativo Fixo Brasil ou o Delegado recebe um email do Responsável BPO Local (Accenture) ou Delegado com o resultado de todos os controles de mitigação SOD executados pelo Responsável BPO Local (Accenture) ou Delegado. _x000D_O Head RTR Ativo Fixo Brasil ou o Delegado tem que verificar se todos os controles de mitigação sob responsabilidade do BPO Local foram corretamente executados e documentados._x000D_No caso de resultado negativo, o Head RTR Ativo Fixo Brasil ou o Delegado responde ao Responsável BPO Local, solicitando que execute novamente o controle/controles com anomalias, e informe ao Responsável BPO Holding sobre todas as anomalias detectadas._x000D_No caso de resultado positivo, o Head RTR Ativo Fixo Brasil responde com a aprovação ao Responsável BPO Local._x000D_Este controle de monitoramento refere-se ao seguinte controle: C_ELC_CC.BR_SOD07.

cells.T: Each time a WBS is created in the module SAP PS (transaction CJ01) and their attributes are entered, the system performs check controls on the required fields and control formats of the data entered (for example text, numeric / alphanumeric). _x000D_In particular the mandatory fields are:_x000D_- Name of the WBS element of first order (will be equal to the name of the project);_x000D_- Name of the WBS element of second order (with the X format - #### - 33 #);_x000D_- Responsible;_x000D_- Start date._x000D_If there are the disagreements, the SAP PS system does not allow the completion of the creation of WBS and alerts the user with a message on screen.

cells.S: O módulo SAP R/3 - PS, automaticamente, após o usuário iniciar a interface de sincronização, com base no campo da região do projeto registrado no elemento WBS, bem como na tabela SAP “ZRPLM_OT001_IMA - Relação entre Si e WBS” parametrizada no módulo SAP R/3 - PS, Verifica se for possível identificar a região do trabalho, atribuindo automaticamente a solicitação de investimento (SI) ao respectivo projeto de distribuição WBE. Se o módulo SAP R/3 - PS não puder identificar automaticamente a região de trabalho devido ao fato de a região não estar registrada na tabela “ZRPLM_OT001_IMA - Relação entre Si e WBS”, o módulo SAP R/3 - PS emite um relatório de notificação sistêmica Erro na atribuição do elemento WBE para a tabela ZRPLM_OT001_IMA e bloqueia qualquer alteração do status do elemento WBE no SAP R/3 - PS.
cells.T: The SAP R/3 - PS module automatically, after the user launches the synchronization interface, checks—based on the project region field recorded in the WBS element, as well as the SAP table “ZRPLM_OT001_IMA — Relationship Between SI and WBS” configured in the SAP R/3 - PS module, checks whether the work region can be identified and automatically assigns the investment request (SI) to the corresponding WBE distribution project. If the SAP R/3 - PS module cannot automatically identify the work region because the region is not recorded in the “ZRPLM_OT001_IMA - Relationship between SI and WBS” table, the SAP R/3 - PS module issues a system notification report titled “Error in assigning the WBE element to table ZRPLM_OT001_IMA” and blocks any changes to the WBE element’s status in SAP R/3 - PS.

En caso de resultado negativo (errores en el estado CERR, estado bloqueado o activo final no creado), el SAP S4P - CO muestra un mensaje de error
cells.T: The transition from "Asset Under Construction" (AUC) to "Operating" is carried out automatically in SAP S4P-AA module when the liquidation of the costs is executed with the previous change of status from LIBE to CTEC of the technical or controlling object (investment) in SAP S4P - CO. During the process of final settlement of investment expenses, the SAP S4P - CO system validates the custom fields related to the assets and if everything is correct, the SAP S4P - CO automatically goes from "in progress" to "operating" investment in SAP S4P. In case of negative result (errors in the CERR status, status BLOCKED or final asset not created), the SAP S4P - CO displays an error message

cells.S: La creación del activo en construcción (AUC) se realiza automáticamente en SAP R4P cuando la liberación del objeto técnico o de control (inversión) se realiza en SAP R4P - CO/PS. En este proceso de lanzamiento, el SAP R4P - CO validó todos los campos personalizados en relación con los activos. Además, si todo es correcto, registra el activo en construcción (AUC) automáticamente en SAP R4P y libera el objeto de control en SAP R4P - CO. En caso de errores, el SAP R4P - CO muestra un mensaje de error para que el solicitante corregiera todos los errores. El activo no se crea y el objeto no es responsable (costos reales).
cells.T: The creation of the Asset Under Construction (AUC) is performed automatically in SAP R4P when the release of the technical or controlling (investment) object is performed in SAP R4P - CO/PS. In this releasing process, the SAP R4P - CO validated all the custom fields relative to assets. Also, if everything is correct, records the Asset Under Construction (AUC) automatically in SAP R4P and releases the controlling object in SAP R4P - CO. In case of errors, the SAP R4P - CO shows an error message for the applicant to correct all the errors. The asset is not created and the object is not accountable (real costs).

Durante el proceso de liquidación final de los gastos de inversión, el SAP R4P - CO valida los campos personalizados relacionados con los activos y si todo es correcto, el SAP R4P - CO pasa automáticamente de "en progreso" a Inversión "operativa" en SAP R4P - AA. cells.T: The transition from "Asset Under Construction" (AUC) to "Operating" is carried out automatically in SAP R4P - AA module when the liquidation of the costs is executed with the previous change of status from LIBE to CTEC of the technical or controlling object (investment) in SAP R4P - CO. During the process of final settlement of investment expenses, the SAP R4P - CO validates the custom fields related to the assets and if everything is correct, the SAP R4P - CO automatically goes from "in progress" to "operating" investment in SAP R4P - AA. In case of negative result (errors in the CERR status, status BLOCKED or final asset not created), the SAP R4P - CO displays an error message

cells.S: La creación del activo en construcción (AUC) se realiza automáticamente en el módulo SAP DIP -AA cuando la liberación del objeto técnico o de control (inversión) se realiza en SAP DIP - CO/PS. En este proceso de lanzamiento, el SAP DIP - CO/PS validó todos los campos personalizados en relación con los activos. Además, si todo es correcto, registra el activo en construcción (AUC) automáticamente en SAP DIP y libera el objeto de control en SAP DIP - CO/PS. En el caso de los errores, el sistema SAP DIP - CO/PS muestra un mensaje de error para que el solicitante corregiera todos los errores. El activo no se crea y el objeto no es responsable (costos reales).
cells.T: The creation of the Asset Under Construction (AUC) is performed automatically in SAP DIP-AA module when the release of the technical or controlling (investment) object is performed in SAP DIP - CO/PS. In this releasing process, the SAP DIP - CO/PS validated all the custom fields relative to assets. Also, if everything is correct, records the Asset Under Construction (AUC) automatically in SAP DIP and releases the controlling object in SAP DIP - CO/PS. In case of errors, the SAP DIP - CO/PS system shows an error message for the applicant to correct all the errors. The asset is not created and the object is not accountable (real costs).

cells.S: El Responsable de Supplier Qualification&Performance Management Iberia, o su delegado, tras recibir la propuesta de resultado del proceso de calificación en WeBuy, inicia sesión en el sistema y verifica la finalización de los pasos de calificación del proveedor por parte del equipo. En el caso de calificación por grupo mercadológico (GM) de riesgo medio/alto, el Responsable, o delegado, analiza la completitud y corrección de la documentación aportada por el proveedor y las verificaciones internas a cargo de Enel (evaluaciones de contratistas en materia de Seguridad, Medio Ambiente y Reputacional).Si el resultado es desfavorable, el Responsable de Supplier Qualification&Performance Management Iberia no aprueba la calificación del proveedor.En caso de resultado favorable, el Responsable de Supplier Qualification&Performance Management Iberia valida la propuesta de calificación del proveedor en WeBuy.
cells.T: The Head of Supplier Qualification & Performance Management Iberia, or their delegate, upon receiving the proposed outcome of the qualification process in WeBuy, logs into the system and verifies the completion of the supplier qualification steps carried out by the team. In the case of qualification by marketing group (GM) with medium/high risk, the Head, or delegate, reviews the completeness and accuracy of the documentation provided by the supplier and the internal verifications carried out by Enel (contractor evaluations regarding Safety, Environment, and Reputational aspects).If the outcome is unfavorable, the Head of Supplier Qualification & Performance Management Iberia does not approve the supplier’s qualification.If the outcome is favorable, the Head of Supplier Qualification & Performance Management Iberia validates the supplier qualification proposal in WeBuy.

cells.S: Ogni volta che una criticità segnalate da fonti interne ed esterne ad Enel viene ricevuta da parte dell'Unità Security, il Responsabile di Sustainability & Reputational Governance e il Responsabile di Ecofin, Performance, Qualification Model monitorano il mantenimento dei requisiti reputazionali da parte dei fornitori, analizzando le criticità segnalate.In caso di esito positivo, ovvero qualora non vengano accertate criticità, il Responsabile di Sustainability & Reputational Governance e il Responsabile di Ecofin, Performance, Qualification Model confermano il mantenimento dei requisiti reputazionali da parte dei fornitori oggetto di analisi all'interno della sezione "Analisi di Onorabilità" del fornitore presente all'interno del sistema Webuy.In caso di esito negativo, ovvero in caso di rischio reputazionale accertato, il Responsabile di Sustainability & Reputational Governance e il Responsabile di Ecofin, Performance, Qualification Model attivano il processo del Comitato di Onorabilità convocando tutte le unità organizzative coinvolte.Il Responsabile di Sustainability & Reputational Governance e il Responsabile di Ecofin, Performance, Qualification Model, o loro delegati, riportano l'esito delle valutazioni svolte dal Comitato di Onorabilità (conferma del mantenimento dei requisiti/sospensione della qualifica del fornitore) all'interno della sezione "Analisi di Onorabilità" del fornitore presente all'interno del sistema Webuy.
cells.T: Each time a critical issue reported by reported by sources internal and external to Enel is received by the Security Unit, the Head of Sustainability & Reputational Governance and the Head of Ecofin, Performance, Qualification Model monitor the maintenance of reputational requirements by suppliers, analyzing critical issues reported.In case of positive result, if no criticalities are found, the Head of Sustainability & Reputational Governance and the Head of Ecofin, Performance, Qualification Model confirm the maintenance of reputational requirements by the suppliers under analysis within the "Honorability Analysis" section of the supplier present within the WeBuy system.In case of negative result, in case of established reputational risk, the Head of Sustainability & Reputational Governance and the Head of Ecofin, Performance, Qualification Model activate the Honorability Committee process by convening all organizational units involved.The Head of Sustainability & Reputational Governance and the Head of Ecofin, Performance, Qualification Model, or delegates, report the outcome of the evaluations carried out by the Honorability Committee (confirmation of maintenance of requirements/suspension of supplier qualification) within the "Honorability Analysis" section of the supplier present within the WeBuy system.

cells.S: El Responsable de Supplier Qualification&Performance Management Iberia realiza un seguimiento del mantenimiento de los requisitos reputacionales por parte de los proveedores en aquellos casos en los que la actividad para la que el proveedor desee calificarse esté identificada con Riesgo Reputacional encargando al Área de Security un Informe de Contraparte.Si el resultado es favorable, es decir, si no se encuentran criticidades, el Responsable de Supplier Qualification&Performance Management Iberia confirma la ausencia de riesgo reputacional por parte de los proveedores analizados dentro de la sección "Análisis de Honorabilidad" en el sistema WeBuy.Si el resultado es desfavorable, es decir, en caso de que en el Informe de Contraparte se detecten hallazgos relevantes, el Responsable de Supplier Qualification&Performance Management Iberia convoca el Comité de Integridad, integrado por Security, Procurement, y LA Procurement. El Responsable de Supplier Qualification&Performance Management Iberia, o su delegado, informa del resultado de las evaluaciones realizadas por el Comité de Integridad (continuación del proceso de calificación del proveedor o no calificación del proveedor) en la sección "Análisis de Honorabilidad" en el sistema WeBuy.
cells.T: The Head of Supplier Qualification & Performance Management Iberia monitors the maintenance of reputational requirements by suppliers in cases where the activity for which the supplier seeks qualification is identified as having Reputational Risk, by requesting a Counterparty Report from the Security Area.If the result is favorable, meaning no critical issues are found, the Head of Supplier Qualification & Performance Management Iberia confirms the absence of reputational risk for the analyzed suppliers in the "Honorability Analysis" section of the WeBuy system.If the result is unfavorable, meaning relevant findings are detected in the Counterparty Report, the Head of Supplier Qualification & Performance Management Iberia convenes the Integrity Committee, composed of Security, Procurement, and LA Procurement. The Head of Supplier Qualification & Performance Management Iberia, or their delegate, reports the outcome of the evaluations carried out by the Integrity Committee (continuation of the supplier qualification process or non-qualification of the supplier) in the "Honorability Analysis" section of the WeBuy system.

cells.S: De acuerdo con el cronograma definido mensualmente para el cierre de la nómina, el profesional de BPO PP- Pre Payroll verifica:a) sobre  las medidas del mes (altas de empleados y movimientos del mes), que los datos personales ingresados de los siguientes infotipos locales a través de Onboarding (Altas de empleados) y la información de medidas del periodo recibida mediante ticket ServiceNow (movimientos del mes), correspondan con la información del sistema SAP PAGO:• Infotipo 2 - Información de genero del empleado (altas)• Infotipo 34 -  Función Interna • Infotipo 8 - Subgrupo Profesional(La información del infotipo 34 y 8 de forma automatica define la categoria del empleado)b) que la información personal de las altas de empleados relacionada con Infotipo 2 - Información de genero del empleado (altas),  Infotipo 34 -  Función Interna e I nfotipo 8 - Subgrupo Profesional reportada en los documentos de ingreso del empleado corresponde con la información del sistema SAP PAGO.En caso de resultado negativo (identificar diferencias), el profesional de BPO PP- Pre Payroll (Revisor), corrige  y/o gestiona la corrección del dato errado en el sistema SAP PAGO.En caso de resultado positivo (no identificar diferencias o después de realizar las correcciones), el profesional de BPO PP- Pre Payroll (Revisor) guarda el archivo “Reporte Medición personal [Mes] [Año]” con la revisión en la carpeta compartida del grupo Enel.
cells.T: According to the monthly schedule defined for the payroll closing, the professional  of BPO PP- Pre Payroll verifies:a) on the actions of the month (employee new hired and movements of the month), that the personal data entered from the following local infotypes through Onboarding (employee new hired) and the information of actions of the period received through ServiceNow ticket (movements of the month), correspond with the information of the SAP PAGO system:- Infotype 2 - Employee Gender Information (employee new hired)- Infotype 34 - Internal Function - Infotype 8 - Professional Subgroup(The information of infotype 34 and 8 automatically defines the employee's category).b) that the personal information of employee registrations related to Infotype 2 - Employee Gender Information (Registrations), Infotype 34 - Internal Function and Infotype 8 - Professional Subgroup reported in the employee's entry documents corresponds with the information in the SAP PAGO system.In case of negative result (identify differences), the professional (Reviewer) of BPO PP- Pre Payroll, corrects and/or manages the correction of the erroneous data in the SAP PAGO system.In case of positive result (no differences identified or after making the corrections), the professional (Reviewer) of BPO PP- Pre Payroll saves the "Personal Measurement Report [Month] [Year]" file with the revision in the shared folder of the Enel group.
cells.AF: 1) Informe extraído de SAP PAGO de los infotipos: Infotipo 2, Infotipo 8 e Infotipo 34)2) En caso de resultado negativo de la comprobación, evidencia de las correcciones realizadas en el sistema (si aplica).3) Fichero “Reporte Medición personal [Mes] [Año]” con la evidencia de la validación.
cells.AG: 1) Report extracted from SAP PAGO of the infotypes: Infotype 2, Infotype 8, and Infotype 34)2) In case of a negative result of the check, evidence of the corrections maded in the system (if applicable).3) File "Personal Measurement Report [Month] [Year]" of the validation.

cells.S: Mensualmente, una vez recibido el correo electrónico del Profesional de BPO Pre PP Payroll con el archivo “Informe de Medidas_Mes_Año” extraído del sistema SAP PAGO con la transacción S_PH0_48000510 que contiene el detalle de las medidas del mes (altas, bajas y movimientos registrados en el mes), el Profesional de People Administration COL & CA verifica:1) la coincidencia del numero de las altas y las bajas ingresada en SAP PAGO, comparando el archivo “Informe de Medidas_Mes_Año” con los archivos "Base_Ingresos_MM_AAAA" extraído del sistema Onboarding por el Profesional de People Administation COL & CA y “Bajas y Finiquitos_AAAA” elaborado por el Profesional de People Administration COL & CA.2) la coincidencia del numero de medidas (movimientos registrados en el mes) reportadas en los archivos "medidas mes.año" generado desde Service Now vs. el archivo “Informe de Medidas” generado del sistema SAP PAGO3) verifica que el cargo y genero del empleado corresponde con la información del infotipo 8 - Subgrupo Profesional, infotipo 34 - Funcion Interna e Infotipo 2 - Información de genero del empleadoEn caso de resultado negativo (se detectan errores), el Profesional de People Administration COL & CA realiza las siguientes acciones: 1. Analiza por su cuenta la diferencia identificada y la corrige en el sistema SAP HR Global (HGP) - Web Layer 2. Solicita por correo electrónico al Profesional de BPO Pre PP Payroll para que realice las correcciones respectivas en el informe medida extraído de SAP PAGO.En caso de resultado positivo (no se detectan errores, o después de realizar las correcciones), el Profesional de People Administration COL & CA guarda el archivo “Informe de Medidas_Mes_Año” de la validación en la carpeta compartida de la unidad.
cells.T: On a monthly basis, once the email is received from the BPO Pre PP Payroll Professional with the "Actions Report_month_Year" file extracted from the SAP PAGO system with the transaction S_PH0_48000510 containing the details of the actions of the month (registrations, terminations and movements recorded in the month), the People Administration COL & CA Professional verifies:1) the coincidence of the number of registrations and terminations entered in SAP PAGO, comparing the "Actions Report_month_Year" file with the files "Revenue base MM YYYY" extracted from the Onboarding system by the People Administration COL & CA Professional and "Terminations and Settlements_YYYY" elaborated by the People Administration COL & CA Professional.2) the coincidence of the number of actions (movements registered in the month) reported in the files "Actions month.year" generated from Service Now vs. the file "Actions Report_month_year" generated from the SAP PAGO system.3) verifies that the employee's position and gender correspond with the information in infotype 8 - Professional Subgroup, infotype 34 - Internal Function and infotype 2 - Employee's gender information.In case of negative results (errors are detected), the People Administration COL & CA Professional performs the following actions: 1. Analyses the identified difference and corrects it in the SAP HR Global (HGP) - Web Layer system.2. Requests by e-mail to the BPO Pre PP Payroll Professional to make the respective corrections in the measured report extracted from SAP PAGO.In case of positive results (no errors are detected, or after making the corrections), the People Administration COL & CA Professional saves the validation "Action Report_month_Year" file in the shared folder of the unit.
cells.AB: Alejandra Judith Peña Navarrete;
cells.AF: 1) Correo electrónico de BPO Pre PP Payroll con el archivo "Informe de medidas_mes_año" extraído del sistema SAP PAGO con la transacción S_PH0_48000510.2)  Archivos "Base Ingresos MM AAAA" extraído del sistema Onboarding por el profesional de People Administration y “Bajas y Finiquitos_AAAA” elaborado por el profesional de People Administration.3) Archivo "medidas mes.año"4) En caso de resultado negativo, correo electrónico del profesional de People Administration solicitando las correcciones respectivas. (Si aplica).5) En caso de resultado positivo, archivo “Informe de Medidas_Mes_Año” de la validación guardado en la carpeta compartida de la unidad

In case of negative result, e-mail from the People Administration professional requesting the respective corrections (if applicable).5. In case of positive result, file "Action Report" of the validation saves in the shared folder of the unit.

cells.S: A valle della ricezione, tramite e-mail, da parte dell'unità Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting del report contentente il calcolo del KPI "Renewable Installed Capacity Percentage", il Responsabile di Capital Markets, o delegato, verifica la completezza delle informazioni riportate nel report stesso.In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile di Capital Markets, o delegato, contatta l'unità Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting al fine di apportare le dovute correzioni/modifiche/integrazioni al report.In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile di Capital Markets, o delegato, modifica lo status del documento su Sturnis in "Submitted".
cells.T: After receiving, by e-mail sent by Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting, the report containing the "Renewable Installed Capacity Percentage" KPI calculation, the Capital Markets responsible, or delegate, checks the completeness of the information reported.In case of negative result, the Capital Markets responsible, or delegate, contacts by email the Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting Unit in order to perform the needed amendments/modifications/additions to the report.In case of positive result, the Capital Markets responsible, or delegate, modifies the status of the document into "Submitted" on Sturnis.
cells.AB: Alberto Ragnoni;Giovanni Niero;

DM "Sturnis".

cells.S: Every six months, the Head of Audit USA and Canada Unit or delegate accesses the Ethics Point Platform and verifies: i) the correct classification of each report; ii) the compliance with the timing of analysis and investigation activities of each report on the basis of what is indicated in the Group Policy n. 18  “Whistleblowing Policy”; iii) the evaluations carried out on each report in order to identify the actual presence of a violation of the Code of Ethics principles; iv) the correct valorisation of the "actions taken" field in the event of ascertained violations of the Code of Ethics principles.In case of negative result, the Head of Audit USA and Canada Unit or delegate, makes the appropriate changes/corrections in Ethics Point in order to resolve the anomalies.In case of positive result, the Head of Audit USA and Canada Unit or delegate confirms by email to Audit Holding that the data related to the reports have been updated in the Ethics Point platform.

cells.S: Mensalmente, o Analista de RTR General Accounting Brazil valida a planilha “Saldo Contingencias Honorários Depósitos – mes.ano.xls” (contendo os saldos do SAP extraído através da transação ZFI4D_BR_ZC29/F.01/SAP Analysis - Operational Reporting (OR)) respondido por e-mail e/ou OIP pelo Analista de BPO-AFC para o Analista de Legal e/ou de Tax Audits informando a validação do processo de contingência. Em caso de resultado positivo, o Analista de RTR General Accounting Brazil arquiva a planilha “Saldo Contingencias Honorários Depósitos – mes.ano.xls” no Sharepoint e responde o OIP ao Analista de Legal e/ou de Tax Audits sinalizando a conformidade das informações. Em caso de resultado negativo, o Analista de RTR General Accounting Brazil responde por e-mail e/ou OIP solicitando as devidas justificadas e os ajustes se necessários ao Analista de BPO-AFC.
cells.T: Monthly, the RTR General Accounting Brazil Analyst validates the spreadsheet “Balance of Contingency Fees Deposits – month.year.xls” (containing the SAP balances extracted through transaction ZFI4D_BR_ZC29/F.01/SAP Analysis - Operational Reporting (OR)) responded by email and/or OIP by the BPO-AFC Analyst to the Legal and/or Tax Audits Analyst, informing the validation of the contingency process.In case of a positive result, the RTR General Accounting Brazil Analyst files the spreadsheet “Balance of Contingency Fees Deposits – month.year.xls” in Sharepoint and responds to the OIP to the Legal and/or Tax Audits Analyst, indicating the conformity of the information.In case of a negative result, the RTR General Accounting Brazil Analyst responds, via e-mail or OIP, requesting the appropriate justifications and corrections, if necessary, from the BPO-AFC Analyst.

cells.AB: Weslei Camelo Lopes;Rodrigo Cabral De Mello;
cells.AF: 1) Planilhas “Saldo Contingencias Honorários Depósitos – mes.ano.xls”;2) Em caso de resultado negativo, e-mail e/ou OIP enviado pelo Analista de RTR General Accounting Brazil para o Analista de BPO-AFC solicitando as devidas justificadas e os ajustes se necessários;3) Em caso de resultado positivo, e-mail e/ou OIP do Analista de RTR General Accounting Brazil ao Analista de Legal e/ou de Tax Audits sinalizando a conformidade das informações;4) Evidência para garantir a integridade e acuracidade dos parâmetros utilizados na extração do relatório pelo sistema SAP transação ZFI4D_BR_ZC29/F.01/SAP Analysis - Operational Reporting (OR), e todos os seus detalhes de números de linhas, valores totais ou qualquer outra informação que confirmem que a informação utilizada é exatamente o mesmo dado gerado pelo relatório extraído no sistema.
cells.AG: 1) “Balance of Contingency Fees Deposits – month.year.xls” spreadsheets;2) In case of negative result, OIP sent by the RTR General Accounting Brazil Analyst to the BPO-AFC Analyst requesting the necessary adjustments, when applicable;3) In case of positive result, email and/or OIP from the RTR General Accounting Brazil Analyst to the Legal and/or Tax Audits Analyst indicating the conformity of the information;4) Evidence to guarantee the integrity and accuracy of the parameters used in the extraction of the report by the SAP system transaction ZFI4D_BR_ZC29/F.01/SAP Analysis - Operational Reporting (OR), and all its details of line numbers, total values ​​or any other information that confirms that the information used is exactly the same data generated by the report extracted in the system.

cells.S: Mensalmente, após o Analista de BPO-AFC sinalizar via e-mail que realizou as contabilizações de margem, o Analista de DAP RTR-GA verifica se as contabilizações foram registradas corretamente através do check de margem “Check Margem EMPRESA MMAA” e SAP R4P transação ZFI4R_BR_ZC29_BALMES/F.01/SAP Analysis - Operational Reporting (OR). Em caso de resultado positivo, o Analista de DAP RTR-GA segue para liberação da margem para validação e sinaliza a conformidade via e-mail ao Analista de BPO-AFC. Em caso de resultado negativo, o Analista de DAP RTR-GA envia e-mail para análise do Analista de Margin Management e/ou realiza as alterações devidas antes de liberar a margem da companhia para validação e informa ao Analista de BPO-AFC.
cells.T: Monthly after the BPO-AFC Analyst signals via e-mail that he has carried out the margin accounting, the DAP RTR-GA Analyst verifies that the accounting has been correctly accounted for through the margin check "Check Margin COMPANY MMAA" and SAP R4P transaction ZFI4R_BR_ZC29_BALMES/F.01/SAP Analysis - Operational Reporting (OR).In case of positive result, the DAP RTR-GA Analyst proceeds to release the margin for validation and signals the accordance via email to the BPO-AFC Analyst.In case of negative result, the DAP RTR-GA Analyst sends the report by e-mail for analysis of the Margin Management Analyst and/or makes the necessary changes before releasing the company's margin for validation and informs the BPO-AFC Analyst.
