cells.S: Environmental Competence Center - Enel Grids & Innovation _x000D__x000D_Una volta estratti da PUC i dati relativi all'intersezione della rete con Protected Areas e/o habitat critici, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center - Enel Grids & Innovation, o delegato, effettua:_x000D__x000D_i) un controllo di completezza verificando che: _x000D_- siano presenti i dati di tutti i paesi (ad eccezione dell'Argentina) e le tecnologie pertinenti secondo le unità di misura attese (es.km di linea, ettari di suolo);_x000D_- sia stata ricevuta conferma via e-mail da parte dell'Unità Global ICT - Industrial Delivery - Asset Centric Services  del corretto caricamento delle ultime mappe fornite;_x000D_ii) un controllo di coerenza  comparando i dati relativi agli asset in Aree Protette e nei Critical Habitat del periodo in corso con i valori dell'anno precedente, indagando eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto per Country superiori alla soglia del 5%._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center - Enel Grids & Innovation, o delegato, provvede a contattare i referenti di Unità Global ICT - Industrial Delivery - Asset Centric Services e/o di Construction Operation & Mantainance richiedendo i chiarimenti del caso e, se necessario, richiedendo di integrare o correggere i dati e/o richiedere la correzione dei layer cartografici_x000D__x000D_In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center - Enel Grids & Innovation, o  delegato, carica i dati in Eden e procede alla relativa validazione.
cells.T: Environmental Competence Center - Enel Grids & Innovation _x000D__x000D_Once the data relating to the intersection of the network with Protected Areas and/or critical habitats has been extracted from PUC, the Head of the Environmental Competence Centre - Enel Grids & Innovation Unit, or their delegate, carries out:_x000D__x000D_i) a completeness check to verify that:_x000D_- data for all countries (except Argentina) and relevant technologies are present according to the expected units of measurement (e.g. km of line, hectares of land);_x000D_- confirmation has been received by email from the Global ICT - Industrial Delivery - Asset Centric Services Unit that the latest maps provided have been uploaded correctly;_x000D_ii) a consistency check, comparing the data relating to assets in Protected Areas and Critical Habitats for the current period with the values for the previous year, investigating any deviations in absolute value per country exceeding the 5% threshold._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of the Environmental Competence Center - Enel Grids & Innovation Unit, or delegate, contacts the representatives of the Global ICT - Industrial Delivery - Asset Centric Services Unit and/or Construction Operation & Maintenance Unit to request clarification and, if necessary, request the data to be supplemented or corrected and/or request the correction of the map layers._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of the Environmental Competence Center - Enel Grids & Innovation Unit, or delegate, uploads the data to Eden and proceeds with the relevant validation.

cells.S: A seguito del caricamento del dato da parte delle GBL Enel Grids & Innovation e EGP&TGX in EDEN, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting, o suo delegato, effettua:_x000D__x000D_i) un controllo di completezza del dato, verificando che siano presenti i dati per entrambe le GBL coinvolte, e che per ciascuna GBL siano riportati tutti i cluster richiesti e le unità di misura attese (es. numero impianti, km di linea, ettari di suolo);_x000D__x000D_ii) un controllo di coerenza dei dati aggregati a livello di GBL, comparando i dati del periodo in corso con i valori dell'anno precedente ed indagando eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 5%._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting, o delegato, provvede a segnalare l'anomalia, tramite commento a sistema e/o invio e-mail, alle Unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) e/o Environmental Competence Center - Enel Grids & Innovation, richiedendo chiarimenti e/o correzioni._x000D_In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting o delegato informa via e-mail il Responsabile dell'Unità Sustainability Reporting, o suo delegato, e l'Unità Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler circa la correttezza dei dati.
cells.T: Following the uploading of data by GBLs Enel Grids & Innovation and EGP&TGX to EDEN, the Head of the Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting Unit, or delegate, performs:_x000D__x000D_i) a completeness check of the data, verifying that data is present for both GBLs involved, and that all required clusters and expected units of measurement (e.g. number of plants, km of line, hectares of land) are reported for each GBL;_x000D__x000D_ii) a consistency check of the aggregated data at GBL level, comparing the data for the current period with the values for the previous year and investigating any deviations in absolute value exceeding the 5% threshold._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of the Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting Unit, or delegate, reports the anomaly, via comment in the system and/or by sending an email, to the Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) and/or Environmental Competence Center - Enel Grids & Innovation units, requesting clarification and/or corrections._x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of the Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting Unit or delegate informs the Head of the Sustainability Reporting Unit, or delegate, and the Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler Unit by email about the accuracy of the data.

cells.S: A valle del calcolo dell'indicatore relativo alla percentuale di funzioni aziendali a rischio corruzioni, il Responsabile dell'Unità Business Integrity Compliance, o suo delegato, verifica:_x000D_- la correttezza dell'indicatore, ovvero che tutte le unità risultanti dai file di formazione estratti da ME-Learning siano stati riconciliati con la corrispettiva unità a livello CEO -1._x000D_- la completezza dell'indicatore, ovvero che il denominatore consideri tutte le funzioni identificate a rischio in coerenza con il perimetro di funzioni definito per il calcolo dell'indicatore (unità a livello CEO -1)._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Business Integrity Compliance, o suo delegato, procede a rettificare i dati ed effettuare un nuovo calcolo dell'indicatore._x000D_ In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Business Integrity Compliance, o suo delegato, procede ad archiviare digitalmente il file excel con il calcolo dell'indicatore.
cells.T: After the calculation of the indicator related to the percentage of business functions at risk corruption, the Head of the Business Integrity Compliance Unit, or delegate, verifies:_x000D_- the accuracy of the indicator, i.e., ensuring that all units resulting from the training files extracted from ME-Learning have been reconciled with the corresponding unit at the CEO -1 level._x000D_- the completeness of the indicator, i.e., ensuring that the denominator includes all the functions identified as being at risk, in line with the scope of functions defined for the calculation of the indicator (units at the CEO -1 level)._x000D__x000D_In case of a negative result, the Head of the Business Integrity Compliance Unit, or delegate, will correct the data and recalculate the indicator._x000D_In case of a positive result, the Head of the Business Integrity Compliance Unit, or delegate, will proceed to digitally archive the Excel file with the calculated indicator.

cells.S: Una vez que los KPI quantitativos del Informe Integrado dedicados a "SASB" sean cargados en Sturnis por los operadores de la unidad Financial Statement EGP&TGx y E&CM Chile, con base en la información proporcionada por las diferentes Unidades Organizativas involucradas (data owner), el responsable de Financial Statement EGP&TGx y E&CM Chile, o su delegado, verifica, dentro de los plazos establecidos para la preparación del Informe Integrado, la integridad y corrección de la información reportada.En caso de resultado negativo, el responsable de Financial Statement EGP&TGx y E&CM Chile, o su delegado, realiza las enmiendas, modificaciones o adiciones necesarias a los párrafos, las cuales serán posteriormente implementadas por el operador en Sturnis.En caso de resultado positivo, el responsable de Financial Statement EGP&TGx y E&CM Chile, o su delegado, modifica el estado de los párrafos correspondientes a "Enviado" en Sturnis.
cells.T: Once the quantitative SASB indicators of the Integrated Report are uploaded to Sturnis by the Financial Statement EGP&TGx and E&CM Chile Unit operators, based on the information provided by the different Organizational Unit involved (data owner), the Financial Statement EGP&TGx and E&CM Chile responsible, or delegate, checks, within the deadlines for the preparation of the Integrated Report, the completeness and correctness of the information reported therein, comparing them with the information provided by the owner. In case of negative result, the Financial Statement EGP&TGx and E&CM Chile responsible, or delegate, carries out the due amendments/modifications/additions to the paragraphs, which will be subsequently implemented by the operator in Sturnis. In case of positive result, the Financial Statement EGP&TGx and E&CM Chil responsible, or delegate, modifies the status of the paragraphs of competence to "Submitted" in Sturnis.

cells.S: Después de mostrar la hoja que contiene los datos relacionados con la emisión de NOx, SO2 y MP (polvo material particulado total PST) de la generación de energía termoeléctrica, el Jefe de HSEQ Thermal Col de la zona realiza una revisión de la información, de la siguiente manera:_x000D__x000D_i) una comprobación de integridad, verificando que todos los administradores de centros de Colombia han cargado los datos en el sistema EDEN. _x000D_ii) un control de razonabilidad con respecto al valor anual anterior, investigando cualquier desviación en valor absoluto que supere el umbral del 10%._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, el Jefe de HSEQ Thermal Col, o delegado, devolverá el archivo al nivel anterior, indicando, mediante un comentario en el sistema EDEN y/o envía correo electrónico, al responsable de entrada de datos solicitando de aclaración/adición a los datos registrados. Después de la modificación, el sistema EDEN envía automáticamente un correo electrónico al introductor de datos en el sistema EDEN notificando los cambios realizados._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, el Jefe de HSEQ Thermal Col&CAM o delegado aprueba el archivo asignando un estado "validado a nivel de sitio" EDEN devuelve un aviso advirtiendo de la responsabilidad asumida y a partir de este momento el archivo deja de ser editable, pasando a ser visible para el Jefe de Environment COL&CA o delegado.
cells.T: After displaying the sheet containing the data related to NOx, SO₂ and PM (total particulate matter PST) emission from thermoelectric power generation, the HSEQ Thermal Col Head for the zone performs a review of the information, as follows:_x000D__x000D_i. a completeness check, verifying that all administrators of centers in Colombia have uploaded the data into the EDEN system. _x000D__x000D_ii. a reasonableness checks with respect to the previous annual value, investigating any deviation in absolute value that exceeds the 10% threshold._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the HSEQ Thermal Col Head for the technological line, or delegate, will return the file to the previous level, indicating, by means of a comment in the EDEN system and/or by sending an e-mail, to the data entry manager a request for clarification/addition to the data recorded. After modification, the EDEN system automatically sends an e-mail to the data entry clerk in the EDEN system notifying the changes made._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result, the the HSEQ Thermal Col Head for the technological line or delegate approves the file by assigning a status "validated at site level" EDEN returns a notice warning of the responsibility assumed and from this moment the file is no longer editable, becoming visible to the Head of Environment COL & CA or delegate.

cells.S: Después de mostrar los datos validados preliminarmente por el Jefe de HSEQ Thermal Col de la unidad en el sistema EDEN para la emisión de NOx, SO2 y MP (polvo material particulado total PST) de la generación de energía termoeléctrica, el Jefe de Environment Colombia and CA, o delegado, realiza una revisión de la información, de la siguiente manera:_x000D__x000D_i. una verificación de integridad, verificando que todos los administradores del sitio en Colombia hayan cargado los datos en el sistema EDEN. _x000D__x000D_ii. una comprobación de razonabilidad con respecto al valor anual anterior, investigando cualquier desviación del valor absoluto que supere el umbral del 10%._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, el Jefe de Environment Colombia and CA, o delegado, devolverá el archivo al nivel anterior, indicando, a través de un comentario en el sistema EDEN y/o envia un correo electrónico, al responsable de entrada de datos solicitando aclaración/adición a los datos registrados. Después de la modificación, el sistema envía automáticamente un correo electrónico al empleado de entrada de datos en el sistema EDEN notificando los cambios realizados._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, el Jefe de Environment Colombia and CA, o delegado, valida el expediente aprobándolo en estado de "validado a nivel país", EDEN devuelve un aviso advirtiendo de la responsabilidad asumida y a partir de este momento el formulario deja de ser editable, pasando a ser visible para la Unidad de Environment COL&CA.
cells.T: After displaying the data preliminarily validated by the HSEQ Thermal Col Head of the area in the EDEN system for NOx, SO₂ and PM (total particulate matter PST) emissions from thermoelectric power generation, the Environment Colombia and CA Head, or delegate, performs a review of the information, as follows:_x000D__x000D_i.a completeness check, verifying that all site administrators in Colombia have uploaded the data into the EDEN system. _x000D__x000D_ii. a reasonableness check with respect to the previous annual value, investigating any deviation in absolute value that exceeds the 10% threshold._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the Environment Colombia and CA Head or delegate, will return the file to the previous level, indicating, through a comment in the EDEN system and/or by sending an email, to the data entry manager a request for clarification/addition to the recorded data.  After the modification, the system automatically sends an e-mail to the data entry clerk in the EDEN system notifying the changes made._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result, the responsible for Head of Environment Col&CA, or delegate, validates the file approving it in "validated at country level" status. EDEN returns a notice warning of the responsibility assumed and from this moment on the form is no longer editable, becoming visible to the Environment Colombia and CA unit.

cells.S: Anualmente, una vez recibido el correo electrónico del Profesional de HSEQ Thermal COL, el Jefe de HSEQ Thermal Col & CA, o delegado, verifica la exactitud e integridad del calculo del indicador de emisión de NOx, SO₂ y PM (polvo material particulado total PST) de las plantas en las zonas densamente pobladas o cercanas, así:_x000D__x000D_1. El valor de las emisiones de NOx, SO₂ y PM (partículas suspendidas totales, PST) utilizado en el cálculo, coincida con el mismo valor reportado en EDEN;_x000D_2. The parameters adopted to identify densely populated or nearby areas exceed the defined population and contain supporting documentation (published by the National Statistics Department (DANE))._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of HSEQ Thermal Col or delegate requests the correction by email from the HSEQ Thermal COL professional._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of HSEQ Thermal COL or delegate sends an email confirming the correctness of the calculation of the indicators and requests the Head of Environment Col&CA to review.

cells.S: Una vez que el Head of Consolidación Chile o el delegado recibe vía correo electrónico, por parte del Jefe/especialista de Finance & Insurance, el monto del dividendo a pagar por acción, el Head of Consolidación Chile o el delegado, proceden a validar la consistencia de los cálculos realizados y el monto a pagar por cada dividendo, comparando el valor enviado por Finanzas con los cálculos realizados por él en el archivo "DIVIDENDOS PROVISORIOS  ENEL GX-DX-CHILE Y AMERICAS MM-YYYY.xls".En caso de resultado negativo (encontrando inconsistencias), el Head of Consolidación Chile o el delegado informa, vía e-mail, al Jefe/especialista de Finance & Insurance, para regularizar el cálculo del dividendo. En caso de resultado positivo (si no se encuentran inconsistencias), el Head of Consolidación Chile o el delegado da su aprobación, vía e-mail, al Jefe/especialista de Finance & Insurance, respecto del cálculo del dividendo.
cells.T: Once the Head of Consolidaciónn Chile or the designated delegate receives, via email from the Finance & Insurance Manager/Specialist, the dividend amount to be paid per share, the Head of Consolidación Chile or the delegate proceeds to validate the consistency of the calculations performed and the amount payable for each dividend by comparing the value provided by Finance with the calculations carried out in the file "DIVIDENDOS PROVISORIOS  ENEL GX-DX-CHILE Y AMERICAS MM-YYYY.xls".In case of negative result (i.e., inconsistencies are identified), the Head of Consolidación Chile or the delegate notifies the Finance & Insurance Manager/Specialist by email so that the dividend calculation can be corrected.In case of positive result (i.e., no inconsistencies are identified), the Head of Consolidación Chile or the delegate provides approval by email to the Finance & Insurance Manager/Specialist regarding the dividend calculation.

cells.S: Mensalmente, após receber o registro da PECLD enviada por e-mail pelo Analista de BPO-AFC, o Analista de RTR-GA verifica se todos os valores lançados de PECLD no Sistema SAP R/3 Eletropaulo_RP1_CCS_Produção- Módulo FI estão de acordo com o arquivo "Double Check_IFRS9_MMAAAA_EMPRESA.xls" através da transação ZSL_IFRS17/F.01/FS10N/SAP Analysis - Operational Reporting (OR) consolidando os inputs recebidos de Reporting e Compliance. Em caso de resultado negativo (se alguma inconsistência for identificada), o Analista de RTR-GA envia um e-mail para o Analista de BPO-AFC e/ou Analista de Reporting e Compliance para análise e realização dos ajustes se necessários. Em caso de resultado positivo (se não forem identificadas inconsistências), o Analista de RTR-GA envia um e-mail para o Analista de BPO-AFC aprovando o registro.
cells.T: Monthly, after receiving the PECLD record sent by email by the BPO-AFC Analyst, the RTR-GA Analyst checks whether all PECLD values ​​entered in the SAP R/3 Eletropaulo_RP1_CCS_Produção- Módulo FI system are in accordance with the file "Double Check_IFRS9_MMYYYY_COMPANY.xls" through transaction ZSL_IFRS17/F.01/FS10N/SAP Analysis - Operational Reporting (OR), consolidating the inputs received from Reporting and Compliance. In case of negative results (if any inconsistency is identified or if there is any doubt), the RTR-GA Analyst sends an email to the BPO-AFC Analyst and/or Reporting and Compliance Analyst to make the necessary adjustments. In case of positive results (if no inconsistencies are identified), the RTR-GA Analyst sends an email to the BPO-AFC Analyst approving the record.

O Analista BPO-AFC compara as informações das contas contábeis de Receita de fornecimento de energia por classe de consumo, Transporte de energia e Fornecimento, extraídas do SAP E4E D4P - GL, através da transação FBL3H, que contém os valores contabilizados na receita do mês, com o Razão Geral, extraído do SAP ISU Brasil, através da transação FPT8, recebido da unidade de Faturamento, e apresentado na planilha "Check Faturamento Empresa MMAAAA.xls", comparando os valores contabilizados na receita do mês._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado positivo (posição das planilhas conciliadas), o Analista BPO-AFC envia um e-mail ao Analista RTR-GA informando que os valores foram conciliados corretamente._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado negativo (a posição das transações não está conciliada), o Analista BPO-AFC envia um e-mail ao Analista RTR-GA informando que existem discrepâncias nos valores entre o SAP E4E D4P BR/GL e o SAP ISU apresentados no arquivo "Check Faturamento Empresa MMAAAA.xls" que precisam ser resolvidas.
cells.T: Monthly, the BPO-AFC Analyst reviews whether the billing amounts are the same in the SAP ISU Brazil and in SAP E4E D4P - BR / GL. The BPO-AFC Analyst compares the information from the accounting accounts of Revenue from energy supply by consumption class, Transport of energy and Supply, extracted from the SAP E4E D4P - GL, through transaction FBL3H, which contains the amounts accounted for in the revenue for the month, with the "General Ledger" extracted from the SAP ISU Brazil, through transaction FPT8 received from Billing Planning Perform Brasil unit, being shown in the worksheet "Check Billing Company MMYYYY.xls", the comparison of the values ​​accounted for in revenue for the month._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result (position of the worksheets are reconciled), the BPO-AFC Analyst sends an email to the RTR-GA Analyst informing them that the values ​​have been reconciled correctly._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result (the position of the transactions is not reconciled), the BPO-AFC Analyst sends an email to the RTR-GA Analyst informing that there are discrepancies in values ​​between SAP E4E D4P BR/GL vs. SAP ISU presented in the file "Check Billing Company MMYYYY.xls"that need to be resolved.

cells.S: Mensalmente, o Analista BPO-AFC analisa se a arrecadação no SAP ISU está de acordo com a arrecadação  registrada no SAP E4E D4P BR/GL, verificando se a planilha Excel "Razão Geral", extraída do sistema SAP E4E D4P BR/GL através da transação FBL3H, que contém os valores depositados em bancos e recebidos nas respectivas contas contábeis do mês, corresponde aos movimentos de recebimento e depósito extraídos do SAP ISU Brasil através da transação FP30. Tudo isso é comprovado pela impressão dos totais dos "Lotes de arrecadação" recebidos da unidade de Reporting e Compliance, arquivados na planilha Excel "Check Arrecadação Empresa AAAAMM"._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado positivo (os valores forem iguais), o Analista BPO-AFC envia um e-mail ao Analista RTR-GA, informando que os valores foram conciliados corretamente._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado neagtivo (os valores forem diferentes), o Analista BPO-AFC envia um e-mail ao Analista RTR-GA, informando que há divergências de valores entre SAP E4E D4P BR/GL e SAP ISU apresentados no arquivo"Check Arrecadação Empresa AAAAMM" que precisam ser resolvidas.
cells.T: Monthly, the BPO-AFC Analyst analyzes whether the SAP ISU collection matches the collection recorded in SAP E4E D4P BR/GL, verifying if the Excel file "General Ledger" extracted from the SAP E4E D4P BR/GL system through transaction FBL3H, which contains the amounts deposited in banks and collected in the corresponding accounting accounts for the month, matches the collection and deposit movements extracted from SAP ISU Brazil through transaction FP30 all being evidenced with the print of the totals of the "Collection Batches" received from Reporting and Compliance unit, archived in the Excel file "Check Collection Company YYYYMM"._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result (the values ​​are the same), the BPO-AFC Analyst sends an email to the RTR-GA Analyst, informing them that the values ​​have been reconciled correctly._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result (the values ​​are not the same), the BPO-AFC Analyst sends an email to the RTR-GA Analyst, informing that there are discrepancies in values ​​between SAP E4E D4P BR/GL vs. SAP ISU presented in the file  "Check Collection Company YYYYMM" that need to be resolved.

cells.S: Mensalmente, após receber do Analista BPO-AFC a planilha "Check Faturamento Empresa MMAAAA.xls", o Analista RTR-GA analisa se a faturamento corresponde entre as contas contábeis de Receita de fornecimento de energia por classe de consumo, Transporte de energia e Fornecimento, extraídas do SAP E4E D4P - GL, através da transação FBL3H/F.01/SAP Analysis - Operational Reporting (OR), que contém os valores contabilizados na receita do mês, com o "Razão Geral" extraído do SAP ISU Brasil, através da transação FPT8. Em caso de resultado positivo (as posições da planilha estão conciliadas), o Analista RTR-GA envia um e-mail ao Analista BPO-AFC e/ou ao Analista de Faturamento informando-os de que a validação foi bem-sucedida. Em caso de resultado negativo (as posições da transação não estão conciliadas), o Analista RTR-GA envia um e-mail ao Analista BPO-AFC e/ou ao Analista de Faturamento para análise e ajustes se necessários.
cells.T: Monthly, after receiving from the BPO-AFC Analyst the spreadsheet "Check Billing Company MMYYYY.xls", the RTR-GA Analyst analyzes whether the billing matches between the accounting accounts of Revenue from energy supply by consumption class, Transport of energy and Supply, extracted from the SAP E4E D4P - GL, through transaction FBL3H/F.01/SAP Analysis - Operational Reporting (OR), which contains the amounts accounted for in the revenue for the month, with the "General Ledger" extracted from the SAP ISU Brazil, through transaction FPT8.In case of positive result (the spreadsheet positions are reconciled), the RTR-GA Analyst sends an email to the BPO-AFC Analyst and the Billing Analyst informing them that the validation is successful.In case of negative result (the transaction positions are not reconciled), the RTR-GA Analyst sends an email to the BPO-AFC Analyst and/or the Billing Analyst to make the appropriate changes.

cells.M: Errata informativa di sostenibilità, dovuta all'utilizzo di dati (qualitativi o quantitativi) actual e/o stimati inaccurati/incompleti o all'omissione di dati (qualitativi o quantitativi) e stime
cells.N: Error in sustainability reporting, due to the use of inaccurate/incomplete actual and/or estimated data (qualitative or quantitative) or omission of data (qualitative or quantitative) and estimations
cells.S: Mensualmente, el Responsable de Quality of Service o su delegado, realiza con los datos provenientes del sistema CERTA - Gestor de Calidad (GDC) el calculo automático con soporte access de los siguientes KPIs: - SAIDI - SAIFI y luego realiza un control de gestión de los datos, comparando el KPI calculado por el sistema en la etapa de cierre con la estimación preliminar basada en la información disponible antes del cálculo y analiza toda desviación que prevea un deterioro respecto al cálculo preliminar.En caso de resultado negativo (desvíos detectados), el Responsable de Quality of Service o su delegado corrige dentro de su propia unidad los registros con información inconsistente, por otra parte, informa y solicita por e-mail a la unidad de Centros de Control de BT y MT la revisión de los procesos que originaron esos desvíos.En caso de un resultado positivo, el Responsable de Quality of Service o su delegado valida el resultado de los indicadores SAIDI y SAIFI y comparte los archivos utilizados para el cálculo con la unidad Construction and O&M Industrial Control (Global).
cells.T: Monthly, the Head of Quality of Service, or delegate, performs the automatic calculation with access support of the following KPIs with the data from the CERTA - Gestor de Calidad (GDC) system: - SAIDI - SAIFI and then performs a management check on the data, comparing the KPI calculated by the system at the closing stage with the preliminary estimation based on the information available prior the closing, analysing all variance that provides for a deterioration compared to the preliminary calculation.In case of negative result (detected deviations), the Head of Quality of Service, or delegate, corrects the records with inconsistent information within its own unit, on the other hand it informs and requests via e-mail the LV and MV Control Centers unit to review the processes that originated these deviations.In case of a positive result, the Head of Quality of Service, or delegate, validates the result of the SAIDI and SAIFI indicators and shares  the files used for the calculation to the Construction and O&M Industrial Control (Global) unit.

En caso de un resultado positivo, archivos del cálculo realizado resguardados digitalmente.
cells.AG: 1. In case of negative result (detection of deviations), email sent by the Head of Quality of Service or delegate to the unit responsible for the MV and LV Control Center providing details of the deviations so that they may review the processes that gave rise to them.2. In case of positive result, files of the calculation digitally archived.

cells.S: El Responsable de O&M Performance Management & Control Colombia, o delegado, con base en los cálculos automáticos generados desde la base de datos DATAMART de los siguientes KPIs:_x000D_-SAIDI_x000D_-SAIFI_x000D__x000D_realiza un control de revisión de los datos, comparando los KPIs calculados por DATAMART con las proyecciones generadas de los KPIs (Budget) y que tienen en cuenta los aportes de reducción de los proyectos de inversión de la compañia._x000D__x000D_En caso de identificar desviaciones de los KPIs vs el Budget, el Responsable de O&M Performance Management & Control Colombia, o delegado, solicita explicaciones dentro de su propia unidad para tratar de comprender la tendencia anormal, o solicitar el apoyo de las demas unidades de la compañia._x000D__x000D_En caso de no identificar desviaciones de los KPIs vs el Budget, o despues de la justificaciones de las deviaciones identificadas,  el Responsable de O&M Performance Management & Control Colombia o delegado inserta los datos en el formato requerido y compartido con la unidad de Control de Gestión del Desempeño de O&M (Global).
cells.T: The Responsible of O&M Performance Management & Control Colombia, or delegate, following the automatic calculations generated from the DATAMART database of the following KPIs:_x000D_-SAIDI_x000D_-SAIFI_x000D__x000D_performs a review control of the data, comparing the KPIs calculated by DATAMART with the projections generated from the KPIs (Budget) and that take into account the reduction contributions of the company's investment projects._x000D__x000D_In case of identifying deviations from the KPIs vs. the Budget, the Responsible of O&M Performance Management & Control Colombia, or delegate, requests explanations within their own unit to try to understand the abnormal trend, or try to request the support of the other units of the company._x000D__x000D_In case of not identifying deviations of the KPIs vs. the Budget, or after justifying the identified deviations, the Responsible of O&M Performance Management & Control Colombia, or delegate, inserts the data in the required format and share them with the O&M Performance Management & Control unit (Global).

cells.S: El profesional del area Performance Management and Control O&M Colombia realiza la auditoria para verificar por muestreo (metodologia de obtención de muestreo de acuerdo a la Guía: GRI-COL-GUI-OM-0001 Control y vigilancia de las interrupciones relacionadas con la continuidad del suministro eléctrico) el correcto registro de los datos de eventos e indicadores de calidad de suministro eléctrico en las redes AT-MT-BT ingresados en el sistema RETIM (Real Time Monitoring) (AT-MT), en la base de datos DATAMART y GEMAS (Global Events Management System) (BT)._x000D_ _x000D_En caso de identificar inconsistencias en el proceso de verificación, el profesional del area Performance Management and Control O&M Colombia determinara la tipologia de error de acuerdo a la la Guía: GRI-COL-GUI-OM-0001 Control y vigilancia de las interrupciones relacionadas con la continuidad del suministro eléctrico y se incluiran en el archivo RG02GRI-COL-GUI-OM-0001 Análisis Inconsistencias y Acciones Correctivas, los cuales se enviarán mediante correo electrónico a las Unidades Operativas o unidades organizativas responsables para su correspondiente seguimiento y gestión de planes de acción._x000D_ _x000D_En caso de resultado positivo de la verificación, el profesional del area Performance Management and Control O&M Colombia realiza la consolidación de los resultados de la verificación de la muestra en el RG01GRI-COL-GUI-OM-0001 Registro único de Eventos Auditados y los guarda digitalmente.
cells.T: The professional from the Performance Management and Control O&M Colombia area performs the audit to verify by sampling (methodology for obtaining sampling according to the Guide: GRI-COL-GUI-OM-0001 Control and monitoring of interruptions related to the continuity of power supply) the correct recording of event data and indicators of quality and electricity supply in the HV-MV-LV network entered in the RETIM (Real Time Monitoring) (HV-MV) system, in the DATAMART and GEMAS (Global Events Management System) (LV) databases._x000D__x000D_In case of identifying inconsistencies in the verification process, the professional from the Performance Management and Control O&M Colombia area will determine the type of error according to the Guide GRI-COL-COL-GUI-OM-0001 "Control and monitoring of interruptions related to the continuity of electricity supply" and will be included in the file RG02GRI-COL-COL-GUI-OM-0001 "Inconsistency Analysis and Corrective Actions", which will be sent by email to the Operating Units or organizational units responsible for their corresponding monitoring and management of action plans._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result, the professional from the Performance Management and Control O&M Colombia area consolidates the results of the verification of the sample in the RG01GRI-COL-GUI-OM-0001 "Single Record of Audited Events" digitally stored.
cells.AB: Leidy Yessenia Enchima Silva;
cells.AF: 1. En caso de identificar inconsistencias en el proceso de verificación, se conserva archivo RG02GRI-COL-GUI-OM-0001 Análisis Inconsistencias y Acciones Correctivas, los cuales se enviarán mediante correo electrónico a las Unidades Operativas o unidades organizativas responsables._x000D_2. consolidación de los resultados de la verificación de la muestra en el RG01GRI-COL-GUI-OM-0001 Registro único de Eventos Auditados almacenados digitalmente.
cells.AG: 1. In case of negative result, file RG02GRI-COL-COL-GUI-OM-0001 Inconsistency Analysis and Corrective Actions sent by email to the Operating Units or responsible organizational units._x000D_2. In case of positive result, consolidation of the results of the sample verification in the RG01GRI-COL-GUI-OM-0001 Single Record of Audited Events digitally stored.

cells.S: Uma vez calculados os KPIs SAIDI e SAIFI para Rio, Ceará e São Paulo, o Especialista em Operation Analysis BR (Network Operation BR) verifica os dados para fins gerenciais, comparando os KPIs calculados pelo sistema Spotfire Analytics com os resultados indicados pelas áreas locais. Além disso, verifica a consistência dos dados, por meio de uma análise realizada comparando o KPI calculado pelo sistema com o BDG (orçamento) previsto.Em caso de resultado positivo (quando não há divergências), o Especialista em Operation Analysis BR (Network Operation BR) elabora o documento "Apresentação Mensal de O&M Brazil' com os resultados para serem divulgados aos Responsáveis da Network Operativo BR e Enel Grids Brasil. Adicionalmente, o Especialista em Operation Analysis BR (Network Operation BR) envia o cálculo do SAIDI/SAIFI por e-mail para a unidade de Planning, Reporting Regulatory and Margin Control Brazil (Industrial Control Enel Grids Brazil) para que os KPIs sejam carregados no sistema New P.R.I.M.O.  e envia os dados para a unidade de Construction and O&M Industrial Control (Global).Em caso de resultado negativo (quando há divergências), o Especialista em Operation Analysis BR (Network Operation BR) junto com o responsável da unidade de ICT, efetuam os devidos ajustes na base do DataLake PM&C BR (Brasil), evidenciando o correto cálculo dos KPIs que são aderentes aos valores reportados na "Apresentação mensal de O&M Brazil'.
cells.T: Once the SAIDI and SAIFI KPIs have been calculated for Rio, Ceará and São Paulo, the Operation Analysis BR Specialist (Network Operation BR) checks the data for managerial purposes, comparing the KPIs calculated by the Spotfire Analytics system with the results indicated by the local units. In addition, verifies the consistency of the data, through an analysis performed comparing the KPI calculated by the system with the predicted Budget. In case of a positive result (when there are no discrepancies), the Operation Analysis Specialist BR (Network Operation BR) prepares the document "Monthly Presentation of O&M Brazil" with the results to be disclosed to the Responsibles of Network Operativo BR and Enel Grids Brazil. Additionally, the Operation Analysis Specialist BR (Network Operation BR) sends by e-mail the calculation of the SAIDI/SAIFI to the unit of Planning, Reporting Regulatory and Margin Control Brazil (Industrial Control Enel Grids Brazil) to upload the KPIs in the New P.R.I.M.O system and send the data to the Construction and O&M Industrial Control unit (Global) In case of a negative result (when there are discrepancies), the Operation Analysis Specialist BR (Network Operation BR) together with the responsible of the ICT unit, makes the necessary adjustments in the PM&C BR (Brazil) DataLake database, evidencing the correct calculation of the KPIs that adhere to the values reported in the "Monthly Presentation of O&M Brazil".

cells.S: Mensalmente, uma vez registradas no Sistema SDE (OPER BT/SAC) as interrupções relativas ao Ceará e ao Rio, de acordo com a política IO1209, o Especialista de O&M da Distribuidora verifica com o objetivo de garantir a exatidão e precisão das informações registradas que determinam os indicadores de qualidade de serviço através da verificação abaixo:_x000D__x000D_• Registo das interrupções com origem na rede AT, MT, BT, Subestações Primárias e Secundárias;_x000D_• Classificação da causa e origem das interrupções;_x000D_• Atualização de sistemas para garantir a consistência da rede;_x000D_• Gestão dos relatórios de avarias dos clientes e do processo de pagamento de indenizações aos clientes;_x000D__x000D_O tipo de interrupção é confirmado ou modificado pelo Operador da Distribuidora (O&M Local) ao qual foi atribuído o ticket no Sistema SDE, após a confirmação no campo do trecho da central de distribuição afetado pela falha._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado positivo (quando a equipe em campo não verifica qualquer anomalia nos dados da interrupção na rede de distribuição), o ticket é encerrado e o Operador da Distribuidora (O&M Local) excuta o adequado fechamento da ocorrência possibilitando a geração dos indicadores de continuidade para que o Especialista de O&M da Distribuidora envie por e-mail para o NO&M responsável._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado negativo (quando a equipe em campo  verifica qualquer anomalia nos dados da interrupção na rede de distribuição), o ticket deve ser corrigido e associado, caso necessário, à uma interrupção no Sistema Técnico de Gestão da Qualidade.
cells.T: Monthly, once the interruption related to Ceará and Rio are recorded in the SDE System (OPER BT/SAC), in accordance with the IO1209 policy, the NO&M specialist checks with the aim to ensure the correctness and accuracy of the recorded information that determines the quality of service indicators through the below verifies:_x000D__x000D_• Registration to the interruptions originating on the HV, MV, LV network, Primary and Secondary Substations;_x000D_• Classification of the cause and the origin of the interruptions;_x000D_• Updating of systems to ensure the network consistency;_x000D_• Management of the customer reports of faults and the payment process of compensation to customers;_x000D__x000D_The type of disruption is confirmed or modified by the NO&M specialist who has been assigned the ticket in the SDE System, following the confirmation in the field of the distribution plant section affected by the fault. _x000D__x000D_In case of a positive result (when the field team does not find any anomaly in the data on the interruption in the distribution network), the ticket is closed and the Distributor Operator (Local O&M) performs the appropriate closure of the occurrence, enabling the generation of continuity indicators for the Distributor's O&M Specialist to send them by email to the responsible NO&M._x000D__x000D_In case of a negative result (when the field team finds any anomaly in the data on the interruption in the distribution network), the ticket must be corrected and associated, if necessary, with an interruption in the Technical Quality Management System.

Em caso de resultado positivo, e-mail enviado pelo Especialista em O&M da Distribuidora com informações sobre o comportamento dos indicadores mensais DEC/SAIDI e FEC/SAIFI para o NO&M responsável;_x000D_5. Em caso de resultado negativo, repositório definido pela Global para alocação dos comprovantes (arquivos excel) das correções mensais realizadas.

In case of a negative result, repository defined by Global for allocation of evidence (excel files) of monthly corrections made.

cells.M: Errata informativa di sostenibilità, dovuta all'utilizzo di dati (qualitativi o quantitativi) actual e/o stimati inaccurati/incompleti o all'omissione di dati (qualitativi o quantitativi) e stime

cells.S: Visualizzate su EDEN le schede approvate dai Responsabili delle unità Environment di Country relative ai dati inerenti il consumo di combustibile fossile per la produzione negli impianti termoelettrici utilizzati nell'ambito del calcolo delle metriche relative allo Scope 1 e per gli Indicatori di energy consumption, il Responsabile dell’unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX), o delegato, provvede ad effettuare:i) un controllo di completezza, verificando che i Responsabili delle unità Environment di Country abbiano inserito tutti i dati nelle schede sul sistema EDEN.ii) un controllo di ragionevolezza confrontando la variazione percentuale del dato del consumo di combustibile rispetto all'anno precedente con la variazione percentuale del dato della produzione rispetto all'anno precedente, indagando su eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%.  In caso di esito negativo del controllo, il Responsabile dell’unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX), o delegato, provvede a rimandare la scheda al livello precedente indicando, tramite commento a sistema e/o invio e-mail, all'addetto dell'inserimento dati una richiesta di chiarimento/integrazione sui dati registrati, rettificando eventuali valori anomali riscontrati.A seguito della modifica, il sistema invia automaticamente una mail all'inseritore del dato sul sistema EDEN per la notifica dei cambiamenti effettuati.In caso di esito positivo del controllo, il Responsabile dell’unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX), o delegato, provvede a validare la scheda tramite l’approvazione in stato “validato a livello GBL”: EDEN restituisce un avviso che avverte sulla responsabilità intrapresa e da questo momento in poi la scheda non è più modificabile, diventando visibile dal Responsabile dell'unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition.
cells.T: Displayed on EDEN the sheet filled in by the Responsible of each Environment Country unit regarding data related to Combustion of fossil fuel related to thermoelectric energy production used within the calculation of the metrics related to the Scope 1 and Energy consumption indicators, the Responsible of theEnvironmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) unit, or his delegate, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that all Responsible of each Environment Country unit have been uploaded the data into the EDEN system.ii) a reasonableness check by comparing the percentage change in the fuel consumption data compared to the previous year with the percentage change in the production data compared to the previous year, investigating any deviations in absolute value higher than the 20% threshold.In case of negative result, the Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) Responsible, or delegate, proceed to send back the sheet to the previous level notifying, through a comment in the system and/or sending an e-mail, to the Operator a request for clarification / integration of the recorded data, modifying any anomalous values found.Following the modification, the system automatically sends an e-mail to the Operator in the EDEN system to notify the changes made.In case of positive result, the Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) Responsible, or delegate, validates the sheet through the approval status "validated at GBL level": EDEN returns a message to the approver regarding the responsibility connected to the validation process and from this moment onwards the sheet can no longer be modified, becoming visible to the Responsible of  ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition

cells.S: Visualizzata su EDEN la scheda approvata dai Responsabili Environment di tutte le Country relativa ai dati inerenti il consumo di combustibile fossile nei motori ausiliari per attività di distribuzione dell'energia utilizzati nell'ambito del calcolo delle seguenti metriche: a) Total direct emissions (Scope 1)b)  Other CO2eq emissions due to electricity production and other activitiesc) Specific CO₂eq emissions from Scope 1d) Indicatori di energy consumptionil Responsabile dell’unità Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation), o delegato, provvede ad effettuare:i) un controllo di completezza, verificando che tutti i Responsabili Environment di tutte le Country abbiano caricato i dati sul sistema EDEN. ii) un controllo di ragionevolezza rispetto al valore annuale precedente, indagando su eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%. In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'unità Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation), o delegato, provvede a rimandare la scheda al livello precedente indicando, tramite commento a sistema e/o invio e-mail, all'addetto dell'inserimento dati una richiesta di chiarimento/integrazione sui dati registrati, rettificando eventuali valori anomali riscontrati.A seguito della modifica, il sistema invia automaticamente una mail all'inseritore del dato sul sistema EDEN per la notifica dei cambiamenti effettuati.In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'unità Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation), o delegato, provvede a validare la scheda tramite l’approvazione in stato “validato a livello GBL”: EDEN restituisce un avviso che avverte sulla responsabilità intrapresa e da questo momento in poi la scheda non è più modificabile, diventando visibile dal Responsabile dell'Unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition
cells.T: Displayed on EDEN the sheet filled in by the Environment Responsible of each Country unit regarding data related to combustion of fossil fuels in auxiliary engines for energy distribution activities used within the calculation of the following metrics:a) Total direct emissions (Scope 1)b)  Other CO2eq emissions due to electricity production and other activitiesc) Specific CO₂eq emissions from Scope  1d) Energy consumption indicatorsthe Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation) Responsible, or delegate, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that the Environment Responsible of each Country unit have been uploaded the data into the EDEN system.ii) a reasonableness check compared to the previous annual value, investigating any deviations in absolute value higher than the 20% threshold. In case of negative result, the Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation) Responsible, or delegate, proceeds to send back the sheet to the previous level notifying, through a comment in the system and/or sending an e-mail, to the Operator a request for clarification / integration of the recorded data, modifying any anomalous values found.Following the modification, the system automatically sends an e-mail to the Operator on the EDEN system to notify the changes made.In case of positive result, the Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation) Responsible, or delegate, validates the sheet through the approval status "validated at GBL level" status: EDEN returns a message to the approver regarding the responsibility connected to the validation process and from this moment onwards the sheet can no longer be modified, becoming visible to the  ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition unit Responsible.

cells.T: Displayed on EDEN the sheet filled in by the Operator of Energy Balance and Losses Management (Enel Grids & Innovation) regarding data related to Technical losses from the grid used within the scope of the following metrics: _x000D_i) Scope 2 calculation, market based - Total indirect emissions_x000D_ii) Scope 2, location based - Total indirect emissions_x000D_iii) Energy consumption indicators,_x000D_the Energy Balance and Losses Management (Enel Grids & Innovation) Responsible, or delegate, carries out:_x000D_i) a completeness check by verifying that the data sent by all country owners concerning the percentage of technical losses recorded on the grids is inserted into EDEN system.  _x000D_ii) a reasonableness check with respect to the previous annual value, investigating possible deviations in absolute value higher than the 10% threshold._x000D_In case of negative result, the Energy Balance and Losses Management (Enel Grids & Innovation) Responsible, or delegate, provide to contacts the Responsible of the GBL grid Analysis unit  in orderto obtain clarifications on the data received._x000D_In case of positive result, the Energy Balance and Losses Management (Enel Grids & Innovation) Responsible, or delegate, validates the sheet through the approval status  "validated at GBL level": EDEN returns a message to the approver regarding the responsibility connected to the validation process and from this moment onwards the sheet can no longer be modified, becoming visible to the responsible of the ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability) unit.

cells.S: Ricevuti i dati dai Responsabili delle unità Network Analysis di Country inerenti alle perdite tecniche della rete utilizzati nell'ambito del calcolo delle metriche: i) Scope 2, market based - Total indirect emissions ii) Scope 2, location based - Total indirect emissionsiii) Indicatori di energy consumption,il Responsabile dell'unità Grids Analysis & Network Assessment (Enel Grids and Innovation), o delegato, provvede ad effettuare:i) un controllo di completezza, verificando che tutte le unità Network Analysis di Country abbiano fornito il dato relativo alle perdite tecniche di rete. ii) un controllo di ragionevolezza rispetto al valore semestrale precedente relativo ai dati sulle perdite tecniche di rete, indagando su eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%. In caso di esito negativo del controllo, il Responsabile dell'unità Grids Analysis & Network Assessment (Enel Grids and Innovation), o delegato, provvede a contattare via e-mail il Responsabile della competente unità Network Analysis di Country per ottenere delucidazioni sui dati ottenuti, il quale provvede a rettificare il dato. In caso di esito positivo del controllo, il Responsabile dell'unità Grids Analysis & Network Assessment (Enel Grids and Innovation), o delegato, condivide il dato relativo alle perdite tecniche di rete con l'Unità Energy Balance and Losses Management (Enel Grids & Innovation).
cells.T: Received data from the Responsible of the Country Grid Analysis units related to  Technical losses from the grid  used within the scope of the following metrics: i) Scope 2 calculation, market based - Total indirect emissions ii) Scope 2, location based - Total indirect emissionsiii) Energy consumption indicators,the Grids Analysis & Network Assessment (Enel Grids and Innovation) Responsible, or delegate, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that all the Country Network Analysis units have been provided the data related to technical grid losses ii) a reasonableness check against the previous six-monthly value relating to data on technical grid losses, investigating any deviations in absolute value higher than the 20% threshold. In case of a negative result of the check, the Grids Analysis & Network Assessment (Enel Grids and Innovation) Responsible, or delegate, provides to contact the Responsible of the competent Country Network Analysis unit by e-mail in order to obtain clarifications on the data obtained, wich proceeds to modify the data. In case of a positive result of the check, the Grids Analysis & Network Assessment (Enel Grids and Innovation) Responsible, or delegate, proceeds to forward the data obtained on the technical grid losses by e-mail to the Energy Balance and Losses Management (Enel Grids & Innovation).

cells.T: After the upload on EDEN of data related to renewable fuel consumption by the Country Environment Units Responsible, the Environmental Model Development Responsible (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), or delegate, carries out:_x000D_i) a completeness check, verifying that all data collected from the individual operational areas have been correctly uploaded into the EDEN system;_x000D_ii) a consistency check with historical values, investigating any deviations higher than the 20% threshold._x000D__x000D_In case of a negative result of the check, the Environmental Model Development Responsible (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), or delegate, sends the form back to the previous level for data integration or clarification of missing or inconsistent information, before proceeding with the final approval._x000D_In case of a positive result of the check, the Environmental Model Development Responsible (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), or delegate, proceeds with the validation of the form.

cells.S: Visualizzate su EDEN le schede approvate dai Responsabili delle unità Environment di Country relative ai dati inerenti il consumo di combustibili rinnovabili utilizzati per gli Indicatori di energy consumption, il Responsabile dell’unità Environment (HSEQ GBL EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, provvede ad effettuare:_x000D__x000D_i) un controllo di completezza, verificando che i Responsabili delle unità Environment di Country abbiano inserito tutti i dati nelle schede sul sistema EDEN._x000D_ii) un controllo di ragionevolezza confrontando la variazione percentuale del dato del consumo di combustibile rispetto all'anno precedente con la variazione percentuale del dato della produzione rispetto all'anno precedente, indagando su eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%.  _x000D__x000D_In caso di esito negativo del controllo, il Responsabile dell’unità Environment (HSEQ GBL EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, provvede a rimandare la scheda al livello precedente indicando, tramite commento a sistema e/o invio e-mail, all'addetto dell'inserimento dati una richiesta di chiarimento/integrazione sui dati registrati, rettificando eventuali valori anomali riscontrati._x000D_A seguito della modifica, il sistema invia automaticamente una mail all'inseritore del dato sul sistema EDEN per la notifica dei cambiamenti effettuati._x000D_In caso di esito positivo del controllo, il Responsabile dell’unità Environment (HSEQ GBL EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, provvede a validare la scheda tramite l’approvazione in stato “validato a livello GBL”: EDEN restituisce un avviso che avverte sulla responsabilità intrapresa e da questo momento in poi la scheda non è più modificabile, diventando visibile dai Responsabili delle unità Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting (Environment – P&O Holding) and ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition.
cells.T: Once the forms approved by the Country Environment Units Responsible, related to renewable fuel consumption data used for Energy Consumption Indicators, are displayed on EDEN, the Environment Responsible (HSEQ GBL EGP and Thermal Generation), or delegate, carries out:_x000D__x000D_i) a completeness check, verifying that the Country Environment Units Responsible have entered all the required data in the forms on the EDEN system;_x000D_ii) a reasonableness check, comparing the percentage variation in fuel consumption data with the percentage variation in production data compared to the previous year, investigating any absolute deviations higher than the 20% threshold._x000D__x000D_In case of a negative result of the check, the Environment Responsible (HSEQ GBL EGP and Thermal Generation), or delegate, sends the form back to the previous level, indicating through a comment in the system and/or by e-mail a request for clarification or integration of the recorded data, and correcting any anomalous values identified._x000D_After the modification, the system automatically sends an e-mail notification on EDEN to the data submitter to inform them of the changes made._x000D_In case of a positive result of the check, the Environment Responsible (HSEQ GBL EGP and Thermal Generation), or delegate, proceeds to validate the form by approving it with the status “validated at GBL level.”: at this stage, EDEN displays a notice reminding of the responsibility undertaken, and the form becomes no longer editable, being visible to the Responsible of Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting (Environment – P&O Holding) and ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition units.

cells.S: Calcolati i valori degli indicatori relativi all'Energy consumption, il Responsabile dell'Unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability), o delegato, provvede ad effettuare:i) un controllo di completezza sugli indicatori, verificando che tutte le componenti degli stessi siano calcolate.ii) un controllo di ragionevolezza, verificando tutte le variazioni in valore assoluto superiori al 10%.In caso di esito negativo del controllo, il Responsabile dell'Unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability), o delegato, provvede a contattare via e-mail il Responsabile dell'unità GBL competente per ottenere delucidazioni.In caso di esito positivo del controllo, il Responsabile dell'Unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability), o delegato, provvede ad informare Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler per il caricamento dei dati su Digital S.
cells.T: Calculated the values of indicators related to Energy consumption, the Responsible of ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability) Unit, or delegate, carries out:i) a completeness check on indicators, verifying that all their components are calculated.ii) a reasonableness check, by verifying all the variations in absolute value higher than 10%.  In case of a negative result of the check, the Responsible of ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability) Unit, or delegate, contacts the Responsible of the competent GBL unit by e-mail to obtain clarifications. In case of a positive result of the check, the Responsible of ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability) Unit, or delegate, informs Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler for the upload of data on Digital S.

cells.S: Ricevuta comunicazione riguardante l'avvenuto caricamento in Digital S da parte di Staff & Services Digital Enabler (Global ICT), il Responsabile dell'Unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition, o delegato, provvede ad effettuare un controllo di congruenza sugli indicatori relativi all'Energy consumption, verificando l'importo calcolato su Digital S con quanto calcolato dal sistema EDEN tramite costruzione di tabelle di confronto estratte dai rispettivi sistemi e recanti i dati raccolti su tutti gli indicatori. In caso di esito negativo del controllo, il Responsabile dell'Unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition, o delegato, verifica eventuali problematiche in sede di caricamento / calcolo nel sistema tramite la convocazione di una riunione con Staff & Services Digital Enabler (Global ICT) ed in caso di accertato errore richiede nuovamente allo stesso team responsabile di procedere al caricamento dei dati aggiornati.In caso di esito positivo del controllo, il Responsabile dell'Unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition, o delegato, valida in via definitiva gli indicatori in Digital S
cells.T: Once the communication regarding the upload in Digital S has been received by the Staff & Services Digital Enabler (Global ICT), the Responsible of ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition Unit, or delegate, carries out a consistency check on the indicators related to Energy consumption, verifying the amount calculated on Digital S with the amount calculated by the EDEN system through the construction of comparison tables extracted from the respective systems and containing the data collected on all indicators.In case of a negative result of the check, the Responsible of ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition Unit, or delegate, verifies possible problems in the loading/calculation in the system through the convocation of a meeting with Staff & Services Digital Enabler (Global ICT) and in case of ascertained error asks again the same responsible team to proceed to the loading of updated data.In case of a positive result of the check, the Responsible of ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition Unit, or delegate, definitively validates the indicators on Digital S.

cells.S: Una volta che i dati sono stati validati dalle unità di Environment Holding, il Responsabile Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler, o un suo delegato, procede a migrare i dati presenti su EDEN - Sustainability in Digital S._x000D_In caso di esito negativo (ossia in presenza di una migrazione dei dati incompleta o errata), Digital S notifica automaticamente via e-mail al Responsabile Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler, o ad un suo delegato, le informazioni relative agli errori riscontrati (codice errore, codice indicatore, tipo di errore rilevato), al fine di procedere con l’analisi e la risoluzione degli stessi, rilanciando la migrazione per gli indicatori sui quali è stato individuato il problema._x000D_In caso di esito positivo (ossia in presenza di una migrazione dei dati completa e corretta), Digital S notifica automaticamente via e-mail l’avvenuta migrazione al Responsabile Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler, o a un suo delegato._x000D_A seguito dell’esito positivo, il Responsabile Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler, o un suo delegato, informa i referenti del sistema Digital e l’unità Sustainability Reporting (Administration HLD) dell’avvenuta migrazione dei dati.
cells.T: Once the data have been validated by the Environment Holding units, the Head of Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler or delegate, proceeds to migrate the data present on EDEN - Sustainability on Digital S._x000D_In case of negative result, (there is an incomplete/incorrect data migration), Digital S automatically notifies by email to the Head of Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler, or delegate, the information on the recorded errors (error code, indicator code, type of error detected), in order to proceed to analyse and solve them, relaunching the migration for the indicators on which the problem has been detected._x000D_In case of positive result, (there is a complete/correct migration of the data), the Digital S automatically notifies the successful migration by e-mail to the Head of Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler, or delegate. Following the positive result, the Head of Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler, or delegate, informs the referents of Digital system and the referents of Sustainability Reporting within  Administration HLD unit of the successful migration of the data.
cells.AB: Giulio Pavoni;
cells.AF: 1) In caso di esito negativo, invio di un’e-mail al Responsabile Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler o al suo delegato con le informazioni sugli errori registrati, al fine di procedere all’analisi e alla loro risoluzione;2) In caso di esito positivo, invio di un’e-mail al Responsabile Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler o al suo delegato per informarli della corretta migrazione.
cells.AG: 1) In case of negative result, email sent to the Head of Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler or delegate with the information on the recorded errors in order to proceed to analyze and solve them;2) In case of positive result, email sent to the Head of Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler or delegate to inform them of the correct migration.

cells.G: ENEL S.P.A.
cells.M: Incompleta/inaccurata/errata classificazione delle attività economiche del Gruppo secondo le tre categorie previste (eligible-aligned, eligible-not aligned, not eligible)
cells.N: Incomplete/inaccurate/incorrect classification of the Group's economic activities according to the three expected categories (eligible-aligned, eligible-not aligned, not eligible)
cells.S: Il Responsabile dell'Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), o delegato, verifica che per tutte le attività economiche sia stato ottenuto il feedback dell'analisi DNSH e del rispetto dei pilastri di Garanzie Minime di Salvaguardia Sociale previsti all'art. 18  al fine di assicurare la conformità delle informazioni elaborate rispetto ai requisiti previsti dal Regolamento 2020/852 ed effettuando anche un'analisi di scostamento rispetto l'anno precedente nel caso in cui le attività cambino classificazione tra un anno e l'altro (eligible-aligned, eligible-not aligned, not eligible).In caso di mancato feedback sulle fasi DNSH e Garanzie Minime o in caso di scostamenti, il Responsabile dell'Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), o delegato, richiede chiarimenti e/o integrazioni alle Unità competenti prima di procedere alla fase successiva.In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), o delegato, convalida le informazioni e le consolida e trasmette all’Unità Reporting and Performance Control (Group Planning and Control) nel file excel "EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx - Metrics".
cells.T: The Head of the Sustainability Reporting Unit (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), or delegate, checks that for all economic activities the feedback from the DNSH analysis and the assessment of compliance with the Minimum Social Safeguards set out in Article 18 has been obtained, in order to ensure that the information produced complies with the requirements of Regulation 2020/852. The Head also performs a variance analysis against the previous year in cases where the activities change classification from one year to the next (eligible-aligned, eligible-not aligned, not eligible).If feedback on the DNSH and Minimum Safeguards assessments is missing, or if variances are identified, the Head of the Sustainability Reporting Unit (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), or delegate, requests clarifications and/or additional information from the competent Units before proceeding to the next phase.In case of positive result, the Head of the Sustainability Reporting Unit (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), or delegate, validates and consolidates the information and transmits it to the Reporting and Performance Control Unit (Group Planning and Control) in the Excel file ‘EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx – Metrics’.
cells.AB: Laura Faraone;Rossella Rocca;PAOLO PIRRI;
cells.AF: 1.File Excel "EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx" e file excel "EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx – Metrics"._x000D_2. In caso di scostamenti,  eventuali richiesta di integrazione e/o la correzione dei dati alle Unità competenti._x000D_3. In caso di esito positivo, email inviata all'Unità Reporting and Performance Control (Group Planning and Control) contente l'excel "EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx – Metrics".
cells.AG: 1) Excel file ‘EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx’ and Excel file ‘EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx – Metrics’._x000D_2) In case of variances, any requests for integration and/or corrections of the data sent to the competent Units._x000D_3) In case of positive result, sending of the email to the Reporting and Performance Control Unit (Group Planning and Control) containing the ‘EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx – Metrics’ Excel file.

cells.S: Il Responsabile dell'Unità Planning and Reporting (Industrial Control GECM and CPO), o delegato, a valle della raccolta dati necessari al calcolo del KPI relativo al Turnover per tutte le attività appartenenti alle GBL Enel Green Power and Thermal Generation, Nuclear e Trading, e con dettaglio per Country verifica la correttezza e completezza dei dati comparando gli stessi con i medesimi valori dell'anno precedente, indagando eventuali scostamenti identificati a livello di singola country._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Planning and Reporting (Industrial Control GECM and CPO), o delegato, contatta le Unità di P&C di Country per richiedere chiarimenti e/o le dovute correzioni._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Planning and Reporting (Industrial Control GECM and CPO), o delegato, trasmette i dati validati all'Unità Reporting and Performance Control (Group Planning and Control) per la fase di consolidamento.
cells.T: The Head of the Planning and Reporting Unit (Industrial Control GECM and CPO), or delegate, after collecting the data required to calculate the KPI relating to Turnover for all activities belonging to the GBLs Enel Green Power and Thermal Generation, Nuclear and Trading, and broken down by Country, checks the accuracy and completeness of the data by comparing them with the same values from the previous year and investigating any variances identified at Country level._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of the Planning and Reporting Unit (Industrial Control GECM and CPO), or delegate, contacts the Country P&C Units to request clarifications and/or the necessary corrections._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of the Planning and Reporting Unit (Industrial Control GECM and CPO), or delegate, sends the validated data to the Reporting and Performance Control Unit (Group Planning and Control) for the consolidation phase

cells.M: Cálculo incorreto/falta do teste de imparidade de acordo com a metodologia do Grupo
cells.N: Incorrect /Missing execution of the impairment test calculation based on the Group's methodology
cells.S: Mediante solicitação, após a identificação de um trigger event, o Especialista em Financial Statement atualiza os valores e as rubricas do grupo de contas, definidos na planilha "CIN_MM_YYYY" e sujeitos ao teste de Impairment, que contêm o detalhamento dos saldos conforme as rubricas do balanço patrimonial, elaborados com base nos critérios do processo de preparação das demonstrações financeiras e em conformidade com os saldos de contas do SAP E4E._x000D_Após atualizar a planilha "CIN_MM_YYYY", o Especialista em Financial Statement envia o arquivo por e-mail ao Responsável de Financial Statement para revisão, visando garantir a apresentação correta dos saldos de contas sujeitos ao teste de Impairment._x000D_Em caso de resultado negativo (se forem encontradas divergências), o Responsável de Financial Statement solicita, por e-mail, que o Especialista de Responsável de Financial Statement realize as correções necessárias na planilha "CIN_MM_YYYY"._x000D_Em caso de resultado positivo (se não forem identificadas divergências), o Responsável de Financial Statement valida o arquivo "CIN_MM_YYYY" por e-mail e o encaminha ao Especialista de Planning, Reporting, Finance Control, and P&C Staff and Industrial Control Services para a realização do teste de Impairment.
cells.T: Upon request, after the identification of a trigger event, the Financial Statement Specialist updates the values ​​and line items of the account group, defined in the "CIN_MM_YYYY" spreadsheet, that are subject to the impairment test, which contains a breakdown of balances according to the line items of the balance sheet, prepared using the criteria of the financial statement preparation process, in accordance with the account balances of SAP E4E. _x000D_After updating the "CIN_MM_YYYY" spreadsheet, the Financial Statement Specialist sends the file by email to the Financial Statement Responsible for review, in order to ensure the correct presentation of the account balances subject to the impairment test._x000D_In case of negative result (if discrepancies are found), the Financial Statement Responsible requests by email that the Financial Statement Specialist make the necessary corrections to the "CIN_MM_YYYY" spreadsheet._x000D_In case of positive result (if no discrepancies are identified), the Financial Statements Responsible validates the "CIN_MM_YYYY" file via email and forwards it to the Specialist of Planning, Reporting, Finance Control, and P&C Staff and Industrial Control Services to perform the impairment test.

cells.G: ENEL S.P.A.
cells.M: Incompleta/inaccurata/errata identificazione delle attività economiche del Gruppo
cells.N: Incomplete/inaccurate/incorrect identification of the Group's economic activities
cells.S: Annualmente, il Responsabile dell’Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), o suo delegato, a valle dell'aggiornamento dell'elenco di attività economiche del Gruppo, con il supporto dell'Unità Reporting and Performance Control (Group Planning and Control), verifica, all’interno dell’apposito file Excel “EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx”, la completezza e correttezza dell'elenco e della relativa riconciliazione con le attività previste dalla Tassonomia EU, tenendo conto:- dell’evoluzione del quadro normativo di riferimento (es. aggiornamenti degli atti delegati o dei criteri tecnici di vaglio); - di eventuali modifiche derivanti da decisioni aziendali (es. acquisizioni, dismissioni o cambi di modello operativo).In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell’Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), o suo delegato, provvede ad aggiornare l'elenco e/o la riconciliazione all’interno del file Excel “EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx”.In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell’Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), o suo delegato, procede all'invio del file “EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx” ai Business Owners per l'analisi del contributo sostanziale.
cells.T: Annually, the Head of the Sustainability Reporting Unit (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), or delegate, following the update of the list of the Group's economic activities, with the support of the Reporting and Performance Control Unit (Group Planning and Control), verifies, within the appropriate Excel file “EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx”, the completeness and correctness of the list and its reconciliation with the activities provided for by the EU Taxonomy, taking into account:- developments in the regulatory framework (e.g., updates to delegated acts or technical screening criteria); - any changes resulting from corporate decisions (e.g., acquisitions, disposals, or changes in operating model).In case of a negative result, the Head of the Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), or delegate, shall update the list and/or reconciliation within the Excel file “EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx”.In case of a positive result, the Head of the Sustainability Reporting Unit (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), or delegate, sends the Excel file “EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx” to the Business Owners for analysis of the material contribution.

cells.S: A valle della ricezione dei feedback da parte dei Business Owner circa il rispetto dei criteri tecnici delle attività economiche del Gruppo considerate eleggibili ai sensi della Tassonomia UE, il Responsabile dell’Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), o suo delegato, provvede a  verificare all'interno dell'apposito file Excel “EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx” la completezza e correttezza delle informazioni fornite rispetto a quanto richiesto dalla normativa (e.g. atti delegati).In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell’Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), o suo delegato, richiede chiarimenti e/o integrazioni ai Business Owner delle singole attività.In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell’Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), o suo delegato, aggiorna il file excel “EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx” e lo archivia in formato digitale, indicando quali attività rispettano o meno i requisiti tecnici e lo condivide con l’Unità Environment (P&O Holding) e ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (Sustainability) per le fasi successive di analisi.
cells.T: Following receipt of feedback from Business Owners regarding compliance with the technical criteria for the Group's economic activities considered eligible under the EU Taxonomy, the Head of the Sustainability Reporting Unit (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), or delegate, shall verify the completeness and accuracy of the information provided in the appropriate Excel file “EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx” with respect to the requirements of the regulations (e.g., delegated acts) .In case of a negative result, the Head of the Sustainability Reporting Unit (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), or delegate, requests clarifications and/or additions from the Business Owners of the individual activities.In case of a positive result, the Head of the Sustainability Reporting Unit (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting), or delegate, updates the Excel file “EU Taxonomy Statement 20xx” and archives it in digital format, indicating which activities comply or do not comply with the technical requirements, and shares it with the Environment Unit (P&O Holding) and ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (Sustainability) for the subsequent stages of analysis.
