cells.M: Inaccurata/errata identificazione delle attività che rispettano il principio Do Not Significant Harm
cells.N: Incomplete/inaccurate/incorrect identification of the activities that respect the Do Not Significant harm principle
cells.S: Una volta ricevuto dall’Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability) l’elenco delle attività economiche eleggibili che rispettano i criteri previsti per l'analisi del contributo sostanziale secondo obiettivo  "Mitigazione dei Cambiamenti Climatici", il Responsabile dell'Unità Environment (P&O Holding), o suo delegato, verifica, all'interno di un'apposita una matrice "Do No Significant Harm" (DNSH) contenuta in un file Excel, per la valutazione del "Do No Significant Harm" (DNSH), così come stabiliti dagli Atti Delegati della Tassonomia UE, sulla base delle evidenze prodotte dalle Unità di Environment (Global Business Lines/Countries)/Business Owners.In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environment (P&O Holding), o suo delegato, evidenzia all'interno del file excel relativo alle attività economiche eleggibili, le attività per cui il principio DNSH non è rispettato e archivia digitalmente in pdf le matrici "Do No Significant Harm" (DNSH) a supporto delle analisi eseguite. In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environment (P&O Holding), o suo delegato, evidenzia all'interno del file excel relativo alle attività economiche eleggibili, le attività per cui il principio DHSH è rispettato e archivia digitalmente in pdf le matrici "Do No Significant Harm" (DNSH) a supporto delle analisi eseguite.Al termine delle verifiche il Responsabile dell'Unità Environment (P&O Holding), o suo delegato, sintetizza gli esiti della verifica all'interno di un DNSH Assessment Report e lo condivide via email con l'Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting).
cells.T: Once the Sustainability Reporting Unit (Group Financial and Sustainability) has received the list of eligible economic activities that meet the criteria for the analysis of the substantial contribution according to the “Climate Change Mitigation” objective, the Head of the Environment Unit (P&O Holding), or delegate, verifies, within a specific “Do No Significant Harm” (DNSH) matrix contained in an Excel file, for the assessment of “Do No Significant Harm” (DNSH), as established by the Delegated Acts of the EU Taxonomy, based on the evidence produced by the Environment Units (Global Business Lines/Countries)/Business Owners.In case of a negative result, the Head of the Environment Unit (P&O Holding), or delegate, highlights in the Excel file relating to eligible economic activities those activities for which the DNSH principle is not respected and digitally archives the “Do No Significant Harm” (DNSH) matrices in pdf format to support the analyses performed. In case of a positive result, the Head of the Environment Unit (P&O Holding), or delegate, highlights in the Excel file relating to eligible economic activities those activities for which the DHSH principle is complied with and digitally archives the “Do No Significant Harm” (DNSH) matrices in PDF format to support the analyses performed.At the end of the checks, the Head of the Environment Unit (P&O Holding), or delegate, summarizes the results of the check in a DNSH Assessment Report and shares it via email with the Sustainability Reporting Unit (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting).

cells.G: ENEL S.P.A.
cells.M: Inaccurata/errata determinazione delle condizioni necessarie a garantire il rispetto delle condizioni minime di salvaguardia sociale
cells.N: Inaccurate/incorrect determination of the conditions necessary to ensure compliance with minimum social protection requirements
cells.S: A valle del completamento dell'analisi circa il rispetto del principio di Do Not Significant Harm, il Responsabile dell’Unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability), o suo delegato, procede alla raccolta e verifica dei documenti necessari a verificare il rispetto dei pilastri di Garanzie Minime di Salvaguardia Sociale previsti all'art. 18 del Regolamento della Tassonomia Europea.In particolare:- con riferimento al pilastro dei diritti umani, la verifica si basa sul processo di due diligence del Gruppo;- con riferimento agli altri tre pilastri (fiscalità, anticorruzione e governance), la verifica viene effettuata sulla base della documentazion prodotta in collaborazione con le Unità competenti – Audit, Tax, Legal e Compliance – con l’obiettivo di confermare l’assenza di cambiamenti materiali nel corso dell’anno di riferimento.In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell’Unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability), o suo delegato, segnala le eventuali non conformità o carenze documentali alle Unità competenti, richiedendo integrazioni o chiarimenti.In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell’Unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability), o suo delegato, conferma via email all'Unità Sustainability Reporting (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting) il rispetto delle Garanzie Minime di Salvaguardia Sociale.
cells.T: Following completion of the analysis regarding compliance with the Do Not Significant Harm principle, the Head of the ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability) Unit, or delegate, shall collect and verify the documents necessary to verify compliance with the pillars of Minimum Social Safeguards provided for in Article 18 of the European Taxonomy Regulation.In particular:- with regard to the human rights pillar, the verification is based on the Group's due diligence process;- with regard to the other three pillars (taxation, anti-corruption, and governance), the verification is carried out on the basis of documentation produced in collaboration with the relevant units – Audit, Tax, Legal, and Compliance – with the aim of confirming the absence of material changes during the reference year.In case of a negative result, the Head of the ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability) Unit, or delegate, reports any non-compliance or documentary deficiencies to the relevant Units, requesting additions or clarifications.In case of a positive result, the Head of the ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition (CEO Office, Strategy and Sustainability) Unit, or delegate, confirms compliance with the Minimum Social Safeguards to the Sustainability Reporting Unit (Group Financial and Sustainability Reporting) by email.

cells.S: Mensalmente, o Responsável pelo DAP RTR - Ativo Fixo revisa a planilha "Empresa_Provisão WIP Obras em Curso" para verificar se o cálculo manual da provisão de WIP foi realizado corretamente pelo Analista do DAP RTR - Ativo Fixo, através das seguintes verificações: _x000D__x000D_- Filtrar as obras energizadas, mas não capitalizadas, dentro de dois meses a partir da data de energização ou da última movimentação de custos (itens originários das colunas "Data de energização" e "Última data de movimentação de custos" no arquivo "Relatório de Obras em Curso");_x000D_-Valores totais_x000D_-Taxa média _x000D_-Inconsistências cadastrais._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado positivo (se não houver discrepâncias no cálculo manual da provisão de WIP), o Responsável pelo DAP RTR - Ativo Fixo aprova por e-mail o cálculo manual da provisão de WIP. Em seguida, envia a planilha "Empresa_Provisão WIP Obras em Curso", via OIP ao BPO para contabilização da provisão._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado negativo (se houver discrepâncias no cálculo manual da provisão de WIP), o Responsável pelo DAP RTR - Ativo Fixo solicita por e-mail ao Analista do DAP RTR - Ativo Fixo realizar os ajustes necessários.
cells.T: Monthly, the Head of DAP RTR - Fixed Asset reviews the "Company_Provision for Work in Progress" spreadsheet  to verify whether the manual calculation of  WIP provision was performed correctly by the Analyst of DAP RTR - Fixed Asset, through the following checks:_x000D__x000D_- Filter of the works energized  but not capitalized within the two months from the energization date or from the last date cost movement (items originating from the "Energization Date" and “Last date cost movement” columns through the file “Works in Progress Report”);_x000D_- Total amounts;_x000D_- Average rate;_x000D_- Registration inconsistencies._x000D__x000D_In case of a positive result (if there are no discrepancies in the manual calculation of  WIP provision), the Head of DAP RTR - Fixed Asset approves the manual WIP provision calculation via email. Then, the Analyst of DAP RTR - Fixed Assets sends the "Company_Provision for Work in Progress" spreadsheet, via OIP, to BPO for accounting of the provision._x000D__x000D_In case of a negative result (if there are discrepancies in the manual calculation of  WIP provision), the Head of DAP RTR - Fixed Asset requests the necessary adjustments, via email, to the Analyst of DAP RTR - Fixed Asset makes the necessary adjustments.

cells.G: ENEL S.P.A.
cells.M: Mancata trasparenza/neutralità dei dati qualitativi e quantitativi e delle stime utilizzati/e per l'informativa di sostenibilità
cells.N: Lack of transparency/neutrality of qualitative and quantitative data and estimations used for sustainability reporting
cells.S: Semestralmente, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, a valle del caricamento dei dati dei rifiuti da parte dei singoli impianti/cluster, sia con gestione dei rifiuti interna sia con gestione dei rifiuti affidata a contrattisti, partendo dalla lista degli impianti/cluster italiani con produzione totale di rifiuti superiore a 400.000 kg nel semestre, e utilizzati nel calcolo delle seguenti metriche:a) Totale dei rifiuti prodotti;b) Quantità totale di rifiuti pericolosi:c) Rifiuti non destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;d) Rifiuti destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;e) Rifiuti non riciclati;f) Percentuale di rifiuti non riciclati;g) Totale rifiuiti di ceneri e gessi smaltiti/riciclati/non riciclatiestrae un campione casuale pari al 30% degli impianti/cluster e verifica la correttezza e completezza dei dati presenti in Eden confrontandoli con la documentazione di supporto (FIR - Formulario di Identificazione dei Rifiuti, o dati forniti tramite template excel).In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità HSEQ Italia EGP and Thermal Generation, o delegato, contatta via email il Responsabile dell’impianto/cluster per richiedere chiarimenti e apportare eventuali correzioni o integrazioni in Eden.In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità HSEQ Italia EGP and Thermal Generation, o delegato, archivia il report con evidenza delle verifiche effettuate e la documentazione di supporto.
cells.T: Semi-annually, the Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) Unit, or delegate, after the upload of waste data by the individual plants/clusters, both with internal waste management and with waste management outsourced to contractors, starting from the list of Italian plants/clusters with waste total production exceeding 400,000 kg during the semester and used in the calculation of the following metrics:  a) Total Waste generated;b) Total amount of hazardous waste.c) Waste diverted from disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;d) Waste directed to disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;e) Non-recycled waste;f) Percentage of non-recycled waste;g) Total ash and gypsum waste recycled/reused/disposedextracts a random sample equal to 30% of the plants/cluster and verifies the accuracy and completeness of the data recorded in EDEN, by comparing them with the supporting documentation (FIR - Formulario di Identificazione dei Rifiuti, or data provided through the Excel template).In case of negative result, the Head of the HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation Unit, or delegate, contacts the Plant/Cluster Responsible via email to request clarifications and to make the necessary corrections or integrations in EDEN.In case of positive result, the Head of the HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation Unit, or delegate, files the report including evidence of the checks performed and the related supporting documentation.

cells.G: ENEL S.P.A.
cells.M: Errata/mancata approvazione e trasmissione dei dati utilizzati nella predisposizione dell'informativa quantitativa di Sostenibilità
cells.N: Incorrect/missing approval and transmission of data used in the elaboration of sustainability quantitative information
cells.S: A valle della validazione su EDEN dei dati inerenti i rifiuti da parte del Responsabile HSEQ di sito/cluster e utilizzati nel calcolo delle seguenti metriche:a) Totale dei rifiuti prodotti;b) Quantità totale di rifiuti pericolosi:c) Rifiuti non destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;d) Rifiuti destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;e) Rifiuti non riciclati;f) Percentuale di rifiuti non riciclati;g) Totale rifiuiti di ceneri e gessi smaltiti/riciclati/non riciclatiil Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, effettua:i) un controllo di completezza, verificando che tutti i siti/cluster di competenza della Country abbiano caricato i dati in EDEN;ii) un controllo di ragionevolezza, comparando il dato del periodo in corso con il valore del periodo corrispondente dell'anno precedente e indagando eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%.In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, contatta via email il Responsabile di sito al fine di richiedere chiarimenti/integrazioni sui dati registrati a sistema.In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, procede a validare in EDEN la scheda tramite l’approvazione in stato "convalidato a livello di Paese".
cells.T: After the validation in EDEN of the waste data by the Site/Cluster HSEQ Responsible and used in the calculation of the following metrics:  a) Total Waste generated;b) Total amount of hazardous waste.c) Waste diverted from disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;d) Waste directed to disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;e) Non-recycled waste;f) Percentage of non-recycled waste;g) Total ash and gypsum waste recycled/reused/disposedthe Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) Unit, or delegate, performs:i) a completeness check, verifying that all sites/cluster under the Country’s responsibility have uploaded their data in EDEN;ii) a reasonableness check, comparing the current period data with the corresponding period of the previous year and investigating any absolute deviations exceeding the 20% threshold.In case of negative result, the Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) Unit, or delegate, contacts the Site Responsible via email to request clarifications or integrations on the data recorded in the system.In case of positive result, the Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) Unit, or delegate, proceeds with the validation in EDEN by approving the record in the status “validated at Country level”.

cells.S: A valle della validazione su EDEN dei dati inerenti i rifiuti da parte delle Unità di Country, con riferimento al perimetro O&M e utilizzati nel calcolo delle seguenti metriche:a) Totale dei rifiuti prodotti;b) Quantità totale di rifiuti pericolosi:c) Rifiuti non destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;d) Rifiuti destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;e) Rifiuti non riciclati;f) Percentuale di rifiuti non riciclati;g) Totale rifiuiti di ceneri e gessi smaltiti/riciclati/non riciclatiil Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX), o delegato, effettua: i) un controllo di completezza, verificando che tutte le Country di competenza della Business line abbiano correttamente caricato/validato il dato in EDEN;ii) un controllo di ragionevolezza, comparando il dato aggregato del periodo in corso con il valore del periodo corrispondente dell'anno precedente e indagando eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%.In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX), o delegato, contatta via email le Unità di Country al fine di richiedere chiarimenti/integrazioni sui dati presenti a sistema.In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX), o delegato, procede a validare in EDEN la scheda tramite l’approvazione in stato "convalidato a livello di GBL".
cells.T: After the validation of waste data on EDEN by the Country Units with reference to the O&M perimeter and used in the calculation of the following metrics:  a) Total Waste generated;b) Total amount of hazardous waste.c) Waste diverted from disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;d) Waste directed to disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;e) Non-recycled waste;f) Percentage of non-recycled waste;g) Total ash and gypsum waste recycled/reused/disposedthe Head of the Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) Unit, or delegate, performs: i) a completeness check, verifying that all Countries within the Business Line's remit have correctly uploaded/validated the data in EDEN;ii) a reasonableness check, comparing the data aggregated for the current period with the value for the corresponding period of the previous year and investigating any deviations in absolute value exceeding the 20% threshold.In case of negative result, the Head of the Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) Unit, or delegate, contacts the Country Units by email to request clarification/additional information on the data in the system.In case of positive result, the Head of the Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) Unit, or delegate, validates the form in EDEN by approving it as “validated at GBL level.”

cells.S: Semestralmente, il Responsabile dell’Unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX), o delegato, con riferimento al perimetro Ingegneria e Costruzione, effettua controlli in Eden sui dati dei rifiuti caricati dall’Unità E&C HSE Competence Center e utilizzati nel calcolo delle seguenti metriche:_x000D_a) Totale dei rifiuti prodotti;_x000D_b) Quantità totale di rifiuti pericolosi:_x000D_c) Rifiuti non destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;_x000D_d) Rifiuti destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;_x000D_e) Rifiuti non riciclati;_x000D_f) Percentuale di rifiuti non riciclati;_x000D_Il Responsabile dell’Unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX), o delegato, compara il dato aggregato rispetto ai valori attesi in termini di volumi (MW installati per tecnologia), avanzamento lavori e accuratezza delle principali categorie (terreni e rocce, rifiuti C&D) e indagando eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell’Unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX), o delegato, contatta il Responsabile dell'Unità E&C HSE Competence Center al fine di richiedere chiarimenti/integrazioni sui dati presenti a sistema._x000D_In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell’Unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX), o delegato, procede a validare in EDEN la scheda tramite l’approvazione in stato "convalidato a livello di GBL" .

cells.S: Semestralmente, a valle del caricamento dei dati relativi ai rifiuti in EDEN e utilizzati nel calcolo delle seguenti metriche:_x000D_a) Totale dei rifiuti prodotti;_x000D_b) Quantità totale di rifiuti pericolosi:_x000D_c) Rifiuti non destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;_x000D_d) Rifiuti destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;_x000D_e) Rifiuti non riciclati;_x000D_f) Percentuale di rifiuti non riciclati._x000D_il Responsabile dell'Unità Ambiente (HSEQ Enel Grids and Innovation Italy), o delegato, con riferimento ai dati sui rifiuti aggregati a livello Country, effettua:_x000D_i) un controllo di completezza e coerenza, verificando che i dati siano conformi alle estrazioni originali da WinWaste, SIGERI e Open Portal;_x000D_ii) un controllo di congruenza, verificando la coerenza dei dati rispetto allo stesso periodo dell’anno precedente e indagando eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Ambiente (HSEQ Enel Grids and Innovation Italy), o delegato, contatta il referente dell'Unità territoriale al fine di richiedere chiarimenti e/o le dovute correzioni._x000D_In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Ambiente (HSEQ Enel Grids and Innovation Italy), o delegato, valida i dati su Eden.
cells.T: Semi-annually, following the upload of waste data into EDEN and used in the calculation of the following metrics:  _x000D_a) Total Waste generated;_x000D_b) Total amount of hazardous waste._x000D_c) Waste diverted from disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;_x000D_d) Waste directed to disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;_x000D_e) Non-recycled waste;_x000D_f) Percentage of non-recycled waste._x000D_the Head of Grids IT QSA – Italy, or delegate, with reference to the waste data aggregated at Country level, carries out:_x000D_i) a consistency and completeness check of the data with the original WinWaste, SIGERI and Open Portal extractions;_x000D_ii) a consistency check, verifying the consistency of the data compared to the same period of the previous year, investigating any deviations in absolute value exceeding the 20% threshold._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of Grids IT QSA – Italy, or delegate, contacts the representative of the territorial Unit to request clarification and/or the necessary corrections._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of Grids IT QSA – Italy, or delegate, validates the data to Eden

cells.S: A valle della validazione su EDEN dei dati inerenti i rifiuti da parte delle Unità di Country e utilizzati nel calcolo delle seguenti metriche:_x000D_a) Totale dei rifiuti prodotti;_x000D_b) Quantità totale di rifiuti pericolosi;_x000D_c) Rifiuti non destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;_x000D_d) Rifiuti destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;_x000D_e) Rifiuti non riciclati;_x000D_f) Percentuale di rifiuti non riciclati._x000D_il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation), o delegato, effettua: _x000D_i) un controllo di completezza, verificando che tutte le Country di competenza della Business line abbiano correttamente caricato il dato in EDEN;_x000D_ii) un controllo di ragionevolezza, comparando il dato del periodo in corso con il valore del periodo corrispondente dell'anno precedente  e indagando eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation), o delegato, contatta via email le Unità Environment di Country (Enel Grids) al fine di richiedere chiarimenti/integrazioni sui dati presenti a sistema._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation), o delegato, procede a validare in EDEN la scheda tramite l’approvazione in stato "convalidato a livello di GBL".
cells.T: After the validation of waste data on EDEN by the Country Units and used in the calculation of the following metrics:  _x000D_a) Total Waste generated;_x000D_b) Total amount of hazardous waste;_x000D_c) Waste diverted from disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;_x000D_d) Waste directed to disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;_x000D_e) Non-recycled waste;_x000D_f) Percentage of non-recycled waste._x000D_the Head of the Environmental Competence Center Unit (Enel Grids and Innovation), or delegate, performs: _x000D_i) a completeness check, verifying that all Countries within the Business Line's remit have correctly uploaded the data to EDEN;_x000D_ii) a reasonableness check, comparing the data for the current period with the value for the corresponding period of the previous year and investigating any deviations in absolute value exceeding the 20% threshold._x000D__x000D_In the event of a negative outcome, the Head of the Environmental Competence Center Unit (Enel Grids and Innovation), or delegate, contacts the Environment Country Units (Enel Grids) by email to request clarification/additional information on the data in the system._x000D__x000D_If the outcome is positive, the Head of the Environmental Competence Center Unit (Enel Grids and Innovation), or delegate, validates the form in EDEN by approving it as “validated at GBL level.”

cells.S: A valle della validazione su EDEN dei dati consuntivi inerenti i rifiuti da parte delle Unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) e Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation) e utilizzati nel calcolo delle seguenti metriche:_x000D_a) Totale dei rifiuti prodotti;_x000D_b) Quantità totale di rifiuti pericolosi;_x000D_c) Rifiuti non destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;_x000D_d) Rifiuti destinati allo smaltimento, suddivisi per rifiuti pericolosi e non pericolosi e per tipo di trattamento;_x000D_e) Rifiuti non riciclati;_x000D_f) Percentuale di rifiuti non riciclati;_x000D_g) Totale rifiuiti di ceneri e gessi smaltiti/riciclati/non riciclati._x000D_il Responsabile dell’Unità Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting (Environment HLD), o delegato, verifica la ragionevolezza dei dati aggregati a livello Gruppo per i perimetri O&M e E&C, confrontando i dati del periodo corrente con quelli dell’anno precedente e indagando eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell’Unità Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting (Environment HLD), o delegato, notifica lo scostamento al livello precedente tramite commento nel sistema e/o email alle Unità Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) o Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation), richiedendo chiarimenti e modifiche ai valori anomali rilevati._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell’Unità Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting (Environment HLD), o delegato, informa via email l’Unità Sustainability Reporting e l’Unità Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler della correttezza dei dati.
cells.T: After the validation on EDEN of waste data by Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) and Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation) Units and used in the calculation of the following metrics:  _x000D_a) Total Waste generated;_x000D_b) Total amount of hazardous waste;_x000D_c) Waste diverted from disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;_x000D_d) Waste directed to disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;_x000D_e) Non-recycled waste;_x000D_f) Percentage of non-recycled waste._x000D_g) Total ash and gypsum waste recycled/reused/disposed_x000D_the Head of Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting (Environment HLD) Unit, or delegate, verifies the reasonableness of the aggregated data at Group level related to the perimeter O&M and E&C, comparing the current period's data with the value of the previous year and investigating any deviations in absolute value higher than the 20% threshold._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of the Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting (Environment HLD) Unit, or delegate, notifies the deviation to the previous level, through a comment in the system and/or sending an e-mail, to the Environmental Competence Center (EGP&TGX) or Environmental Competence Center (Enel Grids and Innovation) Units, requesting for clarification on the data recorded and modifying any anomalous values found._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of the Environmental Performance Strategy & Reporting (Environment HLD) Unit, or delegate, informs by e-mail the Sustainability Reporting Unit and the Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler Unit of the correctness of the data.

cells.S: Anualmente, o Analista de Industrial P&C EGP&TGX Brazil - Planning & Reporting executa a carga de orçamento, para ativos fixos e intangiveis através do sistema Master Budget através do template Excel disponibilizado no site web SAP Business Planning and Consolidation.Posteriormente, o Analista do Industrial P&C EGP&TGX Brazil - Planning & Reporting usando uma query do Operational Reporting verifica se o saldo carregado está igual ao valor da meta estipulada pela Industrial P&C EGP&TGX (Holding) enviada por e-mail à área local.Em caso de resultados negativos (caso o saldo não esteja em conformidade com a aprovação), o Analista do Industrial P&C EGP&TGX Brazil - Planning & Reporting ajusta o saldo no Master Budget que será refletido no sistema PRIMO.Em caso de resultado positivo (caso o saldo esteja de acordo com a aprovação), a carga do orçamento é finalizada, apresentada no Master Budget e refletida no sistema PRIMO.

cells.S: Mensalmente, o RTR - Analista de Ativo Fixo Brasil recebe do Analista do BPO por e-mail, o relatório gerado pelo SAP E4E (R4P) - BR, transação CJI3, demonstrando o resultado da liquidação do CAPEX (para ativos fixos e intangiveis) e revisa:(i) se o saldo final é igual a zero;(ii) se os erros identificados pelo Analista do BPO foram regularizados. Em caso de resultado negativo, (Caso não sejam encontradas  diferenças), o RTR - Analista de Ativo Fixo Brasil investiga as razões, corrige quaisquer erros e, em seguida, solicita ao Analista do BPO que realize o procedimento novamente. Em caso de resultado positivo, (Caso sejam encontradas  diferenças), o RTR - Analista de Ativo Fixo Brasil envia e-mail ao Analista do BPO, com cópia para o RTR - Chefe de Ativo Fixo Brasil, comunicando que o processo de liquidação foi finalizado com sucesso.

cells.S: A valle della validazione su EDEN dei dati inerenti l'acqua stoccata all'interno di bacini idroelettrici da parte del responsabile HSEQ di cluster e utilizzati nel calcolo delle seguenti metriche:_x000D_a) Volume totale acqua stoccata da bacini idroelettrici_x000D__x000D_il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, effettua:_x000D_i) un controllo di completezza, verificando che tutti i cluster di competenza della Country abbiano caricato i dati in EDEN;_x000D_ii) un controllo di ragionevolezza, comparando il dato del periodo in corso con il valore del periodo corrispondente dell'anno precedente e indagando eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%._x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, contatta via email il Responsabile di cluster al fine di richiedere chiarimenti/integrazioni sui dati registrati a sistema._x000D_In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, procede a validare in EDEN la scheda tramite l’approvazione in stato "convalidato a livello di Paese".
cells.T: After the validation on EDEN of data concerning the water stored within hydroelectric basins by the HSEQ cluster responsible, contributing to the following metrics:_x000D_a) Total Water Storage in hydroelectric basins_x000D__x000D_the Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) Unit, or delegate, performs:_x000D_(i) a completeness check, verifying that all clusters within the Country perimeter have uploaded the data in EDEN;_x000D_(ii) a reasonableness check, comparing the data of the current period with the value of the corresponding period of the previous year and investigating any deviations in absolute value above the 20 percent threshold._x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) Unit, or delegate, contacts by email the cluster Responsible in order to request clarifications/integrations on the data recorded in EDEN. _x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) Unit, or delegate, proceeds to validate in EDEN the form through approval in status "validated at country level".
cells.AB: Maria Luisa Paterni;Silvana Iacobellis;Vito Raffaele Macciocca;Andreina Naraci;

cells.S: Annualmente, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, partendo dalla lista dei cluster (area hydro) di country Italia, estrae un campione casuale del 30% dei cluster e verifica la correttezza e completezza dei dati inerenti l'acqua stoccata presenti in EDEN e utilizzati nel calcolo delle seguenti metriche: _x000D_a) Volume totale acqua stoccata da bacini idroelettrici_x000D__x000D_comparandoli con la documentazione di supporto fornita dai responsabili di ciascun cluster (es. file excel compilati manualmente dall'operatore o modelli di calcolo basati su misure dirette o stime della capacità dei bacini idroelettrici)._x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, contatta via email il Responsabile HSEQ dell'area Hydro per ottenere chiarimenti e apportare eventuali correzioni/integrazioni in EDEN._x000D_In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, archivia il report con evidenza delle verifiche svolte e la documentazione a supporto.
cells.T: Annually, the Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), or delegate, starting from the list of country Italy clusters (hydro area), draws a random sample of 30% of the clusters and verifies the correctness and completeness of the data concerning water stored present in EDEN  and used in the calculation of the following metrics: _x000D_a) Total Water Storage in hydroelectric basins_x000D__x000D_comparing them with the supporting documentation provided by the responisible of each cluster (e.g. excel files manually compiled by the operator or extracted from specific systems or calculation models based on direct measurements or estimates of the hydroelectric basins capacity). _x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), or delegate, contacts via email the HSEQ Hydro area responsible in order to obtain clarifications and make any corrections/additions in EDEN._x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), or delegate, files the report with evidence of the verifications carried out and the supporting documentation.
cells.AB: Silvana Iacobellis;Vito Raffaele Macciocca;Maria Luisa Paterni;Andreina Naraci;
cells.AF: 1) In caso di esito negativo, email inviata dal Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, al Responsabile HSEQ di area Hydro dei cluster per ottenere chiarimenti e apportare eventuali correzioni/integrazioni in EDEN._x000D_2) In caso di esito positivo, report archiviato con evidenza del controllo campionario effettuato dal Responsabile dell'Unità Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), o delegato, e relativa documentazione di supporto ( es.file excel compilati manualmente dall'operatore o modelli di calcolo basati su misure dirette o stime della capacità dei bacini idroelettrici).
cells.AG: 1) In case of negative result, email sent by the Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation) Unit , or delegate, to the Cluster HSEQ Hydro area Responsible in order to investigate the reasons for the deviation and make the necessary corrections in EDEN._x000D_2) In case of positive result, report archived with evidence of the sample check performed by the Head of the Environmental Model Development (HSEQ Italy EGP and Thermal Generation), or delegate, and related supporting documentation (e.g. excel files manually compiled by the operator or extracted from specific systems or calculation models based on direct measurements or estimates of the hydroelectric basins capacity).

cells.S: Sob demanda, a pedido da Holding via e-mail, o Analista de Industrial P&C EGP&TGX Brazil - Planning & Reporting faz uma revisão orçamentária chamada "Forecast" conforme a necessidade de redução ou aumento do OPEX/CAPEX (para ativos fixos e intangiveis) de acordo com as decisões estratégicas da primeira linha das tecnologias. Em caso de resultados negativos, (alterações em relação ao BDG), o Analista do Industrial P&C EGP&TGX Brazil - Planning & Reporting insere os valores e comentários no Monthly Forecast Tool (que refletem no sistema E-report), referentes as principais variações orçamentárias. Em caso de resultado positivo, (não há alterações em relação ao BDG) analista do Industrial P&C EGP&TGX Brazil - Planning & Reporting insere os comentários no Monthly Forecast Tool (que refletem no sistema E-report) insere os valores e sinaliza que não houve variações orçamentários em relação ao Budget.
cells.T: On demand, at the request of the Holding via e-mail, the Industrial P&C EGP&TGX Brazil Analyst - Planning & Reporting  carries out a budget review called "Forecast" according to the need to reduce or increase OPEX/CAPEX (for fixed and intangible assets) in accordance with the strategic decisions of the first line of technologies. In case of negative results (changes in relation to the BDG), the Industrial P&C EGP&TGX Brazil Analyst - Planning & Reporting inserts the values ​​and comments in the Monthly Forecast Tool (that reflect in the E-report system) referring to the main budget variations. In case of a positive result, (there are no changes in relation to the BDG) the Industrial P&C EGP&TGX Brazil Analyst - Planning & Reporting inserts the comments in the Monthly Forecast Tool (that reflect in the E-report system), inserts the values ​​and signals that there were no budget variations in relation to the Budget.

cells.S: Trimestralmente, o RTR - Analista de Ativo Fixo Brasil, utiliza a extração do relatório “ZILA" (referente a ativos fixos e intangíveis) realizada pela Analista de Ativo Fixo BPO Brasil por meio da transação ZAA4R_BR_ZILA do SAP E4E (R4P) - BR - AA  e o relatório “BMP”, transação ZFI4R_BR_ZC29 do sistema SAP E4E (R4P) – BR/FI. Em seguida, o Analista de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brasil elabora a conciliação (planilha "Ativos fixos e intangíveis") dos saldo de ativo fixos e intangíveis com base nas informações dos relatórios acima mencionados. A partir da conciliação, o Analista de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brasil realiza a conferência dos saldos contábeis entre os valores dos módulos AA e FI.Em caso de resultado negativo, (sejam identificadas divergências), o Analista de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brasil repassa, por e-mail, as divergências identificadas para o Analista da BPO realizar as correções no sistema SAP E4E (R4P) - BR.Em caso de resultado positivo (Caso não sejam identificadas divergências), o Analista de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brasil digitalmente arquiva a conciliação "Ativos fixos e intangíveis".
cells.T: Quarterly, the Analyst of RTR - Fixed Asset Brazil utilizes the "ZILA" report (covering fixed and intangible assets)—extracted by the BPO Analyst - Fixed Asset Brazil via transaction ZAA4R_BR_ZILA in the SAP E4E (R4P) – BR – AA system—along with the "BMP" report, obtained via transaction ZFI4R_BR_ZC29 in the SAP E4E (R4P) – BR/FI system.Then, the RTR - Fixed Asset Brazil prepares a reconciliation (the "Fixed and Intangible Assets" spreadsheet) of fixed and intangible asset balances, based on information from the mentioned reports above. Using this reconciliation, the RTR - Fixed Asset Brazil verifies the accounting balances by comparing the values ​​between the AA and FI modules.In case of negative result (discrepancies are identified), the Analyst of RTR - Fixed Asset Brazil forwards, by e-mail, the identified discrepancies to the Analyst of BPO - Fixed Asset Brazil to carry out the corrections in SAP E4E (R4P) - BR.In case of positive result (no discrepancies are identified), the Analyst of RTR - Fixed Asset Brazil digitally archives the "Fixed and Intangible Assets" reconciliation.
cells.AB: Cristina Midorelli Da Silva;FABIO TRIGONI;CAMILA SARAIVA PECLY;
cells.AF: 1) Relatório "ZILA";2) Relatório "BMP"; 3) Em caso de resultado negativo, e-mail enviado pelo Analista de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brasil para o Analista BPO - Ativo Fixo Brasil com as discrepâncias identificadas; 4) Em caso de resultado positivo, conciliação "Ativos fixos e intangíveis" arquivada digitalmente.
cells.AG: 1) Report "ZILA";2) Report "BMP";3) In case of negative results, email sent by the Analyst of RTR - Fixed Asset Brazil to the BPO Analyst - Fixed Asset Brazil with the identified discrepancies;4) In case of positive results, the "Fixed and Intangible Assets" reconciliation archived digitally.

cells.S: Mensalmente, o Analista de BPO DAP executa as transações CJ88 (para liquidação individual de PEP), CJ8G (para liquidação massiva), KO88 (para liquidação individual de ordem) e KO8G (para liquidação massiva de ordens) no sistema SAP E4E (R4P) BR para realizar a liquidação dos PEPs (referente a ativos fixos e intangiveis), visando movimentar os custos da conta da demonstração do resultado aplicável à conta do ativo circulante no balanço patrimonial. _x000D_Após a execução das transações de liquidação, o Analista de BPO DAP executa a transação CJI3 no sistema SAP E4E (R4P) BR e verifica se os PEPs foram devidamente liquidados no sistema SAP E4E (R4P) BR._x000D_Caso o relatório apresente algum erro (ou seja, algumas contas não foram zeradas), o Analista BPO DAP envia um e-mail para o Analista de DAP-RTR Ativo Fixo solicitando as correções necessárias._x000D_Caso contrário, o Analista de BPO DAP envia por e-mail para o Analista de DAP-RTR Ativo Fixo, informando sobre a disponibilidade do relatório no Portal do Sharepoint.
cells.T: Monthly, the BPO DAP Analyst executes transactions CJ88 (for individual PEP settlement), CJ8G (for massive settlement), KO88 (for individual order settlement) and KO8G (for massive order settlement) in the SAP E4E system (R4P) BR to carry out the settlement of PEPs, aiming to move the costs from the applicable income statement account to the current assets account in the balance sheet. _x000D_After executing the settlement transactions, the BPO DAP Analyst executes transaction CJI3 in the SAP E4E (R4P) BR system and checks whether the PEPs (for fixed and intangible assets) were properly settled in the SAP E4E (R4P) BR system._x000D_In case of negative result (i.e., some accounts were not cleared), the BPO DAP Analyst sends an email to the DAP-RTR Fixed Assets Analyst requesting the necessary corrections._x000D_In case of positive result, the BPO DAP Analyst sends an email to the DAP-RTR Fixed Assets Analyst, informing them of the availability of the report on the Sharepoint Portal.
cells.AF: 1) E-mail enviado pela Analista BPO DAP ao Analista de DAP-RTR Ativo Fixo com PEPs e ordens liquidads no sistema SAP E4E (R4P) BR; 2) E-mail enviado pela Analista BPO DAP ao Analista de DAP-RTR Ativo Fixo solicitando as correções necessárias; 3) E-mail enviado pelo Analista BPO DAP ao Analista de DAP-RTR Ativo Fixo informando a disponibilidade do relatório de erro no Portal Sharepoint.
cells.AG: 1) Email sent by the BPO DAP Analyst to the DAP-RTR Fixed Asset Analyst with PEPs and orders settled in the SAP E4E (R4P) BR system; 2) Email sent by the BPO DAP Analyst to the DAP-RTR Fixed Asset Analyst requesting the necessary corrections; 3) Email sent by the BPO DAP Analyst to the DAP-RTR Fixed Asset Analyst informing the availability of the error report on the Sharepoint Portal.

cells.S: Mensalmente, com a finalidade de assegurar que os ativos aptos para a passagem em serviço sejam identificados no sistema SAP E4E (R4P) BR Módulo AA, ao receber via OIP a relação de PEPs a serem transferidos para o AIS pelo Responsável da Área que solicitou a imobilização, o Analista da BPO DAP extrai relatório do sistema SAP E4E (R4P) BR, transação CJI3, para esses PEPs, e relatório “ZILA” do sistema SAP E4E (R4P) BR, transação ZAA4R_BR_ZILA, com os valores dos elementos do ativo fixo em curso e compara os dois relatórios para verificar se as informações estão em conformidade.Em caso de resultado negativo (Se identificar alguma inconsistência), o Analista da BPO DAP responde o chamado no OIP para o responsável para realizar a correção.Em caso de resultado positivo (Se não houver inconsistências), o Analista da BPO DAP executa as transações CJ88, CJ8G, KO88 e KO8G para realizar a transferência do em curso para serviço.
cells.T: Monthly, with the purpose of ensuring that assets suitable for entry into service are identified in the SAP E4E (R4P) BR Module AA system, upon receiving via OIP the list of PEPs to be transferred to the AIS by the Area Manager who requested the fixed assets, the BPO DAP Analyst extracts a report from the SAP E4E (R4P) BR system, transaction CJI3, for these PEPs, and the “ZILA” report from the SAP E4E (R4P) BR system, transaction ZAA4R_BR_ZILA, with the values of the elements of the fixed asset and intangible assets in progress and compares the two reports to verify that the information is in accordance._x000D_In case of negative result (any inconsistency is identified), the BPO DAP Analyst responds to the OIP call to the person responsible to make the correction._x000D_In case of positive results (If there are no inconsistencies), the BPO DAP Analyst executes transactions CJ88, CJ8G, KO88 and KO8G to transfer work in progress to service.
cells.AF: 1) Lista de WBEs a serem transferidos para o AIS extraída do sistema SAP E4E (R4P) BR;2) Relatório "ZILA" Ativos fixos transferidos de em curso para em serviço;3) Em caso de resultado negativo, Ticket respondido na ferramenta OIP pelo Analista BPO DAP;4) Em caso de resultado positivo, tela de impressão para comprovar a transferênciade em curso para em serviço (através da execução das transacções CJ88, CJ8G, KO88 e KO8G).
cells.AG: 1) List of WBEs to be transferred to the AIS extracted from the SAP E4E (R4P) BR system; 2) "ZILA" report Fixed assets transferred from in progress to in service; 3) In case of a negative result, Ticket answered in the OIP tool by the BPO DAP Analyst; 4) In case of a positive result, print screen to prove the transfer from in progress to in service (through the execution of transactions CJ88, CJ8G, KO88 and KO8G).

cells.S: Mensalmente, após a transferência dos saldos de investimento em curso para serviço, realizado pelo Analista da BPO, o Analista de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brasil concilia as informações do arquivo "Zila_Mês_Ano" com o Balancete (BMP) extraído do SAP E4E (R4P) - BR e formalizado no arquivo "Conciliação Ativo Fixo_mês, que contém ativos fixos e intangíveis. Em caso de resultado positivo (se valores coincidem), o Chefe de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brasil, aprova a conciliação via portal de acordo com a periodicidade definida para o grupo de contas. Em caso de resultado negativo (se valores não coincidem), o Chefe de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brasil solicita ao Analista de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brasil via portal os ajustes necessários.
cells.T: Monthly, after the transfer of investment balances in progress to service, carried out by the BPO Analyst, the Analyst of RTR - Fixed Assets Brazil reconciles the information from the "Zila_Month_Year" file with the Balance Sheet (BMP) extracted from SAP E4E (R4P) - BR and formalized in the "Fixed Asset Reconciliation_month" file, which contains fixed and intangible assets.In case of positive (if the values ​​match), the Head of RTR - Fixed Assets Brazil approves the reconciliation via the portal according to the periodicity defined for the account group.If case of negative (if the values ​​do not match), the Head of RTR - Fixed Assets Brazil requests the necessary adjustments to the Analyst of RTR - Fixed Assets Brazil via the portal.
cells.AB: Cristina Midorelli Da Silva;CAMILA SARAIVA PECLY;FABIO TRIGONI;

cells.S: Il Responsabile dell'Unità People Analytics, o delegato, effettua un controllo di completezza verificando che i dati relativi agli indicatori quantitativi di P&O necessari ai fini del reporting siano completi e corretti all'interno del sistema Cloudera (Analytics Sustainability) comparandoli con i dati presenti all'interno dei sistemi e dashboard che alimentano Cloudera (Analytics Sustainability).In caso di esito negativo, l’addetto dell'unità People Analytics provvede a richiedere chiarimenti e/o correzioni alle Unità di P&O Owner del dato.In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità People Analytics, o delegato, informa l'unità Global ICT - S&S Data Intelligence Delivery della disponibilità dei dati a sistema per la successiva migrazione in Digital S.
cells.T: The Head of the People Analytics Unit, or delegate, performs a completeness check to verify that the data relating to the quantitative P&O indicators required for reporting purposes are complete and correct within the Cloudera (Analytics Sustainability) system, comparing them with the data in the systems and dashboards that feed Cloudera (Analytics Sustainability).In case of negative result, the People Analytics Unit employee requests clarification and/or corrections from the P&O Owner Units responsible for the data.In case of positive result, the Head of the People Analytics Unit, or delegate, informs the Global ICT - S&S Data Intelligence Delivery unit of the availability of the data in the system for subsequent migration to Digital S.

cells.S: Visualizzata su EDEN la scheda approvata dai Referenti HSEQ di tutte le Country del perimetro Global Service, relativa ai dati inerenti:- i consumi della flotta aziendale- il consumo di gasolio e metano per riscaldamento e mense negli uffici e le perdite di gas refrigerante  utilizzati nell'ambito del calcolo delle seguenti metriche:a) Total direct emissions (Scope 1)b)  Other CO2eq emissions due to electricity production and other activitiesc) Specific CO₂eq emissions from Scope 1 il Responsabile dell’unità HSEQ Global Services (Global Services), o delegato, provvede ad effettuare:i) un controllo di completezza, verificando che tutti i Responsabili di country abbiano caricato i dati sul sistema EDEN. ii) un controllo di ragionevolezza rispetto al valore del semestre precedente, indagando su eventuali scostamenti in valore assoluto superiori alla soglia del 20%. In caso di esito negativo del controllo, il Responsabile dell'unità  HSEQ Global Services (Global Services), o delegato, provvede a rimandare la scheda al livello precedente indicando, tramite commento a sistema e/o invio e-mail, all'addetto dell'inserimento dati una richiesta di chiarimento/integrazione sui dati registrati, rettificando eventuali valori anomali riscontrati.A seguito della modifica, il sistema invia automaticamente una mail all'inseritore del dato sul sistema EDEN per la notifica dei cambiamenti effettuati.In caso di esito positivo del controllo, il Responsabile dell'unità  HSEQ Global Services (Global Services), o delegato, provvede a validare la scheda tramite l’approvazione in stato “validato a livello GBL”: EDEN restituisce un avviso che avverte sulla responsabilità intrapresa e da questo momento in poi la scheda non è più modificabile, diventando visibile dal responsabile dell'Unità ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition
cells.T: Displayed on EDEN the sheet filled in by the Responsible of Countries regarding data related to:- consumption of company fleet- consumption of oil and natural gas for heating and canteens in offices and refrigerant gas losses   used within the calculation of the following metrics:a) Total direct emissions (Scope 1)b)  Other CO2eq emissions due to electricity production and other activitiesc) Specific CO₂eq emissions from Scope 1 Total direct emissions (Scope 1the Responsible of the HSEQ Global Services (Global Services) unit, or delegate, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that all the Countries have uploaded the data into the EDEN system. ii) a reasonableness check compared to the previous semester value, investigating any deviations in absolute value higher than the 20% threshold. In case of a negative result, the Responsible of the HSEQ Global Services (Global Services) unit, or delegate, send the sheet back to the previous level notifying, through a comment in the system and/or sending an e-mail, to the Operator a request for clarification / integration of the recorded data, modifying any anomalous values found.Following the modification, the system automatically sends an e-mail to the Operator on the EDEN system to notify the changes made.In case of a positive result, the HSEQ Global Services (Global Services) Unit Responsible, or delegate, validates the sheet through the approval status "validated at GBL level": EDEN returns a message to the approver regarding the responsibility connected to the validation process and from this moment onwards the sheet can no longer be modified, becoming visible to the ESG Stakeholders and Just Transition Responsible.

cells.S: HSEQ StaffHabiendo recibido todos los datos relacionados con los eventos HS a través de correo electronico  de los Responsables del sitio, el Responsable de HSEQ Staff & Services o su delegado realiza:i) Una verificación de integridad, asegurando que todos los eventos de HS (Health & Safety) y los datos relacionados para el período en cuestión han sido comunicados de acuerdo con la Política n.º 106.  ii) Una verificación oportuna de todos los eventos de HS HSEQ Staff & Services para garantizar la coherencia entre los datos y la documentación de respaldo, verificando la correspondencia de la información relacionada con los eventos de HS registrados de acuerdo con la gravedad (por ejemplo, nombre y apellidos de la persona lesionada, número de empleado, días de baja, descripción/detalles del evento de HS) con la documentación transmitida en apoyo de dichos eventos (por ejemplo, certificado médico, comunicación a mutualidades, etc.).En caso de resultado negativo de la verificación, el Responsable de HSEQ Staff & Services o su delegado envía un recordatorio por correo electrónico al Responsable HSEQ en  Sitio, con el fin de recibir los datos faltantes y/o solicitar información/aclaraciones de los Responsables del Sitio mediante la corrección de los datos previamente recibidos. En caso de resultado positivo de los controles, los datos de los eventos HS son enviados por el HSEQ Staff & Services a HSEQ Cross Activities and Reporting (Holding) por correo.
cells.T: HSEQ StaffHaving received all data related to HS events through email  from the Site Responsible, the responsible of HSEQ Staff & Services, or delegate, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that all HS events and related data for the period have been communicated in accordance with Policy n.106.ii) a timely checking of all HS events for consistency between data and supporting documentation, verifying the correspondence of the information relating to the HS events recorded according to the severity (eg name and surname of the injured person, employee serial number, sick days, description / HS events details) with the documentation transmitted in support of the HS events (eg medical certificate; mutualities communication, etc.).In case of negative result, the  responsable of HSEQ Staff & Services, or delegate, request via email to the Site Responsible the missing data and/or request additional information/clarifications from the Site Responsibles through the correction of previously received data.In case of positive result, the responsible of HSEQ Staff & Services, or delegate, sends the HS event data to HSEQ Cross Activities and Reporting (Holding) by mail

cells.S: HSEQ Staff (horas trabajadas de contratistas)El Responsable de Staff & Services , o  delegado, una vez calculados los datos relativos a las horas trabajadas por los contratistas, realiza:i) una verificación de integridad, verificando que los datos de todas las unidades organizacionales involucradas estén incluidas;ii) una verificación de razonabilidad en comparación con el mismo valor registrado en el mismo trimestre del año anterior , investigando desviaciones significativas e inesperadas (superiores al 10%), o relacionadas con el porcentaje acumulado anual.En caso de resultado negativo de las verificaciones, el Responsable de Staff & Services, o  delegado, procederá a corregir el cálculo de las horas trabajadas por los contratistas.En caso de resultado positivo de las verificaciones, el Responsable de  Staff & Services o delegado, comparte vía correo electrónico las horas trabajadas por los contratistas con la unidad HSEQ Cross Activities and Reporting (Holding)
cells.T: HSEQ StaffThe Responsable of HSEQ Staff & Services  or delegate, once calculated the data related to the contractors' worked hours, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that the data of all organizational units concerned are present;ii) a reasonableness check against the same value recorded in the same quarter of the previous year, investigating any significant and unexpected deviations (greater than 10% ), or related to the percentage of the progressive annual.In case of negative result of the checks, the  Responsable of HSEQ Staff & Services , or  delegate, proceed to correct the calculation of the data related to the contractors' worked hours.In case of a positive result of the checks, the  Responsable of HSEQ Staff & Services or  delegate, shares via email the data related to the contractors' worked hours with  the unit HSEQ Cross Activities and Reporting (Holding)

Annex 3 Policy n.106) and shares them to HSE - Cross Activities and Training - Enel Grids and Innovability unit throught an dedicated Teams channel.

cells.S: GAR-HSEQ-CROSS ACTIVITIES & TRAINING _x000D__x000D_El responsable de GAR-HSEQ-CROSS ACTIVITIES & TRAINING, o su delegado, recibe del área Planning, Performance Management RE&GS los datos relativos a las horas de trabajo de los contratistas y realiza: _x000D__x000D_i) un control de integridad, verificando la presencia de los datos de todas las unidades organizativas afectadas_x000D__x000D_ii) una comprobación de razonabilidad frente al mismo valor registrado en el mismo trimestre del año anterior, investigando las desviaciones significativas e inesperadas (superiores al 10%), o relacionadas con el porcentaje del anual progresivo. _x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado negativo de las comprobaciones, el responsable de la unidad GAR-HSEQ-CROSS ACTIVITIES & TRAINING o su delegado solicita vía correo electrónico a la unidad Planning, Performance Management RE&GS aclaraciones sobre los datos recibidos._x000D__x000D_En caso de un resultado positivo de las comprobaciones, el responsable de la unidad GAR-HSEQ-CROSS ACTIVITIES & TRAINING o su delegado comparte los datos relativos a las horas de trabajo de los contratistas a las unidades HSE - Cross Activities and Training - Enel Grids & Innovability a través de correo electrónico.

cells.S: HSE StaffEl responsable de HSE Argentina, o su delegado, recibe del Administrador de Contratos (perteneciente a Real Estate and General Services Argentina) los datos relativos a las horas de trabajo de los contratistas y realiza: i) un control de integridad, verificando la presencia de los datos de todas las unidades organizativas afectadas.ii) una comprobación de razonabilidad frente al mismo valor registrado en el mismo trimestre del año anterior, investigando las desviaciones significativas e inesperadas (superiores al 10%), o relacionadas con el porcentaje del anual progresivo. cells.T: HSE StaffThe responsible of HSE Argentina, or delegate, receives the data related to the contractors' working hours from the Contract Administrator (within Real Estate and General Services Argentina unit) and performs:i) an integrity control, verifying the presence of the data of all affected organizational unitsii) a reasonableness check against the same value recorded in the same quarter of the previous year, investigating significant and unexpected deviations (greater than 10% ), or related to the percentage of the annual progressive.In case of negative result of the checks, the responsible of the HSE Argentina unit or delegate requests clarification about the data received via email to the Real Estate and General Services unit.In case of a positive result of the checks, the head of the HSE Argentina unit or its delegate shares the data related to the contractors' working hours to the HSEQ Cross Activities and Reporting (P&O Holding) Unit via email.

Anexo 3 Política n.106 ) con la Unidad de HSEQ Cross Activity and Training Unit (Enel Commercial GBL).
cells.T: HSEQ Enel Commercial (HS events)Once received all the data relating to HS events communicated by email from the Site Responsible delegate via an xls file (Annex 1 Policy n.106), the HSEQ Enel Commercial Colombia Responsible, or delegate, performs the following:i) a completeness check, verifying that all HSE events (Safety, Health and Environment) and related data for the period have been communicated in accordance with Policy n.106.ii)  a timely checking of all HS events for consistency between data and supporting documentation, verifying the correspondence of the information relating to the HS events recorded according to the severity (eg name and surname of the injured person, employee serial number, sick days, description / HS events details) with the documentation transmitted in support of the HS events (eg medical certificate; etc.).In case of negative result of the checks, the HSEQ Enel Commercial Colombia Responsible, or delegate, requests to the Site Responsible the missing data and/or requests information / clarifications and corrects the data previously received.In case of positive result of the checks, the HSEQ REnel Commercial Colombia Responsible, or delegate, uploads the excel file (ref. Annex 3 Policy n.106)  with the HSEQ Cross Activity and Training Unit (Enel Commercial GBL).

cells.S: HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA (eventos)_x000D__x000D_Una vez recibido de los Responsables de la unidad de Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA todos los datos relacionados con los eventos HS a través de correo electrónico, el Jefe de HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA o su delegado, verifica:_x000D__x000D_i) La integridad, asegurando que todos los eventos de HS (Health & Safety) y los datos relacionados para el período revisado han sido comunicados de acuerdo con la Política N.º 106.  _x000D__x000D_ii) La coherencia de todos los eventos de HS reportados por la unidad correspondiente de Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA, entre los datos y la documentación de soporte: validando que la información registrada para el evento HS esten de acuerdo con la gravedad (por ejemplo, nombre y apellidos de la persona lesionada, número de empleado, días de baja, descripción/detalles del evento de HS) y la documentación soporte reportada de dichos eventos (por ejemplo, certificado médico, etc.)._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, (se identifican inconsistencias), el Jefe de HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA o su delegado solicita por correo electrónico al Responsable de la unidad de Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA, los datos faltantes y/o información/aclaraciones/corrección._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, (no se identifican inconsistencias), el Jefe de HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA o su delegado envia los datos de los eventos HS por correo electrónico a HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management GECM, en el archivo “Events_Communication List_Month year"GECM”.
cells.T: HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA (events)_x000D__x000D_Once all data related to HS events has been received by email from the unit responsible for Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA, the Head of HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA or their delegate verifies:_x000D__x000D_i) Integrity, ensuring that all HS (Health & Safety) events and related data for the period reviewed have been reported in accordance with Policy No. 106.  _x000D__x000D_ii) Consistency of all HS events reported by the corresponding Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA unit, between the data and supporting documentation: validating that the information recorded for the HS event is consistent with the severity (e.g., name and surname of the injured person, employee number, days off work, description/details of the HS event) and the supporting documentation reported for such events (e.g., medical certificate, etc.)._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, (inconsistencies are identified), the Head of HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA or delegated requests the missing data and/or information/clarifications/corrections by email from the responsible person of the Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA unit by email._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result, (no inconsistencies identified), the Head of HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA or delegated sends the HS event by email to HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management GECM, in the files “Events_Communication List_Month year“GECM”.

cells.S: HSEQ  Energy and Commodity Management  (horas trabajadas de contratistas)Trimestralmente, el Jefe de HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA o su delegado, una vez calculados los datos relativos a las horas trabajadas por los contratistas, verifica:i) que todos los responsables por la unidad correspondiente de Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA, hayan comunicado los datos;ii) la razonabilidad de las diferencias comparando los datos con el año anterior y año actual (umbral 15%);En caso de resultado negativo, (se identifica diferencias), el Jefe de HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA o su delegado, corrige el cálculo de las horas trabajadas por los contratistas.En caso de resultado positivo, (no se identifican diferencias) el Jefe de HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA o su delegado, comparte por correo electrónico las horas trabajadas por los contratistas de la unidad.
cells.T: HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management (contractor hours worked)On a quarterly basis, the Head of HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA, or delegate, once the data relating to contractor hours worked has been calculated, verifies:i) that all responsible parties for the corresponding Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA unit have reported the data;ii) the reasonableness of the differences by comparing the data with the previous year and the current year (15% threshold);In case of negative result (differences are identified), the Head of HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA, or delegate, corrects the calculation of the hours worked by contractors.In case of positive result (no differences identified), the Head of HSEQ Energy and Commodity Management COL&CA or delegate shares the hours worked by contractors the HSEQ GECM unit by email.

cells.S: HSEQ Colombia and Central America  (EGP& Thermal Generation) (eventos)_x000D__x000D_Una vez recibidos todos los datos relativos a los eventos de HS a través de la herramienta HSEQ 4ALL del Responsable delegado del Sitio, el Responsable, o delegado, HSEQ Colombia and Central America (EGP&TGX), realiza lo siguiente:_x000D__x000D_i) Verifica la integridad de todos los accidentes de trabajo y/o eventos HSE (Seguridad, Salud y Medio Ambiente) y los datos relacionados para el periodo reportado de acuerdo con la Política n.106._x000D_ii) una comprobación de todos los eventos HS para garantizar la coherencia entre los datos y la documentación soporte, verificando la correspondencia de la información relativa a los eventos HS registrados según la gravedad (por ejemplo, nombre y apellidos de la persona lesionada, número/codigo de empleado, días de enfermedad, descripción / detalles de los eventos HS) con la documentación soporte de los eventos HS (por ejemplo, certificado médico; etc.)". _x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado negativo de las verificaciones, el Responsable, o delegado, HSEQ Colombia and Central America (EGP&TGX) solicita al Responsable delegado del Sitio los datos que faltan y/o solicita información / aclaraciones respectivas y/o corrige la data recibida._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado positivo de las verificaciones, los datos de los eventos de HS están disponibles en la herramienta HSEQ 4ALL para la unidad de Salud y Seguridad HSEQ (HSEQ EGP y Generación Térmica).
cells.T: HSEQ Colombia and Central America (EGP& Thermal Generation) (events)_x000D__x000D_Once received all the data relating to HS events throught the system HSEQ 4ALL from the Site Responsible delegate, the HSEQ Colombia and Central America (EGP&TGX), or delegate, performs the following:_x000D__x000D_i) a completeness check, verifying that all HSE events (Safety, Health and Environment) and related data for the period have been communicated in accordance with Policy n.106._x000D__x000D_ii)  a timely checking of all HS events for consistency between data and supporting documentation, verifying the correspondence of the information relating to the HS events recorded according to the severity (eg name and surname of the injured person, employee serial number, sick days, description / HS events details) with the documentation transmitted in support of the HS events (eg medical certificate; etc.)._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result of the checks, the HSEQ Colombia and Central America (EGP&TGX) Responsible, or delegate, requests to the Site Responsible the missing data and/or requests information / clarifications and corrects the data previously received._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result of the checks, data from HS events are available in the system HSEQ 4ALL tool for the HSEQ Health and Safety (HSEQ EGP and Thermal Generation) unit.

cells.S: Una vez recibidos todos los datos relativos a las horas de trabajo de los contratistas en la herramienta Gestor.com, remitidos directamente por las empresas contratistas, el Responsable o Delegado de la unidad de Governance & Contractors Control Col&CA realiza:i) una comprobación de integridad, verificando que están presentes los datos de las empresas contratistas de cada una de las lineas de negocio afectadas (Enel Green Power and Thermal Generation (excepto contratos de Ingeniería y Construcción- Proyectos Renovables); Enel Grids; Enel Commercial); ii) un control de razonabilidad, comparando los datos del mes de cierre con los mismos datos registrados para el mismo mes del año anterior, analizando las desviaciones superiores al 5% en valor absoluto.iii) un control de razonabilidad, comparando los datos del mes de cierre con los mismos datos registrados en el mes anterior del mismo año, analizando las desviaciones superiores al 5% en valor absoluto.En caso de resultado negativo del control, el Responsable o Delegado de la unidad de Governance & Contractors Control Col&CA solicita al Gestor Responsable (de cada una de las lineas de negocio) y a la empresa contratista para que revisen la información cargada en Gestor.com y realice las correcciones y/o aclaraciones sobre los datos recibidos.En caso de resultado positivo del control, el Responsable o Delegado de la unidad de Governance & Contractors Control Col&CA comparte mediante email los datos recogidos con su correspondiente Responsable de Línea de Negocio Local (Enel Green Power and Thermal Generation (excepto contratos de ingeniería y Construcción- Proyectos Renovables); Enel Grids; Enel Commercial). Posteriormente, los responsables o delegados de las lineas de negocio locales envian la información hacia la linea  Global mediante email y/o utilizando canal Teams e informa a la unidad HSEQ Cross and Activities Training (Enel Green Power and Thermal Generation; Enel Grids; Enel Commercial).
cells.T: Once all the data relating to the contractors' working hours have been received in the Gestor.com tool, sent directly by the contractors, the Governance & Contractors Control Col&CA Responsible or Delegate - Colombia, performs the following:(i) a completeness check, verifying that the all data of the contractor companies of each of the business lines concerned (Enel Green Power and Thermal Generation (except Engineering and Construction contracts - Renewable Projects); Enel Grids; Enel Commercial) are present; ii) a reasonableness check, comparing the data of the closing month with the same data recorded for the same month of the previous year, analyzing all deviations greater than 5% in absolute value.iii) a reasonableness check, comparing the data of the closing month with the same data recorded for the previous month of the same year, analyzing all deviations greater than 5% in absolute value.In case of a negative result of the control, the Responsible or Delegate of Governance & Contractors Control Col&CA requests to the Responsible professional of each of the business lines to clarify the data received and/or requests that they contact the contractors to review the information uploaded in Gestor.com.In case of a positive result of the control, the Responsible or Delegate of Governance & Contractors Control Col&CA shares by email the collected data with the corresponding Local Business Line Responsible (Enel Green Power and Thermal Generation (except Engineering and Construction contracts - Renewable Projects); Enel Grids; Enel Commercial). Subsequently, the local business line responsibles or delegates shares the information to the Global Business line via email or using a dedicated Teams channel and inform the HSEQ Cross and Activities Training unit (Enel Green Power and Thermal Generation; Enel Grids; Enel Commercial)

If any discrepancy with the policy is identified, the registrar is questioned as necessary to make corrections. In accordance with the policy, recordable events and HiPO, all necessary evidence is included as an attachment in the HSEQ4ALL, as per the requirements of Policy 106.

cells.S: HSEQ Enel Green Power Brasil Trimestralmente, após receber todos os dados relacionados às horas de trabalho dos terceiros pelo Responsável do Site, através da compilação de uma planilha excel “EGP_BRA_QSE_FR_476_v1 - HHT CONTRACTED REPORT”, o responsável ou seu subordinado da HSEQ Enel Green Power Brasil realiza: i) uma verificação de integridade, verificando se todos os Responsáveis do Site comunicaram os dados; ii) uma verificação razoável face às tendências históricas, considerando variações e comparando-as com projetos em construção e usinas em operação; Em caso de discrepância, o Responsável ou seu subordinado da HSEQ Enel Green Power Brasil solicita, via e-mail/teams ao Responsável do Site esclarecimentos sobre os dados recebidos. - Em caso de resultado positivo da verificação, o responsável ou subordinado HSEQ Enel Green Power Brasil coleta através das planilhas excel “EGP_BRA_QSE_FR_476_v1 - HHT CONTRACTED REPORT” de todas as localidades/plantas (usinas/obras) os dados relacionados às horas dos terceiros, compartilha os dados coletados com sua linha de negócios global correspondente em uma equipe dedicada no Microsoft Teams através de pasta especifica com os dados compilados em formato excel do País.
