cells.S: HSEQ Enel Commercial BrasilTrimestralmente, são recebidos os dados relacionados às horas de trabalho dos terceiros das obras ou serviços da Enel Commercial Brasil, através da planilha "Controle Mensal de dados", e compartilhada, via OneDrive, pelas empresas contratadas. Paralelamente, os dados relacionados às horas de trabalho dos terceiros da área de Mercado GCO, são recebidos pelas contratadas através da planilha "Relatório Gerencial Hora Homem Mensal" dentro do sistema Gestão de Parceiros.Após o recebimento dos dados, o responsável ou seu subordinado da HSEQ Enel Commercial Brasil realiza:i) Uma verificação de integridade, verificando se todos as contratadas comunicaram os dados e se os dados estão de acordo, com o quantitativo de empregados aprovados a prestarem serviço;ii) Uma verificação razoável face às tendências históricas, considerando variações e comparando-as com projetos em construção;Em caso de resultado negativo, o Responsável ou seu subordinado da HSEQ Enel Commercial Brasil solicita, via e-mail, ao Responsável do Site ou gestores do contrato, esclarecimentos sobre os dados recebidos.Em caso de resultado positivo, o responsável ou subordinado HSEQ Enel Commercial Brasil coleta os dados relacionados às horas dos terceiros nas planilhas "Controle Mensal de dados" e "Relatório Gerencial Hora Homem Mensal" e inserem os dados nas planilhas padrão exigida pela holding, "AAAAMMDD_CWH_Brazil" (para Enel Commercial BR) e "AAAAMMDD_CWH.Market GCO_Brazil" (área de Mercado GCO) e compartilha os dados coletados com sua área de HSEQ global, através de uma pasta compartilhada via Sharepoint.
cells.T: HSEQ Enel Commercial BrazilQuarterly, the data related to the working hours of third parties for Enel Commercial Brazil works or services are received, through the "Monthly Data Control" spreadsheet, and shared via OneDrive by contracted companies. At the same time, the data related to the working hours of third parties in the Market unit GCO, are received by the contracted companies through the spreadsheet "Management Hour Monthly Man" within the Partner Management system (Gestão de Pessoas).The HSEQ Enel Commercial Brazil Responsible, or delegate, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that all Site Responsibles communicated the data and whether the data are in accordance with the number of employees approved to provide the service;ii) a reasonable check vs the historical trends, taking into account previous variances and comparing it to projects underway;In case of negative result, the HSEQ Enel Commercial Brazil Responsible, or delegate, requests to the Site Responsible clarifications about the data received.In case of positive result, the HSEQ Enel Commercial Brazil Responsible or his delegate collects data related to the hours of third parties in the "Monthly Data Control" and "Management Monthly Man Hour" worksheets and enters the data in the standard worksheets required by the holding, " YYYYMMDD_CWH_Brazil" (for Enel Commercial BR) and "YYYYMMDD_CWH.Market GCO_Brazil" (Market unit GCO) and share the collected data with your global HSEQ area, via a shared folder via Sharepoint.

Em caso de resultado negativo, e-mail do Responsável ou seu subordinado da HSEQ Enel Commercial Brasil solicitando ao Responsável do Site ou gestores do contrato, esclarecimentos sobre os dados recebidos;4. Em caso de resultado positivo, armazenamento das planilhas padão "AAAAMMDD_CWH_Brazil" (para Enel Commercial BR) e "AAAAMMDD_CWH.Market GCO_Brazil" (área de Mercado GCO) no SharePoint com os dados relacionados às horas dos terceiros coletados pelo responsável ou subordinado HSEQ Enel Commercial Brasil a fim de compartilhar com a área de HSEQ global.

cells.S: HSEQ Enel Commercial BrasilTendo recebido todos os dados relativos aos eventos de HS comunicados por e-mail do Responsável do Site por meio de um arquivo xls (Anexo 1 Política n.106), o Responsável HSEQ Enel Commercial Brasil ou seu subordinado realiza:i) uma verificação de integridade, verificando se todos os eventos de HS e dados relacionados para o período foram comunicados de acordo com a Política n.106, conciliando com as comunicações referentes.ii) uma verificação oportuna de todos os eventos de HS de consistência entre dados e documentação de suporte, verificando a consistência das informações relativas aos eventos de HS registrados de acordo com a gravidade (por exemplo, nome e sobrenome da pessoa lesionada, número do funcionário, dias de doença, descrição/detalhes dos eventos) com a documentação apresentada em apoio aos eventos do HS (e.g. atestado médico).Em caso de resultado negativo, o responsável da HSEQ Enel Commercial Brasil Responsável ou seu subordinado solicita ao Responsável local os dados pendentes e/ou solicita informações/esclarecimentos ao Responsável do local e corrige os dados recebidos anteriormente.Em caso de resultado positivo, o responsavél HSEQ Enel Commercial Brasil ou seu subordinado carrega o arquivo excel (ref. Anexo 3 Política n.106) em um canal de Equipes dedicado da equipe de HSEQ da Enel Commercial.
cells.T: HSEQ Enel Commercial BrazilHaving received all the data relating to HS events communicated by email from the Site Responsible via an xls file (Annex 1 Policy n.106), the HSEQ Enel Commercial Brazil Responsible, or delegate, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that all HS events and related data for the period have been communicated in accordance with Policy n.106.ii) a timely check on all HS events of consistency between data and supporting documentation, verifying the consistency of the information relating to the HS events recorded according to severity (e.g. name and surname of the injured person, employee number, days of illness, HS events description/details) with the documentation submitted in support of the HS events (e.g. medical certificate).In case of negative result, the HSEQ Enel Commercial Brazil Responsible, or delegate, requests to the Site Responsible the missing data and/or requests information / clarifications to the individual Site Responsible and corrects the data previously received.In case of positive result, the HSEQ Enel Commercial Brazil Responsible, or delegate, uploads the excel file (ref. Annex 3 Policy n.106) on a dedicated Teams channel of the HSEQ Cross Activity and Training Unit (GBL Enel Commercial).

cells.S: HSEQ StaffO responsável de HSEQ Brazil, ou seu delegado, após calcular os dados relativos às horas trabalhadas dos contratados, realiza:i) uma verificação de integridade, confirmando a presença dos dados de todas as unidades organizacionais envolvidas;ii) uma verificação de razoabilidade em relação ao mesmo valor registrado no mesmo trimestre do ano anterior, investigando quaisquer desvios significativos e inesperados (superiores a 10%) ou relacionados ao percentual do crescimento anual.Em caso de resultado negativo, o responsável de HSEQ Brazil, ou seu delegado, procede à correção do cálculo dos dados relativos às horas trabalhadas dos contratados.Em caso de resultado positivo, o responsável de HSEQ Brazil, ou seu delegado, compartilha por e-mail os dados relativos às horas trabalhadas dos contratados com a unidade HSEQ Cross Activities and Reporting (P&O Holding).
cells.T: HSEQ StaffThe Responsable of HSEQ Brazil or delegate, once calculated the data related to the contractors' worked hours, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that the data of all organizational units concerned are present;ii) a reasonableness check against the same value recorded in the same quarter of the previous year, investigating any significant and unexpected deviations (greater than 10% ), or related to the percentage of the progressive annual.In case of negative result, the  Responsable of HSEQ Brazil, or  delegate, proceed to correct the calculation of the data related to the contractors' worked hours.In case of a positive result, the  Responsable of HSEQ Brazil, or  delegate, shares via email the data related to the contractors' worked hours with  the unit HSEQ Cross Activities and Reporting (P&O Holding).

cells.S: Tras la validación en EDEN de los datos relativos a las extracciones de agua por parte del profesional  Environment Col&CAM  (HSEQThermal /Hydro/Solar Col&CAM)   de planta y que contribuyen a las siguientes métricas:_x000D__x000D_a) Specific freshwater withdrawals_x000D_b) Water withdrawals by source (scarce source and non scarce source)._x000D_c) Total water withdrawals used by production processes_x000D_d) Total withdrawals for Water used for once through cooling system_x000D_e) Water withdrawal in “water stressed” areas_x000D_f) Percentage of recycled and reused water_x000D_g) Water consumption_x000D_h) Water consumption in area water stressed_x000D_el Responsable de   Environment Col&CAM   o  delegado, realiza:_x000D__x000D_(i) una comprobación de integridad, verificando que todas las plantas dentro del perímetro del país han cargado los datos en EDEN;_x000D_(ii) un control de razonabilidad, comparando los datos del periodo actual con el valor del periodo correspondiente del año anterior e investigando cualquier desviación en valor absoluto por encima del umbral del 20%._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, el Responsable de   Environment Col&CAM  o  delegado,  comunica por correo electrónico con el profesional  Environment Col&CAM (HSEQ Thermal/Hydro/Solar Col&CAM) de planta para solicitar aclaraciones/integraciones sobre los datos registrados en EDEN. _x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, el Responsable de   Environment Col&CAM  o  delegado, procede a validar en EDEN  formulario aprobación en  "validado a nivel país".

cells.S: Tras la creación y antes del cierre de cada incidente de nivel 4, un delegado del Responsable de CERT o su delegado realiza una verificación de la corrección del nivel de impacto atribuido (potencial o efectivo), modificándolo si es necesario. El Responsable de CERT o su delegado también realiza una verificación de la integridad de los incidentes creados en C-Rise frente a los eventos recibidos por los operadores de CERT y reportados por las diferentes fuentes disponibles (internas y externas a ENEL).En caso de resultado negativo, el Responsable de CERT o su delegado contacta al especialista de CERT para analizar las anomalías encontradas y, en caso de incompletitud, proceder con la creación del incidente eventual en C-Rise.En caso de resultado positivo, es decir, en ausencia de cambios en el impacto o creación de nuevos incidentes, los datos estarán disponibles en el sistema.
cells.T: Following the creation and before the closure of each level 4 incident, a delegate of the Responsible of CERT, or delegate, performs a verification of the correctness of the impact level attributed (potential or effective), modifying it if necessary. The Responsible of CERT o delegate also performs a completeness check of the incidents created on C-Rise against the events received by CERT operators and reported by the different available sources (internal and external to ENEL)._x000D_In case of negative result, the Responsible of CERT o delegate contacts the CERT specialist in order to analyze the anomalies found and, in case of incompleteness, proceed with the creation of the eventual incident on C-Rise._x000D_In case of positive result, i.e., in the absence of impact changes or creation of new incidents, the data are available in the system.

cells.S: Cada vez que ocurre un evento de Grado 4 e informado en C-RISE, la unidad de Cyber Security Standards & External Stakeholders (S&ES)  junto al CERT verifica si el incidente constituye o no un incumplimiento normativo, considerando tanto las directrices internas como los estándares de ciberseguridad aplicables.En caso de que el incidente no sea considerado un incumplimiento, este será gestionado de acuerdo con el procedimiento OP204.En caso de que sí se determine como un incumplimiento normativo, la documentación de respaldo se almacena conforme a las políticas internas para fines de reporte.
cells.T: Every time a Grade 4 event occurs and is reported in C-RISE, the Cyber Security Standards & External Stakeholders (S&ES) unit, along with CERT, verifies if the incident is or not a non-compliance incident, taking also in consideration the internal guidelines and the applicable cybersecurity standards._x000D_In case the incident is not a non-compliance incident, the incident will be managed in accordance with the OP204._x000D_In case the incident is a non-compliance incident, the supporting documentation is stored in accordance with the internal policies for reporting purpose.

cells.S: En el sistema EDEN se muestran los formularios a ser completados por los responsables de cada central de Iberia o sus delegados, en relación con los datos sobre: las pérdidas de SF6 para las actividades de generación, utilizados para el cálculo de las siguientes métricas:i) Total emisiones directas (Scope 1), ii) Otras emisiones de CO2eq debido a la producción de electricidad y otras actividadesiii) Emisiones específicas de CO₂eq del Scope 1.- El Consumo de electricidadd tomada de la red para la producción en las centrales  Térmicas,  utilizadas dentro del cálculo de las siguientes métricas:i) Scope 2 Total Emisiones indirectas -  basado en el mercadoii) Scope 2 Total emisiones indirectas - basado en la ubicaciónEl responsable de  Environment (HSEQ Iberia), o su delegado, realiza:i) Una comprobación de integridad, verificando que todos los gestores de las Centrales han cargado los datos en el sistema EDEN. ii) Una comprobación de la razonabilidad con respecto al valor anual anterior, analizando cualquier desviación en valor absoluto superior al umbral del 20%, que no tenga una justificación razonable y conocida.En caso de un resultado negativo del control, el responsable de Environment (HSEQ Iberia) o su delegado, procede a devolver la ficha al nivel anterior notificando, mediante un comentario en el sistema y/o enviando un correo electrónico, al Responsable de la entrada de datos una solicitud de aclaración/integración de los datos registrados, modificando los valores anómalos encontrados.Tras la modificación, el sistema envía automáticamente un correo electrónico al Operador en el sistema EDEN para notificar los cambios realizados.En caso de que el resultado de la comprobación sea positivo, el Responsable de Environment (HSEQ Iberia), o su delegado, valida la ficha mediante el estado de aprobación "validado a nivel de País": EDEN devuelve un mensaje al aprobador sobre la responsabilidad vinculada al proceso de validación y a partir de este momento la ficha ya no puede ser modificada, pasando a ser visible para el Responsable de Environment (HSEQ GBL EGP and Thermal Generation).
cells.T: Displayed on EDEN the sheet filled in by the Site Responsible of each Country Iberia regarding data related to SF6 losses for generation activities used within the calculation of the following metrics:i) Total direct emissions (SCOPE 1),ii) Other CO2eq emissions due to electricity production and other activitiesiii) Specific CO₂eq emissions from SCOPE 1;-  consumption of electricity acquired from the network for the production into thermoelectric plants  used within the calculation of the follwing metrics:i) SCOPE 2, market based - Total indirect emissions ii) SCOPE 2, location based - Total indirect emissions.The Environment (HSEQ Iberia) Responsible, or his delegate, carries out:i) a completeness check, verifying that all Country Iberia Site Responsible have uploaded the data into the EDEN system.ii) a reasonableness check compared to the previous annual value, investigating any deviations in absolute value higher than the 20% threshold  that do not have a reasonable and known justification.In case of a negative result of the check, the Environment (HSEQ Iberia) responsible, or delegate, proceed to send back the sheet to the previous level notifying, through a comment in the system and/or sending an e-mail, to the data entry Responsible a request for clarification / integration of the recorded data, modifying any anomalous values found.Following the modification, the system automatically sends an e-mail to the Operator in the EDEN system to notify the changes made.In case of a positive result of the check, the Environment (HSEQ Iberia) Responsible, or delegate, validates the sheet through the approval status "validated at Country level": EDEN returns a message to the approver regarding the responsibility connected to the validation process and from this moment onwards the sheet can no longer be modified, becoming visible to the Environment (HSEQ GBL EGP and Thermal Generation) Responsible.

cells.S: En el sistema EDEN se muestran los formularios a ser completados por el responsable de HSEQ de cada Línea tecnológica/ Area Hydro, en relación con los datos sobre consumo de combustibles fósiles en los motores auxiliares de las plantas renovables, utilizados para el cálculo de las siguientes métricas:i) Total emisiones directas (Scope 1),ii) Otras emisiones de CO2eq debido a la producción de electricidad y otras actividadesiii) Emisiones específicas de CO₂eq del Scope 1.El responsable de  Environment (HSEQ Iberia), o su delegado, realiza:i) Una comprobación de integridad, verificando que todos los responsables HSEQ de cada Línea tecnológica/ Area Hydro han cargado los datos en el sistema EDEN.ii) Una comprobación de la razonabilidad con respecto al valor anual anterior, analizando cualquier desviación en valor absoluto superior al umbral del 20%, que no tenga una justificación razonable y conocida.En caso de un resultado negativo del control, el responsable de Environment (HSEQ Iberia) o su delegado, procede a devolver la ficha al nivel anterior notificando, mediante un comentario en el sistema y/o enviando un correo electrónico al Responsable de la entrada de datos una solicitud de aclaración/integración de los datos registrados, modificando los valores anómalos encontrados.Tras la modificación, el sistema envía automáticamente un correo electrónico al Operador en el sistema EDEN para notificar los cambios realizados.En caso de que el resultado de la comprobación sea positivo, el Responsable de Environment (HSEQ Iberia), o su delegado, valida la ficha mediante el estado de aprobación "validado a nivel de País": EDEN devuelve un mensaje al aprobador sobre la responsabilidad vinculada al proceso de validación y a partir de este momento la ficha ya no puede ser modificada, pasando a ser visible para el Responsable de Environment (HSEQ GBL EGP and Thermal Generation).
cells.T: Displayed on EDEN the sheet filled in by the Responsible of each HSEQ Technology Line / Area Hydro regarding data related to combustion of fossil fuels in auxiliary engines for renewable sites used within the calculation of the following metrics:i) Total direct emissions (SCOPE 1),ii) Other CO2eq emissions due to electricity production and other activitiesiii) Specific CO₂eq emissions from SCOPE 1;The Environment (HSEQ Iberia) Responsible, or his delegate, carries out: i) a completeness check, verifying that the Responsibles of each HSEQ Technology Line / Area Hydro unit has uploaded the data into the EDEN system. ii) a reasonableness check compared to the previous annual value, investigating any deviations in absolute value higher than the 20% threshold that do not have a reasonable and known justification.In case of a negative result of the check, the Environment (HSEQ Iberia) Responsible, or delegate, proceeds to send back the sheet to the previous level making, through a comment in the system and/or sending an e-mail, to the Operator a request for clarification / integration of the recorded data, modifying any anomalous values found.Following the modification, the system automatically sends an e-mail to the Operator on the EDEN system to notify the changes made.In case of a positive result of the check, the Environment (HSEQ Iberia) Responsible, or delegate, validates the sheet through the approval status "validated at Country level": EDEN returns a message to the approver regarding the responsibility connected to the validation process and from this moment onwards the sheet can no longer be modified, becoming visible to the Environment (HSEQ GBL EGP and Thermal Generation) Responsible.

cells.S: Semestralmente , el Responsable de la Unidad EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Iberia – Environment. o delegado, tras la carga de datos de residuos por parte de las plantas, a partir de la lista de plantas de Iberia con una producción total de residuos superior a 400.000 kg durante el semestre, se utiliza para el cálculo de las siguientes métricas:_x000D_a) Total de residuos generados;_x000D_b) Cantidad total de residuos peligrosos;_x000D_c) Residuos cuya eliminación se ha evitado, con un desglose entre residuos peligrosos y no peligrosos y tipo de tratamiento:_x000D_d) Residuos destinados a la eliminación, con un desglose entre residuos peligrosos y no peligrosos y tipo de tratamiento;_x000D_e) Residuos no reciclados;_x000D_f) Porcentaje de residuos no reciclados_x000D_g) Residuos totales de cenizas y yeso reciclados, reutilizados o eliminados_x000D_extrae una muestra aleatoria equivalente al 30 % de las plantas y verifica la exactitud e integridad de los datos registrados en EDEN, comparándolos con la documentación justificativa (libro de registro de residuos de la generación o datos proporcionados mediante la plantilla de Excel)._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, el rResponsable de la Unidad EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Iberia – Environment. o delegado, procederá a devolver la hoja a EDEN al nivel anterior, notificando, mediante un comentario en el sistema o enviando un correo electrónico, al responsable de la entrada de datos una solicitud de aclaración o corrección de los datos registrados en EDEN._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, o tras corregir los errores o recibir la información solicitada, los datos estan disponibles en EDEN.
cells.T: Semi-annually, the Head of the EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Iberia – Environment Unit, or delegate, after the upload of waste data by the plants,starting from the list of Iberia plants with waste total production exceeding 400,000 kg during the semester and used in the calculation of the following metrics:  _x000D_a) Total Waste generated;_x000D_b) Total amount of hazardous waste._x000D_c) Waste diverted from disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;_x000D_d) Waste directed to disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;_x000D_e) Non-recycled waste;_x000D_f) Percentage of non-recycled waste;_x000D_g) Total ash and gypsum waste recycled/reused/disposed_x000D_extracts a random sample equal to 30% of the plants and verifies the accuracy and completeness of the data recorded in EDEN, by comparing them with the supporting documentation ('waste registry book of the generation ' or data provided through the Excel template)._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of the EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Iberia – Environment Unit, or delegate, proceed to send back in EDEN the sheet to the previous level notifying, through a comment in the system and/or sending an e-mail, to the data entry Responsible a request for clarification / correction of the recorded data in EDEN._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result, or after resolving errors and/or receiving the requested information, the data are available in EDEN.

cells.S: Tras la validación en EDEN de los datos de residuos por parte del Responsable HSEQ del Sitio y utilizados en el cálculo de las siguientes métricas_x000D_a) Total de residuos generados;_x000D_b) Cantidad total de residuos peligrosos;_x000D_c) Residuos cuya eliminación se ha evitado, con un desglose entre residuos peligrosos y no peligrosos y tipo de tratamiento:_x000D_d) Residuos destinados a la eliminación, con un desglose entre residuos peligrosos y no peligrosos y tipo de tratamiento;_x000D_e) Residuos no reciclados;_x000D_f) Porcentaje de residuos no reciclados_x000D_g) Residuos totales de cenizas y yeso reciclados, reutilizados o eliminados_x000D_el Responsable de la Unidad EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Ibe - Environment, o delegado, realiza: _x000D_i) una comprobación de integridad, verificando que todos los Responsables de Sitio de Iberia han cargado los datos en el sistema EDEN - Sustainability._x000D_ii) un control de razonabilidad comparando los datos del período actual con el período correspondiente del año anterior e investigando cualquier desviación absoluta que supere el umbral del 20%._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, el Responsable de la Unidad EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Ibe - Environment, o delegado, procede a remitir de vuelta en EDEN la hoja al nivel anterior notificando, mediante un comentario en el sistema y/o enviando un correo electrónico, al Responsable de ingreso de datos una solicitud de aclaración/corrección de los datos registrados en EDEN._x000D_Tras la modificación, el sistema EDEN - Sustainability envia automáticamente un correo electrónico al Operador para notificar los cambios realizados._x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, el Responsable de la Unidad EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Iberia – Medio Ambiente, o delegado, procede a la validación en EDEN aprobando el registro en estado “validado a nivel de País”.
cells.T: After the validation in EDEN of the waste data by the Site HSEQ Responsible and used in the calculation of the following metrics:  _x000D_a) Total Waste generated;_x000D_b) Total amount of hazardous waste._x000D_c) Waste diverted from disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;_x000D_d) Waste directed to disposal, breakdown by hazardous and non-hazardous waste and treatment type;_x000D_e) Non-recycled waste;_x000D_f) Percentage of non-recycled waste;_x000D_g) Total ash and gypsum waste recycled/reused/disposed_x000D_the Head of the EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Iberia – Environment Unit, or delegate, performs:_x000D_i) a completeness check, verifying that all sitesr under the Country’s responsibility have uploaded their data in EDEN;_x000D_ii) a reasonableness check, comparing the current period data with the corresponding period of the previous year and investigating any absolute deviations exceeding the 20% threshold._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of the EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Iberia – Environment Unit, or delegate, proceed to send back in EDEN the sheet to the previous level notifying, through a comment in the system and/or sending an e-mail, to the data entry Responsible a request for clarification / correction of the recorded data in EDEN._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of the EGP&TGX Iberia - HSEQ Iberia – Environment Unit, or delegate, proceeds with the validation in EDEN by approving the record in the status “validated at Country level”.

cells.M: Errata informativa di sostenibilità, dovuta all'utilizzo di dati (qualitativi o quantitativi) actual e/o stimati inaccurati/incompleti o all'omissione di dati (qualitativi o quantitativi) e stime
cells.N: Error in sustainability reporting, due to the use of inaccurate/incomplete actual and/or estimated data (qualitative or quantitative) or omission of data (qualitative or quantitative) and estimations
cells.S: A valle del trasferimento dei dati da Eden a Digital S o dell’upload dei dati tramite template in Digital S, il Responsabile dell'Unità di Environmental Perform Strategy & Report (Holding), o suo delegato, effettua una verifica di coerenza tra gli indicatori oggetto di disclosure pubblica presenti in Digital S, rispetto agli indicatori presenti in Eden/ calcolati manualmente._x000D_ _x000D_In caso di scostamenti il Responsabile di Environmental Perform Strategy & Report (Holding), o suo delegato, verifica eventuali problematiche dei dati di origine in sede di migrazione automatica da Eden/upload del template e/o dei KPI calcolati da Digital S ed in caso di accertato errore richiede a Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler o di procedere ad un nuovo upload del template/migrazione dei dati e ricalcolo degli indicatori a sistema o a una verifica del calcolo effettuato da Digital S._x000D_ _x000D_In caso di assenza di scostamenti, il Responsabile Environmental Perform Strategy & Report (Holding) o suo delegato appone un flag di approvazione in Digital S, validando in via definitiva gli indicatori presenti a sistema.
cells.T: Following the data transfer from Eden to Digital S or the upload of data through template in Digital S, the Environmental Perform Strategy & Report (Holding) Responsible, or delegate, performs a consistency check of the indicators object of publicly disclosure reported in Digital S and the indicators in Eden/manually calculated._x000D_ _x000D_In case of discrepancies, the Environmental Perform Strategy & Report (Holding) Responsible, or delegate, checks the possible problems with the source data during automatic migration from Eden/upload of the template and/or KPIs calculated by Digital S and, in the event of a confirmed error, requests to Global ICT - Staff & Services Digital Enabler to proceed with a new upload of the template/migration of data and recalculation of the indicators in the system or a verification of the calculation performed by Digital S._x000D_ _x000D_In case there are no discrepancies, the Environmental Perform Strategy & Report (Holding) Responsible, or delegate places an approval flag in Digital S, definitively validating the indicators in the system.
cells.AB: ERIKA CRISTINA CALDERARA;Francesca Scarcelli;Giulio Belz;
cells.AF: 1. In caso di esito negativo del controllo, evidenza della risoluzione delle problematiche riscontrate._x000D_2. In caso di esito positivo del controllo, validazione dei KPI presenti in Digital S da parte del Responsabile di Environmental Perform Strategy & Report, o suo delegato
cells.AG: 1. In case of negative result, evidence of the resolution of the issues found._x000D_2. In case of positive reslt, validation of the KPIs in Digital S by the Environmental Performance Strategy & Report Responsible, or delegate.

cells.S: Semiannually, the Head of HSEQ USA and Canada (EGP USA and Canada) :-	Verifies that each Site Responsible for each plant actually sent the whole set of contractors’ worked hours for the semester-	Performs an accuracy check, comparing for each plant the hours collected for the semester versus the hours collected in the same semester of the previous year, in order to identify any error in the collection.In case of negative result of the control, the HSEQ USA and Canada (EGP USA and Canada) Responsible requests to the Site Responsible the missing data till the collection is complete and/or asks for clarification in order to justify differences/inconsistencies.In case of positive result of the check, the HSEQ USA and Canada (EGP USA and Canada) or his delegate proceeds to digitally archive the supporting file of the worked hours collected and evidence of the checks performed.

cells.S: Después de mostrar los datos validados preliminarmente por el HSEQ Thermal Responsable de la zona en el sistema EDEN utilizados dentro del cálculo de las siguientes métricas: _x000D_i) Emisiones directas totales (SCOPE 1)_x000D_ii) Otras emisiones de CO2eq debidas a la producción de electricidad y otras actividades (SCOPE 1) _x000D_relacionados con:_x000D_ -NOX relacionados con la producción de energía termoeléctrica,               _x000D_el Responsable de Medio Ambiente (HSEQ Colombia & CA EGP y Generación Térmica), o delegado,  efectúa una revisión de la información, asi:_x000D_i) una comprobación de integridad, verificando que todos los administradores de centros de Colombia han cargado los datos en el sistema EDEN. _x000D_ii) un control de razonabilidad con respecto al valor anual anterior, investigando cualquier desviación en valor absoluto que supere el umbral del 20%._x000D_En caso de resultado negativo del control, el  responsable de Medio Ambiente (HSEQ Colombia & CA EGP y Generación Térmica), o su delegado, devolverá la ficha al nivel anterior, indicando, mediante un comentario en el sistema y/o enviando un correo electrónico, al encargado de la entrada de datos una solicitud de aclaración/adhesión a los datos registrados, rectificando los valores anómalos encontrados. Tras la modificación, el sistema envía automáticamente un correo electrónico al introductor de datos en el sistema EDEN notificando los cambios realizados._x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, el responsable de Medio Ambiente (Colombia & CA EGP y Generación Térmica), o su delegado, valida la ficha aprobándola en estado "validado a nivel de país". EDEN devuelve un aviso que advierte de la responsabilidad asumida y a partir de este momento la ficha deja de ser editable, pasando a ser visible para el responsable de Proyectos Ambientales (HSEQ GBL EGP y Generación Térmica).
cells.T: After displaying the data preliminarily validated by the HSEQ Thermal Manager of the zone in the EDEN system used within the calculation of the following metrics:_x000D_i) Total direct emissions (SCOPE 1) _x000D_ii) Other CO2eq emissions due to electricity production and other activities _x000D_related to:_x000D_-NOX related to thermoelectric energy production_x000D_the Head of Environment (HSEQ Colombia & Central America – Enel Green Power and TGX), or delegate, performs a review of the information, as follows:_x000D_(i) a completeness check, verifying that all site managers in Colombia have uploaded the data into the EDEN system. _x000D_ii) a reasonableness check with respect to the previous annual value, investigating any deviation in absolute value that exceeds the 20% threshold._x000D_In case of a negative result, the Head of Environment (HSEQ Colombia & CA EGP and Thermal Generation), or his delegate, will return the file to the previous level, indicating, through a comment in the system and/or by sending an e-mail, to the data entry responsible a request for clarification/addition to the recorded data, rectifying the anomalous values found. After the modification, the system automatically sends an e-mail to the data entry clerk in the EDEN system notifying the changes made._x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of Environment (Colombia  & CA EGP and Thermal Generation), or his delegate, validates the file in "validated at country level" status. EDEN returns a message to the approver about the responsibility related to the validation process and from this moment the sheet can no longer be modified, becoming visible to the Head of Environment Projects (HSEQ GBL EGP and Thermal Generation).

cells.S: Una vez cargada la información en el sistema EDEN por el profesional de Medio Ambiente (Enel Grids Colombia) con la hoja relacionada para los datos relacionados con pérdidas de SF6 para actividades de distribución utilizadas dentro del cálculo de las siguientes métricas: _x000D_i) Emisiones directas totales (SCOPE 1) _x000D_ii) Otras emisiones de CO2eq debidas a la distribución de electricidad._x000D_- y el cálculo automático realizado por EDEN respecto a la metrica Emisiones de SF6 CO₂eq. _x000D_el Jefe de Medio Ambiente (Enel Grids Colombia), o su delegado, realiza:_x000D_i) una verificación de integridad, verificando que los datos de todas las Áreas en alcance de Enel Grids Colombia estén cargados en el sistema EDEN._x000D_ii) una verificación de razonabilidad en comparación con el trimestre anterior y al valor total anual anterior durante la última verificación del año, investigando posibles desviaciones en valor absoluto superiores al umbral del 20%. _x000D_En caso de resultado negativo de las verificaciones (integridad no correcta, o variaciones absoilutas superiores al 20%), el Jefe de Medio Ambiente (Enel Grids Colombia), o su delegado, envía un correo electrónico al Responsable del Área, o su delegado, para obtener aclaraciones sobre los datos registrados, variaciones y/o modificar los valores anómalos encontrados. _x000D_En caso de resultado positivo de las verificaciones, el Jefe de Medio Ambiente (Enel Grids Colombia), o su delegado, procede a validar la hoja a través del estado de aprobación "validado a nivel de País": EDEN devuelve un mensaje al aprobador sobre la responsabilidad relacionada con el proceso de validación y a partir de este momento la hoja ya no podrá ser modificada, pasando a ser visible para el Responsable de la Unidad de Medio Ambiente de HSE (Enel Grids and Innovability).
cells.T: Once the information is uploaded into the EDEN system by the HSE - Environment (Enel Grids Colombia) professional with the related sheet for the data of SF6 losses for distribution activities used within the calculation of the following metrics: _x000D_i) Total Direct Emissions (SCOPE 1) _x000D_ii) Other CO2eq emissions due to electricity distribution and other activities; _x000D_- and the automatic calculation performed by EDEN regarding the metrics Specific CO₂eq emissions from Scope 1_x000D_the Head of HSEQ - Environment (Enel Grids Colombia), or his delegate, performs:_x000D_(i) a completeness check, verifying that the data of all the Areas in scope of Enel Grids Colombia are loaded in the EDEN system._x000D_ii) a reasonableness verification compared to the previous quarter and to the previous annual total value during the last verification of the year, investigating possible deviations in absolute value above the 20% threshold. _x000D_In case of negative result of the verifications (integrity not correct, or absoiluted variations higher than 20%), the Head of HSE - Environment (Enel Grids Colombia), or his delegate, sends an email to the Area Manager, or his delegate, to obtain clarifications on the recorded data, variations and/or modify the anomalous values found. _x000D_In case of positive result of the verifications, the Head of HSE - Environment (Enel Grids Colombia), or his delegate, proceeds to validate the sheet through the approval status "validated at Country level". EDEN returns a message to the approver about the responsibility related to the validation process and from this moment the sheet can no longer be modified, becoming visible to the Head of HSE - Environment (Enel Grids and Innovability).

cells.S: Una vez cargada la información en el sistema EDEN por el profesional de Governance & Contractors Control Col&CAM con la hoja relacionada para los datos de las siguientes métricas: i) Emisiones directas totales (SCOPE 1) ii) Otras emisiones de CO2eq debidas a la producción de electricidad y otras actividades relacionados con: - cantidad de combustibles fósiles y energía consumida por la flota de transporte de la empresa;- cantidad de gases y metano consumido en oficinas y la cantidad de pérdidas de gases refrigerantes de la empresa;El Jefe de HSEQ Staff & Services Col & CA, o su delegado, realiza:i) una verificación de integridad, verificando que los datos de todas las Áreas en alcance estén cargados en el sistema EDEN.ii) una verificación de razonabilidad en comparación con el semestre anterior y al valor total anual anterior durante la última verificación del año, investigando posibles desviaciones en valor absoluto superiores al umbral del 20%. En caso de resultado negativo de las verificaciones (integridad no correcta, o variaciones absolutas superiores al 20%), el Jefe HSEQ Staff & Services Col & CA, o su delegado, rechaza en EDEN la carga y solicita las correcciones en el mismo sistema.En caso de resultado positivo de las verificaciones, el Jefe HSEQ Staff & Services Col & CA, o su delegado, procede a validar la hoja a través del estado de aprobación "validado a nivel de País": EDEN devuelve un mensaje al aprobador sobre la responsabilidad relacionada con el proceso de validación y a partir de este momento la hoja ya no podrá ser modificada, pasando a ser visible para el Responsable de la Unidad de HSEQ (Holding).
cells.T: Once the information was uploaded into the EDEN system by the  professional of Governance & Contractors Control Col&CAM  with the related sheet for the data of the following metrics: i) Total direct emissions (SCOPE 1) ii) Other CO2eq emissions due to electricity production and other activities (SCOPE 1) related to: - quantity of fossil fuels and energy consumed by the company fleet;- quantity of gas oil in energy consumption and use of refrigerant gases of the company;the Head of HSEQ Staff & Services Col & CA, or his delegate, performs:(i) a completeness check, verifying that the data of all the Areas in scope of Enel Grids Colombia are loaded in the EDEN system.ii) a reasonableness verification compared to the previous semester and to the previous annual total value during the last verification of the year, investigating possible deviations in absolute value above the 20% threshold. In case of negative result of the verifications (integrity not correct, or absoiluted variations higher than 20%), the Head of HSEQ Staff & Services Col & CA, or his delegate, rejects the data in EDEN and requests that the corrections be made within the system.In case of positive result of the verifications, the Head of HSEQ Staff & Services Col & CA, or his delegate, proceeds to validate the sheet through the approval status "validated at Country level": EDEN returns a message to the approver about the responsibility related to the validation process and from this moment the sheet can no longer be modified, becoming visible to the Head of HSEQ (Enel Grids Global).

cells.S: Mensualmente, una vez recibido el correo electrónico por el profesional de Operation Termozipa Col con el cálculo de emisión de CO₂ de las centrales termoeléctricas  en el archivo "RG01-TZPA ST02ST05 15 I 004 D Cálculo de emisiones de SO2 CO2 NOx y MP.xls", el Profesional de HSEQ Thermal Col, o delegado, realiza lo siguiente:_x000D_i. Verifica la integridad, de la totalidad de los datos de emisión de CO₂ de las centrales termoeléctricas para todas las unidades de la central eléctrica de Termozipa._x000D_ii. Verifica la consistencia y la exactitud de los datos utilizados en el cálculo y comparándolos con la documentación justificativa _x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, el Profesional de HSEQ Thermal Col, solicita al Profesional de Operation Termozipa Colombia o delegado las correciones o aclaraciones. _x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, el Profesional de HSEQ Thermal Col guarda digitalmente los archivos revisados.

cells.S: Mensualmente, el profesional de HV Maintenance Colombia o delegado, revisa la información reportada por parte de los contratos de mantenimiento de Alta Tensión en AMATIA a través del formato RG01-WKI-HSEQ-E-21-0081-CODE verificando:_x000D_- El equipo de potencia al cual se asocia una recarga de gas SF6 corresponde a un equipo presurizado._x000D_- La cantidad de recarga de gas SF6 en el equipo de potencia se encuentre dentro del parámetro de recarga (menor a 9kg y fuera de los promedios historicos de recarga de gas) _x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, profesional de HV Maintenance Colombia o delegado envia un correo electrónico al contratista para que realice la revisión, justificación de la inconsistencia identificada. Cuando el formato inicial contiene errores que requieren modificaciones el profesional de HV Maintenance Colombia o delegado no aprueba el formato y el contrato debe realizar la correcciòn y una nueva carga del formato en el sistema Amatia._x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, el profesional de HV Maintenance Colombia o delegado, aprueba el formato RG01-WKI-HSEQ-E-21-0081-CODE en el sistema Amatia status “aprobado”.
cells.T: On a monthly basis, the Professional of HV Maintenance Colombia or delegate reviews the information reported by the High Voltage maintenance contractors in AMATIA through a report in RG01-WKI-HSEQ-E-21-0081-CODE format verifying:_x000D_- That the power equipment to which a SF6 gas recharge is associated corresponds to pressurized equipment;_x000D_- That the amount of SF6 gas recharge in the power equipment is within the recharge parameter (less than 9kg and outside of historical gas refueling averages)._x000D_In case of negative result, the Professional of HV Maintenance Colombia or delegate sends an e-mail to the contractor to review and justify the identified inconsistency. When the initial format contains errors that require modifications, the Professional of HV Maintenance Colombia or delegate does not approve the format and the contractor must make the correction and reload the format in the AMATIA system._x000D_In case of positive result, the Professional of HV Maintenance Colombia or delegate approves the report in RG01-WKI-HSEQ-E-21-0081-CODE format in the AMATIA system in status "approved".

cells.S: El Profesional de Supply Chain Support Colombia o delegado realiza la revisión mensual de la información cargada por parte de los contratistas a través de la plataforma AMATIA. En esta revisión, verifica los registros reportados, y  compara los datos de consumo de combustible de plantas auxiliares reportados vs. los soportes de compra de los combustibles cargados por los contratistas.En caso de resultado negativo (identificar alguna inconsistencia), el Profesional de Supply Chain Support Colombia o delegado rechaza por sistema AMATIA y solicita por mismo sistema al contratista para que realice la revisión, justificaciòn de la inconsistencia identificada. Cuando el formato inicial contiene errores que requieren modificaciones el Profesional de Supply Chain Support Colombia o delegado no aprueba el formato y el contrato debe realizar la correcciòn y una nueva carga del formato en el sistema Amatia.En caso de resultado positivo (no identificar comentarios o inconsistencias), el Profesional de Supply Chain Support Colombia o delegado  aprueba el registro en el sistema Amatia “aprobado”.
cells.T: The Supply Chain Support Colombia professional or delegate performs a monthly review of the information uploaded by contractors through the AMATIA platform. In this review, he verifies the reported records, and compares the fuel consumption data of auxiliary plants reported vs. the fuel purchase supports uploaded by the contractors.In case of negative result (detect any inconsistency), the Supply Chain Support Colombia professional or delegate rejects the form via the AMATIA system and requests, through the same system, that the contractor review and provide an explanation for the identified inconsistency. When the initial format contains errors that require modifications, the Supply Chain Support Colombia professional or delegate does not approve the format and the contract must make the correction and reload the format in the Amatia system.In case of positive result (no comments or inconsistencies identified), the Supply Chain Support Colombia professional approves the format in the Amatia system "approved".

cells.N: FINTRE5-Reconciliation of bank accounts vs FINTRE3-Processing of bank payments
cells.S: Trimestralmente, la Responsabile di Enel Reinsurance (o un suo Delegato), senza le incompatibilità SoD oggetto del controllo, estrae dal sistema SAP E4E S4P il report di tutti i documenti SAP relativi ai pagamenti su banca sui quali sono state eseguite sia le attività di elaborazione del pagamento e sia la relativa attività di riconciliazione delle movimentazioni impattanti i conti banca da parte di uno stesso utente di Enel Reinsurance in possesso delle incompatibilità SoD in oggetto._x000D_In caso di esito positivo del controllo, la Responsabile di Enel Reinsurance, o un suo Delegato, approva direttamente in SAP le attività di elaborazione e riconciliazione dei pagamenti banca eseguite dagli stessi utenti di Enel Reinsurance, salvando in Excel il report analizzato e il log delle approvazioni rilasciate in SAP, verificando che tutte le attività del trimestre elencate siano state da lui riviste e approvate._x000D_In caso di esito negativo del controllo, la Responsabile di Enel Reinsurance, o un suo Delegato, richiede all' utente della sua unità di provvedere alle opportune rettifiche e di ricevere adeguata evidenza delle rettifiche operate a sistema, salvando tutte le evidenze a supporto degli approfondimenti effettuati e delle rettifiche apportate a sistema relativamente alle attività dei Report non approvate in SAP (se presenti).
cells.T: Quarterly, the Head of Enel Reinsurance (or her Delegate), without the related SoD risks, extracts from the SAP E4E S4P system a report of all SAP documents relating to bank payments on which both the payment processing activities and the related reconciliation of transactions affecting bank accounts have been carried out by the same Enel Reinsurance user possessing the SoD incompatibilities in question._x000D_In case of positive outcome, the Head of Enel Reinsurance, or her Delegate, directly approves in SAP the bank payment processing and reconciliation activities carried out by the same Enel Reinsurance users, saving the analysed report and the log of approvals issued in SAP to Excel, and verifying that all the activities for the quarter listed have been reviewed and approved by them._x000D_In case of negative outcome, the Head of Enel Reinsurance, or her Delegate, requests the necessary corrections and the adequate evidence of the corrections made to the system, saving all supporting evidence of the investigations carried out and the corrections made to the system regarding the activities in the reports not approved in SAP (if any).
cells.AB: MARIA ELDA VITO;
cells.AF: 1) Report trimestrali in Excel e relativi log delle approvazioni rilasciate in SAP, da cui si evinca che la Responsabile di Enel Reinsurance, o un suo Delegato, abbia approvato tutte le operazioni effettuate nel trimestre dagli utenti dell'unità in possesso delle incompatibilità SoD (in caso sia le attività di elaborazione pagamenti su banca e sia le relative attività di riconciliazione delle movimentazioni impattanti i conti banca da parte di uno stesso utente dell'unità siano state riscontrate e l'esito del controllo sia positivo)._x000D_2) Evidenze degli approfondimenti effettuati e delle rettifiche effettuate a sistema all'interno di Enel Reinsurance su richiesta della Responsabile, o del suo Delegato (in caso  sia le attività di elaborazione pagamenti su banca e sia le relative attività di riconciliazione delle movimentazioni impattanti i conti banca da parte di uno stesso utente dell'unità siano state riscontrate e in caso l'esito del controllo sia negativo).
cells.AG: 1) Quarterly reports in Excel and the corresponding logs of approvals issued in SAP, showing that the Head of Enel Reinsurance, or her Delegate, approved all transactions carried out during the quarter by users of the unit with SoD conflicts (where both bank payment processing activities and the related reconciliation of transactions affecting bank accounts by the same user within the unit have been identified and in case of positive outcome)._x000D_2) Evidence of the investigations carried out and the adjustments made within the system for Enel Reinsurance and requested from the Head, or her Delegate (where both the processing of bank payments and the related reconciliation of transactions affecting bank accounts by the same user within the unit have been identified and in case of negative outcome).

cells.S: L'applicazione Dashboard Monitoring nella Global Customer Room  verifica gli esiti di risalita dei flussi dei dati relativi all'NPS registrati nei sistemi locali per l'app. Global Claim. _x000D_Nel caso in cui i flussi siano risaliti correttamente (segnalati in verde), l'applicazione non esegue alcuna ulteriore azione. _x000D_Nel caso in cui i flussi non siano risaliti correttamente (giallo e rosso), l'applicazione invia una mail automatica ai referenti di Enel Commercial Data Application (Global ICT) e agli owner di business al fine di notificare la problematica riscontrata e procedere con la azioni correttive.
cells.T: The Dashboard Monitoring application in the Global Customer Room verifies the results of the data flows relating to the NPS recorded in the local systems for the app. Global Claim. _x000D_In the event that the flows have risen correctly (marked in green), the application does not perform any further action. _x000D_In the event that the flows have not risen correctly (yellow and red), the application sends an automatic email to the Enel Commercial Data Application (Global ICT) operators and to the business owners in order to notify the problem encountered and proceed with corrective actions.

cells.S: Annualmente, il Responsabile dell'Unità Reporting and Control Model Governance (P&C Holding), o suo delegato, a seguito del calcolo dell'NPS consolidato a livello di gruppo, effettuato sulla base dei valori del NPS ricevuti dalle due GBL e dell'estrazione della customer base utilizzati per il calcolo della media ponderata,  verifica la correttezza del calcolo in base alla metodologia definita (media ponderata: NPS Paese × Customer Base Paese / Customer Base Totale)._x000D__x000D_In caso di esito negativo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Reporting and Control Model Governance (P&C Holding), o suo delegato, procede a correggere il calcolo._x000D_In caso di esito positivo, il Responsabile dell'Unità Reporting and Control Model Governance (P&C Holding), o suo delegato, invia il dato via mail all'Unità Sustainability Reporting.
cells.T: Annually, the Head of the Reporting and Control Model Governance (P&C Holding) Unit, or delegate, following the calculation of the consolidated NPS at group level, carried out on the basis of the NPS values received from the two GBLs and the extraction of the customer base used for the calculation of the weighted average, verifies the correctness of the calculation based on the defined methodology (weighted average: NPS Country × Country Customer Base / Total Customer Base)._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of the Reporting and Control Model Governance (P&C Holding) Unit, or delegate, proceeds to correct the calculation. _x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of the Reporting and Control Model Governance (P&C Holding) Unit, or delegate, sends the data to the Sustainability Reporting Unit.

cells.S: Semestralmente, com referência específica aos processos administrativos ambientais, o advogado responsável pela área de Meio Ambiente dentro do Departamento Jurídico e de Assuntos Corporativos do Brasil recebe por e-mail da unidade de HSEQ os reports “Controle Temas Jurídicos” (CE);  “Multas e Infrações” (RJ) e “Controle de Multas e Notificações.xlsx” (SP) referentes às multas ambientais significativas aplicadas.O advogado responsável pela área de Meio Ambiente dentro do Departamento Jurídico e de Assuntos Corporativos do Brasil verifica as informações referentes às notificações e valores, comparando-as com o e-mail enviado pela unidade de HSEQ.Em caso de resultado negativo (sem inconsistências), o advogado responsável pela área de Meio Ambiente dentro do Departamento Jurídico e de Assuntos Corporativos do Brasil solicita as correções necessárias por e-mail à unidade de HSEQ.Em caso de resultado positivo (sem inconsistências), o advogado responsável pela área de Meio Ambiente dentro do Departamento Jurídico e de Assuntos Corporativos do Brasil envia a planilha “Sanciones Ejecutoriadas_Brazil_YYYY_Enel Americas”, preenchida com o número de sanções e seus respectivos valores, ao advogado responsável pela área de Contencioso do Departamento Jurídico e de Assuntos Corporativos do Brasil, que consolida os indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e os envia por e-mail ao Departamento Jurídico e de Assuntos Corporativos do Chile.
cells.T: Semi-Annualy, with specific reference to environmental administrative proceedings, the lawyer in charge of Environmental within Legal and Corporate Affairs Brazil receives by e-mail from the unit HSEQ the reports: “Controle Temas Jurídicos” (CE);  “Multas e Infrações” (RJ) e “Controle de Multas e Notificações.xlsx” (SP), regarding the environment fines issued per each company regarding the significant environment fines issued. _x000D_The lawyer in charge of Environmental within Legal and Corporate Affairs Brazil checks the information registered regarding to notifications and amount compared to the e-mail sent by the unit HSEQ._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result (inconsistencies are found), the lawyer in charge of Environmental within Legal and Corporate Affairs Brazil requests the necessary corrections by e-mail to the unit HSEQ._x000D__x000D_In case of positive result (no inconsistencies are found), the lawyer in charge of Environmental within Legal and Corporate Affairs Brazil sends the worksheet “Sanciones Ejecutoriadas_Brazil_YYYY_Enel Americas” fulfilled with the number of sanctions and amount to the lawyer in charge of Legal and Corporate Affairs Brazil Litigations, who consolidates the KPIs and sends by e-mail to Legal and Corporate Affairs Chile.

cells.AF: 1) E-mail enviado pela unidade HSEQ contendo os relatórios: “Controle Temas Jurídicos” (CE);  “Multas e Infrações” (RJ) e “Controle de Multas e Notificações.xlsx” (SP) referentes às multas ambientais significativas;_x000D_2) Planilha “Sanciones Ejecutoriadas_Brazil_YYYY_Enel Americas” preenchida com o número e o valor das sanções ambientais;_x000D_3) E-mail enviado pelo Departamento Jurídico e de Assuntos Corporativos do Brasil ao advogado responsável pela área de Contencioso Jurídico e de Assuntos Corporativos do Brasil;_x000D_4) E-mail enviado pelo Departamento Jurídico e de Assuntos Corporativos do Brasil à unidade HSEQ solicitando as correções necessárias.

cells.S: Semestralmente, il Responsabile dell'Unità Data Protection Governance, o suo delegato, verifica che:- tutti i data breach notificati alle autorità competenti nel periodo risultino censiti nel Data Breach Management Tool;- per tutti i data breach notificati, sia disponibile, nel Data Breach Management Tool, la documentazione di supporto (es. evidenza della notifica o documentazione equivalente tracciata presso i DPO).In caso di esito negativo (assenza o incompletezza della documentazione, casi notificati non presenti nel tool), il Responsabile dell'Unità Data Protection Governance, o suo delegato, richiede ai DPO locali l’integrazione del registro e/o della documentazione mancante.In caso di esito positivo, i data breach notificati alle Autorità sono correttamente censiti a sistema.
cells.T: Semiannually, the Head of the Data Protection Governance Unit, or delegate, verifies that:- all data breaches notified to the competent authorities during the period are recorded in the Data Breach Management Tool;- for the notified data breaches recorded in the Data Breach Management Tool, relevant supporting documentation is available (e.g. evidence of the notification or equivalent documentation retained by the DPOs).In case of negative result (missing or incomplete documentation, or notified cases not recorded in the tool), the Head of the Data Protection Governance Unit, or  delegate, contacts the local DPOs asking for the update of the register and/or provide the missing documentation.In case of positive result, the notified data breaches are correctly recorded within the system.

cells.AG: 1) In case of negative result, request by the Head of the Data Protection Governance Unit, or delegate, to the DPOs to update the register and/or provide the missing documentation.2) In case of positive result, data breaches are correctly recorded within the system.

cells.S: Anualmente, el Responsable del Centro de Servicios Administrativos o su delegado revisa el archivo Excel "Reporte de Pagos EEFF 20XX CMF". Especificamente, el Responsable del Centro de Servicios Administrativos o su delegado realiza verificaciones de integridad y consistencia, revisando que los documentos pertinetes han sido considerados y los rangos de pago, tales como: _x000D_• Documentos no gravables no han sido incluidos;_x000D_• Documentos cancelados no han sido incluidos;_x000D_• Pagos en efectivo con registros contables mayores a 30 días ajustados al rango de 1 a 30 días;_x000D_• Proveedores extranjeros (comercio exterior) con anticipos, verificando compensaciones manuales contra pagos bancarios, revisando el rago al cual ha sido asignado ( advance al rango 1 a 30 días, payment al rango efectivo según día de pago)._x000D_En caso de resutado negativo, inconsistencia identificada, el Responsable del Centro de Servicios Administrativos o su delegado envía un correo electrónico al Especialista del Centro de Servicios Administrativos solicitando la corrección del archivo._x000D_En caso de resultado positivo,  no encontrar inconsistencia, el Responsable del Centro de Servicios Administrativos o su delegado envía por correo electrónico el "Reporte de Pagos EEFF 20XX CMF" a la unidad de Financial Statement EGP&TGx and E&CM Chile.
cells.T: Annually, the Administrative Service Center Responsible, or delegate, review the file "Payments Report EEFF 20XX CMF". Specifically, the Administrative Service Center Responsible, or  delegate, performs integrity and consistency checks, reviewing that the proper docuements have been considered and their payment ranges considered, such as:_x000D_• Non-taxable documents are not included;_x000D_• canceled documents  are not included;_x000D_• Advance Cash payments  and bank charge  have been adjusted to the range 1-30 days;_x000D_• Foreign suppliers (foreign trade) with advances, verifying manual offsets against bank payments in order to check the range to which has been assigned (manual offsets with advances payment are included in the range 1-30 days; whie bank payments assigned according the real payment date)._x000D_ _x000D_In case of negative result (inconsistency detected), the Administrative Service Center Responsible, or delegate, sends an email to the Administrative Service Center Specialist requesting  correction._x000D_In case of positive result (no inconsistency detected), the Administrative Service Center Responsible, or delegate, sends the "Payments Report EEFF 20XX CMF" via email to the Financial Statement EGP&TGx and E&CM Chile unit.

cells.S: Cada vez que la unidad HSE and Reputational Governance (Global Procurement) recibe un informe sobre una criticidad reportado por fuentes internas y externas a Enel, el Responsable de Qualification lo verifica con el fin de monitorear el mantenimiento de los requisitos reputacionales por parte del proveedor._x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado negativo (en caso de riesgo reputacional establecido), el Responsable de Qualification activa el proceso del Comité de Honorabilidad convocando a todas las unidades organizativas involucradas. El Responsable de Qualification, o delegado, informa el resultado de las evaluaciones realizadas por el Comité de Honorabilidad (confirmación del mantenimiento de requisitos / suspensión de la calificación del proveedor) dentro de la sección “Honorability Analysis” del proveedor en el sistema WeBuy.  _x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado positivo (si no se encuentran criticidades), el Responsable de Qualification confirma el mantenimiento de los requisitos reputacionales de los proveedores analizados dentro de la sección “Honorability Analysis” del proveedor en el sistema WeBuy.
cells.T: Each time a critical issue  is reported by internal and external sources to the HSE and Reputational Governance unit (Global Procurment), the Head of Qualification verifies it in order to monitor the maintenance of reputational requirements by the supplier._x000D__x000D_In case of negative result (in case of established reputational risk), the Head of Qualification activates the Honorability Committee process by convening all organizational units involved. The Head of Qualification, or delegate, reports the outcome of the evaluations carried out by the Honorability Committee (confirmation of maintenance of requirements/suspension of supplier qualification) within the "Honorability Analysis" section of the supplier present within the WeBuy system.       _x000D_   _x000D_In case of positive result (if no criticalities are found), the Head of Qualification confirms the maintenance of reputational requirements by the suppliers under analysis within the "Honorability Analysis" section of the supplier present within the WeBuy system.
cells.AB: MARIANO ALEJANDRO SALINAS;
cells.AF: 1) Correo electrónico con el reporte de criticidad enviado por la unidad HSE and Reputational Governance  (Global Procurment)._x000D_2) En caso de resultado negativo, activación del proceso del Comité de Honorabilidad y reporte en la sección “Análisis de Honorabilidad” del proveedor en el sistema WeBuy, confirmando el mantenimiento o la suspensión de la calificación del proveedor._x000D_3) En caso de resultado positivo, si no se encuentran criticidades, reporte en la sección “Análisis de Honorabilidad” del proveedor en el sistema WeBuy, confirmando el mantenimiento de los requisitos reputacionales por parte de los proveedores analizados.
cells.AG: 1) Mail with the issue report sent by the HSE and Reputational Governance unit (Global Procurment)._x000D_2) In case of negative results, activation of the Honorability Committee process and report in the “Honorability Analysis” section of the supplier within the WeBuy system, confirming maintenance or suspension of supplier qualification._x000D_3) In case of positive results, if no criticalities are found, report in the “Honorability Analysis” section of the supplier within the WeBuy system, confirming maintenance of reputational requirements by the suppliers under analysis.

cells.S: El Responsable de Qualification, o su delegado, tras recibir la propuesta de resultado del proceso de calificación en WeBuy, inicia sesión en el sistema y verifica la finalización de los pasos de calificación del proveedor por parte del equipo. En el caso de calificación por grupo de materias primas de riesgo medio/alto, el Responsable, o delegado, analiza la completitud y corrección de la documentación aportada por el proveedor y las verificaciones internas a cargo de Enel (evaluaciones de contratistas en materia de Seguridad y Medio Ambiente)._x000D_En caso de  resultado  negativo, el Responsable de Qualification aprueba la propuesta de No idoneidad del proveedor en WeBuy._x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, el Responsable de Qualification aprueba la propuesta de Idoneidad del proveedor en WeBuy.
cells.T: The Responsible of Qualification, or delegate, after receiving the proposed outcome of the qualification process in WeBuy, logs into the system and verifies the completion of the supplier qualification steps by the team. In the case of qualification by group of medium/high-risk raw materials, the Responsible, or delegate, reviews the completeness and accuracy of the documentation provided by the supplier and the internal verifications carried out by Enel (contractor evaluations regarding Safety and Environment)._x000D_In case of negative results, the Qualification Responsible approves the proposal of Non-suitability of the supplier in WeBuy._x000D_In case of positive results, the Qualification Responsible approves the proposal of Suitability of the supplier in WeBuy.

cells.S: Cada vez que la Unidad de HSE y Reputational Governance (Global Procurment) recibe un reporte de un problema crítico proveniente de fuentes internas y externas a Enel, el Responsable de Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia (Procurement Colombia & Central America) realiza un seguimiento del mantenimiento de los requisitos reputacionales por parte de los proveedores._x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, si no se encuentran criticidades, el Responsable de Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia (Procurement Colombia & Central America) confirma el mantenimiento de los requisitos reputacionales por parte de los proveedores analizados dentro de la sección "Análisis de Honorabilidad" del proveedor presente en el sistema WeBuy._x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, en caso de riesgo reputacional establecido, el Responsable de Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia (Procurement Colombia & Central America) activa el proceso de Comité de Honorabilidad convocando a todas las unidades organizativas implicadas._x000D_El Responsable de Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia (Procurement Colombia & Central America), o su delegado, informa del resultado de las evaluaciones realizadas por el Comité de Honorabilidad (confirmación del mantenimiento de los requisitos/suspensión de la calificación del proveedor) en la sección "Análisis de Honorabilidad" del proveedor presente en el sistema WeBuy.
cells.T: Each time a critical issue reported by reported by sources internal and external to Enel is received by the HSE and Reputational Governance (Global Procurment) Unit, the Head of Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia (Procurement Colombia & Central America) verifies it in order to monitor the maintenance of reputational requirements by the supplier._x000D_In case of positive result, if no criticalities are found, the Head of Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia (Procurement Colombia & Central America) confirms the maintenance of reputational requirements by the suppliers under analysis within the "Honorability Analysis" section of the supplier present within the WeBuy system._x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia (Procurement Colombia & Central America) activates the Honorability Committee process by convening all organizational units involved._x000D_The Head of Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia (Procurement Colombia & Central America), or delegate, reports the outcome of the evaluations carried out by the Honorability Committee (confirmation of maintenance of requirements/suspension of supplier qualification) within the "Honorability Analysis" section of the supplier present within the WeBuy system.

cells.S: El Responsable de Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia, o su delegado, tras recibir la propuesta de resultado del proceso de calificación en WeBuy, inicia sesión en el sistema y verifica la finalización de los pasos de calificación del proveedor por parte del equipo. En el caso de cualificación por grupo de materias primas de riesgo medio/alto, el Responsable, o delegado, analiza la completitud y corrección de la documentación aportada por el proveedor y las verificaciones internas a cargo de Enel (evaluaciones de contratistas en materia de Seguridad y Medio Ambiente)._x000D_Si el resultado es negativo, el Responsable de Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia no aprueba la calificación del proveedor._x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, el Responsable de Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia valida la propuesta de calificación del proveedor en WeBuy.
cells.T: The Head of Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia, or delegate, after receiving the proposal for the outcome of the qualification process in WeBuy, accesses the system and verifies the completion of the supplier's qualification steps by the team. In case of qualification for merchandise group with medium/high risk, the Head, or delegate, analyzes the completeness and correctness of the documentation provided by the supplier and the internal verifications in charge of Enel (contractor assessments of Safety and Environment)._x000D_In case of negative result, the Head of Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia does not approve the supplier's qualification._x000D_In case of positive result, the Head of Qualification & Supplier Performance Management Colombia validates the supplier's qualification proposal in WeBuy.

cells.S: Anualmente, una vez que los indicadores relacionados con el pago de facturas se hayan consolidado en el archivo «Pago Proveedores_Colombia_Año_Enel Americas.xls», el Jefe de Procure To Pay  Colombia o su delegado,  realiza verificaciones de integridad de los valores incluidos en el archivo «Pago Proveedores_Colombia_Año_Enel Americas.xls» revisando que:_x000D_- la base de càlculo incluye información relacionada con los proveedores nacionales y extranjeros_x000D_- los rangos de pago asignados y clasificación de registros en rangos (1–30 días, 31–60 días, más de 60 días) son correctos _x000D_- se han excluido documentos no relacionados con proveedores de la base de cálculo_x000D__x000D_En caso de resultado negativo, el Jefe de Procure To Pay  Colombia, o su delegado, procederá a corregir los indicadores en el archivo «Pago Proveedores_Colombia_Año_Enel Americas.xls»._x000D_En caso de resultado positivo, el Jefe de Procure To Pay  Colombia, o su delegado, comparte los indicadores por correo electrónico, con el Responsable de Regional Spoke PTP Latam, o su delegado.

cells.M: Incorreto / Falta de cálculo de depreciação
cells.N: Incorrect/Missing depreciation calculation
cells.S: Mensalmente, o Head de RTR – Ativo Fixo Brasil recebe, via e-mail do Analista de BPO – Ativo Fixo Brasil, a planilha “Conciliação AA FI AAAA MM.xls” e também a movimentação mensal da conta contábil dos sub ledgers (Fiscal, Regulatório e Societário) extraídas do balancete contábil no sistema SAP R/3 - AA e FI, transação F.01, a fim de validar a execução do teste de depreciação e a conciliação dos valores de depreciação efetiva lançados no respectivo mês versus contas contábeis entre os módulos AA e FI._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado negativo (se possuírem divergências), o Head de RTR – Ativo Fixo Brasil retorna a planilha “Conciliação AA FI AAAA MM.xls” via e-mail ao Analista de BPO – Ativo Fixo Brasil, solicitando as correções necessárias do teste de depreciação e ou depreciação efetiva (conciliação)._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado positivo (se não possuírem divergências), o Head de RTR – Ativo Fixo Brasil envia e-mail ao Analista de BPO – Ativo Fixo Brasil, aprovando o teste de depreciação e a depreciação efetiva (conciliação).
cells.T: Monthly, the Head of RTR – Fixed Assets Brazil receives, via email from the BPO Analyst of Fixed Asset Brazil, the spreadsheet “Reconciliation YY FI YYYY MM.xls” and also the monthly movement of G/L account related to the sub ledgers (Fiscal, Regulatory and Corporate) extracted from the accounting balance sheet in the SAP R/3 system - AA and FI, transaction F.01, in order to compare them and validates the depreciation test execution and the reconciliation of the effective depreciation amounts registered in the respective month versus accounting accounts between the AA and FI modules._x000D__x000D_In case of a negative result (if there are discrepancies), the Head of RTR – Fixed Asset Brazil returns the spreadsheet “Reconciliation YY FI YYYY MM.xls” via email to the BPO Analyst of Fixed Asset Brazil, requesting the necessary corrections to the depreciation test and/or the effective depreciation (reconciliation)._x000D__x000D_In case of a positive result (if there are no discrepancies), the Head of RTR – Fixed Asset Brazil sends an email to the BPO Analyst of Fixed Asset Brazil, approving the depreciation test and the efective depreciation (reconciliation).

cells.S: Mensalmente, após a execução das baixas realizadas no SAP R/3 - AA pelo Analista de BPO - Ativo Fixo Brasil, o Head de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brasil recebe, via e-mail, do Analista de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brasil o detalhamento das baixas a fim de verificar se o valor total das baixas realizadas está de acordo com o valor total das baixas previstas por categorias._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado negativo, (identifique erros), o Head de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brazil envia e-mail ao Analista de BPO - Ativo Fixo Brasil solicitando maiores esclarecimentos ou ajustes necessários no registro das baixas no SAP R/3 - AA._x000D__x000D_Em caso de resultado positivo, (não identifique erros), o Head de RTR - Ativo Fixo Brazil valida as baixas via e-mail, o qual é enviado pelo Analista de BPO - Ativo Fixo Brasil.
cells.T: Monthly, after the execution of the write-offs performed in SAP R/3 - AA by the BPO Analyst of Fixed Asset Brazil, the Head of RTR - Fixed Asset Brazil receives, via email, from the Analyst of RTR - Fixed Asset Brazil, the detailed of the write-offs in order to verify if the total value of the write-offs performed is in accordance with the total value of the write-offs defined per category._x000D__x000D_In case of a negative result (errors are identified), the Head of RTR - Fixed Asset Brazil sends an email to the BPO Analyst of Fixed Asset Brazil requesting further clarification or necessary adjustments to the write-off records in SAP R/3 - AA._x000D__x000D_In case of a positive result (no errors identified), the Head of RTR - Fixed Asset Brazil validates the write-offs via email to the BPO Analyst of Fixed Asset Brazil.
